title: Handyman - Mechanical Technician
description:
TKV Construction is currently hiring for a full-time Handyman - Mechanical Technician to perform HVAC, plumbing, and electrical maintenance and repairs while delivering exceptional customer service in the Ellsworth, SD area. This skilled labor position earns a competitive wage of up to $50/hour, based on skills and experience.

In addition to competitive pay and our supportive culture, we offer our skilled labor team the following benefits:

  • Positive company culture
  • 6 paid holidays
  • 401K option

So, now that you've learned the who, what, where, and why, you may be wondering HOW? It's easy! Just fill out our initial mobile-friendly online application. We hope to meet you soon!


DAY-TO-DAY

As a Handyman - Mechanical Technician, you are the lifeblood of our business. Putting your handyman skills to good use, you ensure that our clients' facilities are in good repair and that they receive the best level of customer service possible. Every day you come to work ready to take on a variety of maintenance and repair projects, including HVAC, electrical, and plumbing.

Each job brings new problems to solve, which makes your work a fun and interesting challenge. Personable and friendly, you enjoy the rapport you build with our clients and love to exceed expectations when it comes to customer service. As a hard worker, you take pride in being a handyman our clients can rely on to do a job right!


ABOUT TKV CONSTRUCTION

Based in Utah, we are a growing maintenance company that handles a wide range of projects for our clients. From electrical to HVAC to plumbing, we tackle just about any job that needs doing. We are also a proud military contractor who performs maintenance for military bases on a commissary for active veterans. As a small, family-owned business, we treat every job like it is our own and work to exceed customer expectations.

Our team is filled with professionals who take the time and effort to go through every project thoroughly and with care. Our workers are the face of our company and the key to our success. Here, you're not just a number, you're an important part of our company and family. We're looking for more great employees and would especially welcome veterans to join our team.


OUR IDEAL HANDYMAN - MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN

  • A great communicator - able to explain technical information clearly
  • A problem solver - enjoys troubleshooting and finding solutions
  • Hardworking - dependable and has a positive, can-do attitude
  • A team player - works well as part of a team

If this sounds like you, keep reading!


REQUIREMENTS FOR A HANDYMAN - MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN

  • Experience with refrigeration, electrical, plumbing, or handyman work
  • Ability to perform the physical requirements of this skilled labor position
  • Experience delivering great customer service

Certification in any of the mechanical trades would be a bonus but is not required. HVAC experience would be a plus. Being a veteran would also be a plus. If you meet the above requirements, we need you. Apply today to join our skilled labor team as a Handyman - Mechanical Technician!

title: Head of Growth
description:
About the company

A backed consumer startup building a new category between social video and gaming: a mobile app with a feed of playable games that anyone can make from a single text prompt. Users scroll an endless feed of games, play them instantly and create their own. The product is live on the App Store and the London team is being built now.

The role

At the start, you are the growth team. There is no playbook to inherit and nobody to delegate to. Growth has to come from the product, not from ads, and working out how is your job.

You'll own two questions:

  1. How do we grow organically? Why would someone send the app to a friend, and what makes that friend join? Sharing, invites, content, community, the app store: find which routes work and push hard on them.

  2. How does the product grow itself? Work with the founders, product lead and engineers to build growth into the product: the moments people share, the flows that bring the next person in, and the measurement that proves it worked.

The number you own is the K-factor: how many new users each user brings in. You'll test, read the result, keep what works, and recruit the people to run each proven bet. Paid is a testing tool here, not the engine.

What we're looking for

  • You've owned growth for a company: the number was yours, with a target agreed with the CEO, for 12+ months.

  • You've built product loops that made users bring users: referral, sharing, invite or content loops shipped inside a product, with numbers before and after.

  • You ran growth at a consumer mobile app while it climbed, and your dates line up with its users growing many times over.

  • You've run paid campaigns in-house (Meta, TikTok or Google), read an attribution tool, and used paid to test ideas, not to buy growth.

  • You experiment rather than bulldoze: conviction on two or three bets, not a slide of twenty ideas.

  • You're autonomous: you set your own weekly plan and ship it.

Nice to have

Hired and managed a team · gaming background · app store optimisation · creator or community product experience · built and shipped your own app · knows the London consumer startup scene.

Terms

  • Full-time, permanent.

  • London, in person. The whole team works from one room.

  • Right to work in the UK required (no visa sponsorship until early 2027).

  • Start as soon as possible.

Process

Five steps, around two weeks from first call to offer: screen call, deep dive on your last two roles, a 90-minute live work sample on real sharing data, then an in-person meeting with the founders in London. References with past managers are the final step.

title: SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning Architect
description:
BluePearl Consulting partners with businesses to deliver technology-driven solutions that support innovation, improve operational efficiency, and enable informed decision-making. We connect organisations with specialised technology expertise to solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes.

We are looking for an experienced SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning Architect to lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-wide planning and performance management solutions.

The successful candidate will translate complex financial and business planning requirements into scalable SAC Planning solutions across FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, workforce planning, CAPEX, sales, and operational planning.

Working closely with CFOs, Finance Directors, and senior stakeholders, you will provide strategic guidance and technical leadership throughout the full implementation lifecycle.



Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. SAC Planning Architecture

  • Define and own end-to-end SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solution architecture.
  • Design enterprise planning models covering:
    • Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
    • Budgeting and forecasting
    • Workforce planning
    • Capital expenditure (CAPEX) planning
    • Sales and revenue planning
    • Cost centre and operational planning
  • Establish planning design standards, governance frameworks, and modelling best practices.
  • Design multi-model planning architectures and ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Develop SAC Planning roadmaps aligned with business objectives and client strategies.

2. Client Advisory and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Act as a trusted advisor to CFOs, Finance Directors, and executive stakeholders.
  • Facilitate planning strategy workshops and requirements-gathering sessions.
  • Translate complex business requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Assess existing planning processes and recommend improvements.
  • Present architecture decisions, solution designs, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Support pre-sales activities, solution proposals, and business development initiatives.

3. SAC Planning Delivery Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end SAC Planning implementations from solution design through deployment.
  • Provide technical direction to functional consultants, developers, and delivery teams.
  • Review planning models, calculations, data actions, and advanced formulas.
  • Ensure adherence to SAP best practices and agreed architecture standards.
  • Identify architecture risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment, and post-go-live hypercare.

4. Financial Planning Solution Design

Design and oversee solutions for:

  • Strategic planning and annual budgeting
  • Rolling and driver-based forecasting
  • Workforce and headcount planning
  • CAPEX and cost centre planning
  • Revenue and profitability planning
  • Scenario planning and what-if modelling
  • Predictive forecasting

5. Integration Architecture

Design integration strategies between SAP Analytics Cloud and:

  • SAP S/4HANA
  • SAP Datasphere
  • SAP BW/4HANA and SAP BW
  • SAP ECC
  • SAP HANA
  • Non-SAP ERP platforms
  • HR and payroll systems

Responsibilities include data acquisition design, import processes, live connectivity, data actions integration, and process automation.

6. Technical Leadership and Mentoring

  • Define modelling standards and conduct architecture reviews.
  • Establish performance optimisation guidelines.
  • Lead technical troubleshooting and solution optimisation.
  • Review model structures, calculations, data actions, and advanced formulas.
  • Mentor consultants and team members, supporting technical development and delivery quality.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) experience.
  • 4+ years of SAP Analytics Cloud Planning implementation experience.
  • Experience leading multiple end-to-end SAC Planning implementations as a lead architect.
  • Deep understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management processes.
  • Strong experience designing enterprise planning models and multi-model architectures.
  • Experience integrating SAC Planning with SAP data platforms and non-SAP systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage with senior finance stakeholders and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Strong architecture, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to lead technical teams and maintain solution quality throughout the implementation lifecycle.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a strategic thinker and hands-on architecture leader who understands both the technical capabilities of SAC Planning and the financial processes it supports. You can confidently engage with executive stakeholders, lead complex implementations, guide delivery teams, and design solutions that support long-term business performance.

title: (Senior) Uitvoerder Betonbouw (regio Zuid-Holland)
description:
Bruggen, viaducten, onderdoorgangen en andere complexe betonwerken die Nederland veilig en bereikbaar houden: als uitvoerder civiel werk je aan projecten die ertoe doen! Jij staat midden in de uitvoering, houdt overzicht en stuurt je ploeg aan. Dankzij jou verloopt het werk op de bouwplaats veilig en volgens planning.

Ga het maar doen!
De herinrichting van de Plesmanlaan, de aanpak van de Europaweg en het plaatsen van een nieuwe verkeersbrug bij de N385. Het zijn nog maar enkele van de omvangrijke miljoenenprojecten waar Boskalis Nederland op dit moment aan werkt en waarvoor we uitvoerders zoeken. Op welk project jij start? Dat bepalen we samen op basis van je interesse en regio.

Eén ding is zeker: het gaat altijd om een (deel)project dat technisch uitdagend is én waarin veel belangen spelen. Juist dat maakt jouw werk zo mooi. Want hoe meer stakeholders en belangen, en hoe strakker de planning, hoe belangrijker het wordt dat buiten alles klopt. Je krijgt dan ook veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om het werk op jouw manier te organiseren.

Zo ziet jouw werk eruit:

  • Elke ochtend instrueer je het projectteam over het werk en de planning van die dag. Ook controleer je of onderaannemers leveren wat afgesproken is.
  • Samen met de hoofduitvoerder, andere uitvoerders en de werkvoorbereider beoordeel je hoe het ontwerp buiten het beste uitvoerbaar is. Je overlegt ook met de opdrachtgever en met collega’s uit onze andere disciplines, zoals technisch managers, ecologen, risicomanagers en omgevingsmanagers.
  • Je stuurt op de voortgang en houdt grip op de kosten. Ook denk je mee over slimme werkmethodes en over oplossingen als er iets verandert in de uitvoering.
  • Materieel en materiaal op het juiste moment op de juiste plek? Jij regelt het, zodat het werk buiten door kan.
  • Werkplezier op de bouwplaats staat voorop. Jij houdt de positieve sfeer erin en snapt hoe belangrijk het is om grote en kleine successen samen te vieren.

Dit maakt jouw toekomstige collega trots
“Een grote landelijke aannemer met de sfeer van een klein bedrijf. Juist die mix maakt Boskalis Nederland voor mij een mooie plek om te werken. In het team staan we altijd voor elkaar klaar en we lunchen elke dag samen in de keet. Er is altijd wel iemand die de tafel dekt of kroketten bakt. Ik vind het een samenwerking en sfeer om trots op te zijn.”
Paul, bedrijfsleider regio Zuid

Bekijk meer collega’s en projecten waar we trots op zijn!

Jij helpt Nederland vooruit, wij jou
Dit kun je van ons verwachten:

  • Een brutomaandsalaris van € 3.500 tot € 6.500 (afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring) bij een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur).
  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Bouw & Infra voor UTA-werknemers (Uitvoerend Technisch Administratief), waaronder 20 vakantiedagen én 10 roostervrije dagen, maandelijks 4,96% Budget UTA dagen uitbetaald en 2,3% duurzaam inzetbaarheidsbudget.
  • Een elektrische leaseauto of een mobiliteitsbudget van minimaal € 930,- bruto per maand bij een dienstverband van 40 uur.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling waarvan Boskalis Nederland de premies grotendeels betaalt. Zo houd je netto meer salaris over.
  • Volop ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden. Denk aan opleidingen via onze eigen Boskalis Academy, Performance & Development-gesprekken én boeiende sessies – van webinars tot career-events met trainingen en collega’s die vertellen over hun loopbaanstappen binnen Boskalis.
  • Projecten op locaties door het hele land. De Boskalis-campus in Papendrecht is de uitvalsbasis – hier vind je restaurants, een sportveld mét wekelijkse sportlessen, een state-of-the-art auditorium, een hippe koffieplek én een prachtig uitzicht op onze eigen scheepskade.
  • Waardevolle ontmoetingen met collega’s. Bijvoorbeeld via netwerk- en kennissessies en andere events. Of de activiteiten van onze community’s, zoals Young Boskalis en Women@Boskalis.

Herken je jezelf hierin?
Met jouw duidelijke aansturing leg jij het fundament voor het werk buiten. Je zorgt voor rust en overzicht op de projectlocatie en bent een gesprekspartner voor opdrachtgevers en onderaannemers. Ook schakel je makkelijk met uiteenlopende collega’s, van vakspecialisten tot projectleiders en technisch managers. Je houdt de neuzen dezelfde kant op en signaleert op tijd waar bijsturing nodig is, ook als de planning onder druk komt te staan of de omgeving veel vraagt. En zeker zo belangrijk: je werkt goed samen in een team dat graag hard werkt én er plezier in heeft.

Verder heb je:

  • Mbo- of hbo-niveau, bijvoorbeeld in de richting civiele techniek.
  • Meerdere jaren ervaring als uitvoerder in de civiele infra, zodat je stevig in je schoenen staat op complexe projecten.
  • Ervaring met civiele constructies, zoals bruggen, viaducten, onderdoorgangen of andere betonwerken, bij voorkeur binnen integrale of multidisciplinaire projecten.
  • Je kan zelfstandig werken op dit soort projecten en vindt het leuk om minder ervaren collega's te begeleiden.

Wil je meer weten?
We staan je graag te woord om al je vragen over de functie van uitvoerder betonbouw te beantwoorden. Neem contact op met Tim Gouweleeuw, Recruiter via tim.gouweleeuw@boskalis.com.

Solliciteren doe je eenvoudig door het online sollicitatieformulier in te vullen. We voeren sollicitatiegesprekken online en op kantoor. Denken we allebei dat we een goede match zijn na deze gesprekken, dan zullen we je een mooie aanbieding doen. Ben jij daar blij mee? Welkom aan boord!

Let op: Boskalis vraagt nooit om een financiële bijdrage voor het regelen van visa of andere documenten in relatie tot een vacature. Wees alert op personen die zich voordoen als onze recruiters en wel om dergelijke bijdragen vragen.

Disclaimer voor recruiters en werving & selectiebureaus
Goed dat jullie onze vacatures weten te vinden en willen delen met een potentiële kandidaat, want we begrijpen dat zij wellicht enthousiast worden van deze toffe vacature. Echter hebben wij ons wervingsproces niet op deze manier ingericht, bij Boskalis pakken we de werving zelf op. Dat betekent dat we geen ongevraagde sollicitaties of cv’s van W&S-bureaus accepteren en dat we deze als directe sollicitaties zullen behandelen.

title: Employment Consultant
description:
Are you passionate about supporting individuals to prepare for and secure employment that could change their life? Do you have a knack for identifying an individuals’ employment match?

If so, YOU could be our next Employment Consultant at our Bunbury, WA site within our Workforce Australia Program.

Who Are We:

APM is a global health and human services organisation transforming lives since 1994. Be part of a 15,000-strong team across 11 countries, empowering people of all abilities to lead independent and fulfilling lives. Thrive with us, benefiting from exceptional career growth and development opportunities across our global network of brands.

Who You Are:

A champion of diversity and inclusion – you believe that everyone, no matter their abilities, deserves a chance to succeed

A natural connector – you know how to create opportunities for individuals and speak to stakeholders with confidence

Innovative and solutions focused – You see any challenge as an opportunity and have experience creating pathways to success

Compassionate and empathetic – You want to make a lasting and positive impact on the lives of others

You may also have experience in another industries or roles like sales, retail, call centre, hospitality, consulting, business development, and administration. These skills can set you up for success in this role!

What You’ll Be Doing:

Find the perfect match – you’ll support participants with our Workforce Australia program to prepare for, find and maintain sustainable employment

Boost Confidence – You will help participants see their strengths, overcome obstacles, and take on their new employment with a renewed sense of purpose

Shake Things Up – You will provide creative solutions to overcome employment challenges, making sure every participant has the tools and support for success

Advocating – You will be an advocate for inclusive hiring practices and workplace adjustments

Celebrate the Moments That Matter – Every successful placement is a success, and we are all about celebrating success, big and small with our participants

Building lasting connections – You will form partnerships with companies that are passionate about diversity and inclusion, making sure everyone has a chance to shine!

Why You’ll Love It

This isn’t your average desk job. We are all about breaking barriers, creating opportunities and helping individuals thrive by supporting them to prepare for and secure education or employment pathways.

  • Competitive salary plus performance-based incentives that reward your success.
  • Ongoing training and career development – we are committed to your growth.
  • Supportive and inclusive team environment where your contributions make a difference every day.
  • Celebrating milestones – we love to recognise and rewards hard work with fun events.
  • EAP | Employee Wellbeing Program.
  • Purchased Annual Leave.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Funded Certificate IV in Community Services or Mental Health Peer Support (eligibility criteria applies).
  • Service recognitions.
  • APM Family Hub.
  • Maxxia | Vehicle salary packaging.

To be considered, you will have...

  • Eligibility to work in Australia
  • A current driver’s licence and a comprehensively insured vehicle
  • A MyGovID (Standard level)
  • Willing to complete a National Police Check
  • Able to pass a Working with Children Check
  • Available to work Full-Time Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm

At APM we are strengthened by diversity. We are committed to providing a work environment in which everyone is included, treated fairly and with respect. We encourage applications from people of all ages, nationalities, abilities and cultures including indigenous peoples, the LGBTQI+ community and people with disability.

Ready to change the game? If you are looking for a role where no two days are the same, where you get to inspire, motivate and create a lasting impact, we want to hear from you! Let’s work together to break down barriers, shatter expectations and build a more inclusive world- one individual at a time.

Join us as we continue to #enable better lives!

title: Employee In Charge (EIC)
description:
National Railroad Safety Services, Inc. is looking for safety committed individuals who understand the dedication of working on the railroad as an Employee in Charge in College Station, TX. The Employee in Charge position is a vital position ensuring that work on the rights-of-way is conducted safely.

Job Description: National Railroad Safety Services, Inc. (NRSS) is seeking an Employee in Charge (EIC) to provide essential on-track safety services for freight railroads, transit systems, state DOTs, and rail industry partners.

Job Requirements:

  • Requires proficiency in the use of tablets, smartphones, and communication tools to support coordination of train movements.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to travel for extended periods of time; sometimes months at a time.

title: Systems Proving Engineer - ISV Naval Based Air Defence
description:

The roles will support naval-based air defence programmes, with responsibility for planning and conducting trials, validating system performance and investigating technical issues across a range of testing environments.

Typical responsibilities include:

  • Planning, generating and executing trials in collaboration with Systems Engineering and Design teams
  • Producing trials documentation and preparing for internal and external Trials Readiness Reviews
  • Analysing trials data, investigating design issues and producing technical reports
  • Supporting laboratory, ground-based, harbour, sea and firing trials, including trials conducted overseas
  • Maintaining laboratory safety, risk assessments, asset management and hardware and software configuration control

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in at least one relevant area, such as systems integration, design proving, missile testing, design verification or system acceptance
  • Experience working with engineering teams to plan, conduct and analyse testing activities

The role involves working on-site 4-5 days per week, with opportunities for travel within the UK and internationally to support trials.

title: DevOps Engineer Karachi , On-Site
description:
The DevOps Engineer owns SITC's DevOps function end-to-end, accountable for outcomes rather than tasks. The role sets priorities across deployment readiness, environment stability, monitoring, and service operations, exercises deep technical authority, and develops the engineers within the function, in coordination with engineering, product, and security teams.

Role overview

Division Information Security

Location On-Site, Karachi

Employment type Full Time

About the role

The DevOps Engineer will lead SITC's DevOps function end-to-end, with accountability for deployment readiness, infrastructure stability, monitoring, service operations, and production reliability. The role will oversee CI/CD pipelines, cloud and server operations, containerized deployments, release management, incident response, and operational readiness across SITC systems. Working closely with Engineering, Product, QA, and Security, the position will drive automation, observability, secure and reliable deployments, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate brings 8-10 years of relevant DevOps or infrastructure experience, deep expertise in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, Linux/Windows, Azure/AWS, Infrastructure as Code, and monitoring tools, along with proven people leadership and team development experience.

Key responsibilities

  • DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows, cloud/server operations, and release readiness.
  • Manage containerised deployments, environment stability, monitoring, alerting, backups, and uptime support for SITC systems.
  • Support 24/7 service operations and operational readiness across Linux/Windows, cloud, Docker/Kubernetes, and related infrastructure.
  • Coordinate with Engineering, Product, QA, and Security teams for smooth releases, incident support, and production issue resolution.
  • Document DevOps processes, access controls, operational runbooks, monitoring dashboards, and release dependencies.

Required skills & competencies

  • Deep expertise in CI/CD pipeline design and implementation (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Proficiency in Linux/Windows server administration and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS).
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
  • Monitoring, alerting, and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar).
  • Strong scripting ability (Bash, Python, PowerShell) for automation.
  • Incident management and root-cause analysis for production systems.
  • People management and coaching experience, having built and developed a team.

Qualifications & experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field; Master's preferred, or equivalent delivery experience where evidence supports the required capability.

EXPERIENCE

8-10 years of relevant DevOps / infrastructure operations experience, including ownership of a function or product line and a track record of developing others and being accountable for outcomes rather than tasks. Deep technical authority across CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, Linux/Windows environments, cloud platforms, monitoring/alerting, Prometheus/Grafana or similar tools, applied to complex solution design. Azure/AWS DevOps, CKA, Terraform, or similar certifications preferred.

Note: SITC is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of background, gender, or disability status. Your CV will be held in line with our Privacy Policy.

title: Data & Analytics Expert (hybrid)
description:
About the Team

The Enabling Advanced Analytics team is part of Business Operations and Enablement within P&C Re Operations. The team is responsible for developing and maintaining the P&C Re Operations analytics landscape, supporting functions such as Underwriting Operations, Technical Accounting & Claims Operations, Claims Management, In-force Management, and Client Audit.

We generate actionable business insights by applying advanced analytics, automation, and AI-driven solutions, and act as a bridge between business and IT.

About the Role

Looking for an experienced Data and Analytics Expert to solve high-priority and complex business problems using data-driven approaches, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI. This role is based in Bratislava and will work closely with the Advanced Analytics Lead, team members, IT/D&T, and senior business stakeholders.

You will independently lead complex analytics initiatives end-to-end, shape analytical approaches and solution design, and help scale solutions from exploratory PoCs to robust, production-ready capabilities with measurable business impact. As an expert in the team, you will also provide technical guidance, challenge approaches constructively, and contribute to raising the overall analytics capability of the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous business needs into well-defined analytical problem statements, hypotheses, and scalable data-driven solutions.

  • Lead the design and development of advanced analytics, machine learning, NLP, and Generative AI solutions, selecting appropriate methods based on the business problem and available data.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of analytics solutions, from data exploration and PoC development through validation, production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, working closely with business and IT/D&T teams.

  • Identify data gaps, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve data collection and analytical readiness; work with relevant stakeholders to drive improvements.

  • Lead a team of two data scientists/analysts

  • Provide technical leadership and hands-on guidance to data scientists and analysts through solution reviews, methodological challenge, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.

About You

Technical Skills

  • Master’s degree in a quantitative field (STEM, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or similar).

  • Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in data science, advanced analytics, or machine learning, with demonstrated experience delivering complex solutions into business use.

  • Deep foundation in statistics, probability, experimental design, and analytical problem solving.

  • Strong practical expertise in classical machine learning techniques, such as parametric algorithms (linear/logistic regression), ensemble methods (decision trees, random forests, XGBoost/LightGBM), clustering (k-means, hierarchical clustering), and dimensionality reduction (PCA), with experience in feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and model evaluation.

  • Hands-on experience with NLP and applied Generative AI use cases (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG).

  • Proficiency in Python and Spark (PySpark); experience with common ML/AI libraries.

  • Preferred: SQL, Power BI; insurance/reinsurance domain exposure.

Soft Skills

  • Good communicator with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts clearly and influence both technical and non-technical senior stakeholders.

  • Strong problem-solver with a consulting mindset, able to structure ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, and drive decisions with limited supervision.

  • Demonstrated commitment to talent development, with the ability to mentor, coach, and develop team members, helping them strengthen their capabilities and grow professionally.

  • Comfortable operating in a matrix organization, influencing without formal authority, mentoring colleagues, and collaborating across business and technology teams.

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between 3 300 EUR and 5 400 EUR per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

  • the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​
  • the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​

In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​

Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

#LI-Hybrid

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

title: AI Scrum master
location: Remote, Brazil, Dominican Republic, Argentina, Mexico, Costa Rica
description:
We are seeking an AI Scrum Master with 5+ years of experience in IT and digital product delivery. You will act as the scrum leader and delivery coach for cross-functional teams, owning the health of the Agile process, removing impediments, and enabling teams to deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes. The role requires strong facilitation, coaching, and delivery management skills in Agile environments, combined with hands-on use of AI to make teams faster and more focused.

As we grow into an AI-native way of working, we want someone who is already using LLMs and AI tools in their daily work and is genuinely curious about how these tools can reshape team ceremonies, delivery tracking, and the way engineering teams collaborate.

Key Responsibilities

Agile Delivery Leadership

  • Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Own the team's delivery cadence across the full SDLC, from discovery and refinement through build, test, release, and post-release support.
  • Track sprint and release progress, flag risks early, and keep delivery commitments realistic and transparent.
  • Proactively identify, escalate, and remove impediments that block team progress.
  • Manage cross-team dependencies and coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and delivery leads on shared releases.
  • Ensure a clear and consistent Definition of Ready and Definition of Done across teams.
  • Use LLM tools to accelerate ceremony preparation, sprint summaries, status reports, and retrospective synthesis, while maintaining accuracy and team trust.

Backlog & Flow Management

  • Partner with the Product Manager/Owner to keep the backlog healthy, prioritized, and refined at least two sprints ahead.
  • Help teams break down epics and features into well-sized, testable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Monitor flow metrics such as velocity, cycle time, throughput, and work in progress, and use them to drive improvement.
  • Make bottlenecks, scope changes, and carry-over visible to the team and stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with QA and development teams to ensure work meets quality standards before it is considered done.
  • Apply AI-assisted analysis to Jira data, sprint history, and retrospective notes to surface patterns, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Team Coaching & Continuous Improvement

  • Coach team members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices, and self-organization.
  • Foster a culture of psychological safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Run retrospectives that lead to concrete, tracked improvement actions rather than repeated discussions.
  • Assess team and organizational Agile maturity and tailor coaching to the team's context.
  • Help teams adopt AI-native ways of working, including practical use of LLMs and AI agents in planning, documentation, testing, and delivery.
  • Stay current on LLM and AI agent capabilities and understand where they can be practically applied within the delivery process.

Adaptability & Strategic Thinking

  • Quickly assess IT environments, delivery models, and organizational maturity.
  • Adapt Agile practices to Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery approaches as the engagement requires.
  • Think strategically about delivery predictability while remaining hands-on in day-to-day team execution.
  • Navigate ambiguity, changing priorities, and evolving technical constraints.
  • Provide input to release planning, capacity planning, and roadmap feasibility.

Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration

  • Act as a trusted partner to business stakeholders, client leadership, and IT leadership on delivery matters.
  • Facilitate complex discussions, workshops, and PI or quarterly planning sessions with senior and technical stakeholders.
  • Bridge communication between business, product, and engineering teams.
  • Provide clear, honest reporting on progress, risks, and delivery health throughout the SDLC.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and shield the team from unplanned disruption.

Delivery Health & Metrics

  • Define and maintain team-level delivery metrics and dashboards that show predictability, quality, and flow.
  • Use data to drive conversations about capacity, commitments, and process changes.
  • Coach and mentor junior Scrum Masters and team members in Agile and delivery practices.
  • Contribute to defining how AI adoption is measured within teams, including time saved, output quality, and team confidence in AI-assisted work, not just tool usage numbers.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or similar role, preferably within IT, SaaS, or digital transformation projects.
  • Recognized Scrum or Agile certification (e.g., PSM, CSM, SAFe SM, or equivalent).
  • Strong background in Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid delivery, including backlog management and cross-functional team leadership.
  • Proven success guiding teams to deliver complex IT or software products end-to-end.
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience supporting multiple teams or scaled Agile environments is preferred.
  • Experience in flexible workspace, commercial real estate, or similarly complex B2B service industries is preferred.
  • Strong data-driven mindset with the ability to define delivery metrics, analyze trends, and turn them into team improvements.
  • Technical aptitude to understand engineering practices (CI/CD, testing, code review, technical debt) and discuss trade-offs with engineering teams.
  • Solid understanding of AI/ML concepts and practical experience working with teams that build or use AI-powered features.
  • Comfortable using LLMs (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) as day-to-day productivity tools, not just aware of them in theory.
  • Able to guide teams on responsible AI use in delivery: prompting practices, reviewing AI-generated output, and setting quality expectations.
  • Familiar with the practical limitations of AI systems: hallucinations, data privacy considerations, and when a human review step is needed.

Desired Skills

  • Advanced experience with Jira and Confluence, including board configuration, workflows, dashboards, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with delivery analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Jira Advanced Roadmaps, Power BI, Looker Studio).
  • Experience with scaled Agile frameworks such as SAFe, LeSS, or Scrum@Scale.
  • Prior consulting experience (preferred for contract engagements).
  • Leadership in change management and scaling Agile practices across organizations.
  • Experience coaching distributed or multi-time-zone teams.
  • The capability to identify, assess, and mitigate delivery risks to ensure product success and business continuity.
  • A human-centered approach to team leadership that builds trust, ownership, and sustainable pace.
  • Familiarity with collaboration and whiteboarding tools such as FigJam, Miro, or similar for retrospectives, planning, and process mapping.
  • Regular hands-on use of AI productivity tools in a professional context (e.g., using LLMs to summarize ceremonies, draft sprint reports, analyze retrospective themes, or prepare stakeholder updates).
  • Basic understanding of AI agent concepts, including tool use, automated workflows, and where human-in-the-loop checkpoints are appropriate.
  • Experience introducing AI-assisted workflows into a team's delivery process and measuring their impact.

AP Perks

  • Most cutting-edge technologies
  • Opportunity to work with people who are at the top of their field
  • Great culture and environment
  • Competitive remuneration package. We reward excellence
  • Referral bonus
  • Career growth
  • Collaborative learning environment
  • Mentorship programs
  • Professional training

title: Mid weight Video Editor + Producer (AI & Performance Ads) Remote in USA
description:
Mid weight Video Editor + Producer (AI & Performance Ads)

Core Compensation: $58,000–$70,000 (Base and Bonus)

Location: Remote in USA

About the Role

PetLab Co. is a leader in the DTC pet supplement market, with 9-figure revenue. We're profitable and growing fast around the world.

In performance marketing, a Video Editor does more than make things look good. Every cut, hook and caption you make exists to stop the scroll, hold attention and drive a purchase. You'll be judged on how your ads perform, not on how cinematic they are.

This is a Mid weight, editing-led role for someone with a proven track record of AI-powered performance ads. You'll produce high volumes of ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube that are built to convert. You'll mix UGC, creator footage, stock, and AI-generated video, avatars and voiceovers.

You'll work closely with our Creative Strategists, Paid Media, Video Producers, Organic Social and Influencer teams. This isn't a cut-to-brief role. You'll bring your own ideas, write scripts and hooks, and help shape the creative strategy behind ads that scale customer acquisition and revenue.

Who Will You Report Into?

Hi, I'm Michael, Head of Innovation. We're looking for an experienced, fast editor who's obsessed with direct response and has already built a career on AI-powered ads. You'll be a core part of our in-house creative engine, working day to day with industry-leading creative strategists. You'll see exactly how your ads perform, and you'll have a direct impact on how we acquire customers. If you've made hundreds of AI ads that convert and want to do your best work at a 9-figure DTC brand, let's talk.

What You'll be Responsible For:

1. Performance Video Editing – You'll spend most of your week in the timeline, turning briefs and raw footage into ads that convert. This will include:

  • Editing short-form video ads for Meta, TikTok and YouTube from briefs supplied by our Creative Strategists
  • Writing hooks for the first 3 seconds, keeping the pacing tight, and making sure something visual changes every 2–3 seconds to hold attention
  • Adding captions, text overlays, sound design, music and clear calls-to-action that suit each platform
  • Cutting UGC, creator, influencer, studio and stock footage into native-feeling ads
  • Exporting in 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 and 16:9, with files named and organized so media buyers can launch right away
  • Testing new AI tools to give you that extra edge!

The goal: ads that stop the scroll and drive purchases.

2. Creative Strategy & Scripting – You won't just execute briefs. You'll help come up with the ideas behind them. This will include:

  • Writing direct-response scripts, hooks and CTAs for UGC, creator, AI-avatar and product ads
  • Pitching new concepts and angles based on performance data, customer pain points and trending formats
  • Working with our Creative Strategists to turn insights into briefs, storyboards and shot lists
  • Adapting winning scripts into new angles, personas and hook variations for testing
  • Bringing an editor's eye to strategy: spotting what will hold attention before it's made

The goal: ideas and scripts that are built to convert from the first frame.

3. AI Video Production – AI is already part of how we make ads, and it should be part of how you work every day. This will include:

  • Generating AI video, AI avatars/spokespeople, product B-roll and lifestyle scenes with tools such as Veo, Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen and Arcads
  • Creating AI voiceovers and localized versions with tools such as ElevenLabs
  • Fixing AI outputs so they hold up as real ads: character consistency, product accuracy and overall realism
  • Using AI to speed up editing, such as auto-captions, transcript-based editing, upscaling and cleanup
  • Building repeatable AI workflows and templates, and sharing what works with the team

The goal: more high-quality ads, made faster, at lower cost.

4. Iteration & Testing – You'll help our strategists find winning ads and scale them through fast variations. This will include:

  • Producing many versions of winning ads with new hooks, intros, avatars, lengths and messaging
  • Building versions that change one variable at a time for structured A/B tests (for example, Hook A vs Hook B)
  • Reviewing performance data (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and drop-off points with the team, then re-editing to fix weak spots
  • Studying competitor and trending ads so PetLab's creative stays native to each platform

The goal: keep improving creative performance by testing at volume.

What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like:

  • 60% Editing & AI production: performance video editing and AI video generation
  • 25% Creative & scripting: ideation, scriptwriting and briefing with strategists
  • 15% Iteration & analysis: building test variations and reviewing performance data

Requirements

We're looking for someone with deep editing craft, a direct-response mindset and a proven track record with AI ads.

You must have:

  • 4+ years of video editing experience, including at least 2 years focused on paid social ads for DTC or eCommerce brands
  • Proven experience creating AI-powered ads and creative. Your portfolio must include AI-generated ads you made, with the tools you used and your role in each
  • Hundreds, ideally thousands, of paid social ads produced across your career, with measurable results (e.g. ROAS, CPA, scaled spend)
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the confidence to present ideas, take feedback and work with a global team
  • AI video tools as part of your daily workflow, not something you're still learning (e.g. Veo, Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Arcads, ElevenLabs)
  • Expert skills in Premiere Pro and/or CapCut; After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or motion graphics are a plus
  • A strong grasp of what makes an ad convert: hooks, pacing, retention, offers and CTAs, and the ability to write a direct-response script, not just cut one
  • Working knowledge of performance metrics (Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and how editing choices affect them
  • The speed and organization to deliver a high volume of ads each week without the quality dropping
  • Experience in fast-moving, feedback-heavy creative teams at a high-growth brand or performance agency
  • Bonus points if you love animals. Experience with pet or health and wellness brands is a real plus.

Please note: we won't move forward with portfolios made up only of general editing, YouTube, cinematic, corporate or wedding work. This role is for editors who specialize in performance advertising.

Benefits

  • 20 days PTO excluding bank holidays
  • Company Bonus
  • Medical, Vision and Dental Insurance
  • Generous Learning and development budget
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • 401K

  • Monthly Internet Stipend

We believe that diversity is at the heart of innovation and we welcome passionate candidates from all backgrounds. Come join the family and see for yourself!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to help us build and improve SiteView using React, Java and AWS. If you enjoy working across front-end and back-end development, solving technical challenges and collaborating with an experienced team, we’d like to meet you!

Key about your role

As a Full Stack Developer at Keylane UK, you help develop SiteView, our digital claims platform. SiteView enables insurers to automate workflows, manage digital site visits and connect customers, claims teams and suppliers throughout the claims process. Your work helps make that experience easier to manage and follow. Keylane

You contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from prototyping and developing new features to testing and deployment. On the front end, you work with JavaScript, React, Redux Saga, HTML and CSS. On the back end, you use Java/J2EE, Maven, jOOQ and MySQL, with Docker and AWS forming part of the wider development environment.

Alongside building new functionality, you improve what is already there. You investigate application issues, resolve bugs and identify performance bottlenecks. You follow sound development practices and take responsibility for writing code that is secure, maintainable and reliable.

You work closely with fellow developers and colleagues across the business to understand requirements and translate them into practical solutions. Whether you are exploring a new feature or troubleshooting an existing one, you combine technical curiosity with attention to detail.

Key about your team

You join a small team of experienced developers working on SiteView. Together, you build secure, scalable SaaS software for enterprise customers.

Collaboration is an important part of the role. You discuss technical challenges, share knowledge and work with colleagues from other departments. You are comfortable progressing your own work independently, while knowing when to involve others and work through a problem together.

About Keylane Property & Casualty

Keylane develops SaaS platforms that help insurers modernise their operations and improve the service they provide to customers. Our Property & Casualty portfolio includes Axon and SiteView, bringing together core insurance software and digital claims capabilities. SiteView works alongside existing core systems, helping insurers improve their claims processes without replacing their entire technology landscape.

Requirements

  • You have at least five years of relevant development experience, working across the front end and back end with this technology stack or a comparable one;
  • You have hands-on experience with Java/J2EE, JavaScript, React and MySQL, alongside familiarity with Maven and jOOQ;
  • You have experience using Docker and a solid understanding of networking;
  • You enjoy investigating problems and developing sustainable solutions. You work carefully, take initiative and pay attention to the quality of what you deliver;
  • You communicate clearly, build good working relationships and collaborate effectively with people from different backgrounds. You are comfortable working independently and learning new tools and technologies;
  • You have a degree in computer science, mathematics or another technical subject, or equivalent practical experience or qualifications.

You must have the right to work in the UK.

It’s a plus if you have experience with AWS services such as EC2, RDS, SES or SWF; React Native; Jenkins; Python; or Bash. Familiarity with GitHub, IntelliJ and macOS is also useful.

Using AI

  • You have practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude, OpenAI tools, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, in professional work or your own projects. You can explain how you have applied them to activities such as understanding code, developing features, writing tests or troubleshooting;
  • You understand where these tools can support the development process and where human judgement is essential. You provide clear requirements and context, and recognise when an output needs further investigation;
  • You critically assess, test and debug AI-generated code and suggestions. You remain responsible for the correctness, security and maintainability of everything you deliver.

Benefits

  • Starting with a gross annual salary between 46.000 and 66.000 GBP for a senior candidate based on fulltime employment
  • Income Protection
  • Life Insurance - 4x annual salary
  • 8% Employer Pension Contribution
  • 25 holiday days + 8 inclusion days (Bank Holidays)
  • Company Bonus Scheme
  • Flexible Working
  • Edinburgh or London | Hybrid / remote working

title: Java Engineer
description:
As a Senior Java Engineer, you will work remotely on an hourly paid basis to review AI-generated Java code, architectural solutions, and technical explanations, as well as generate high-quality reference implementations and reasoning steps. You will assess solutions for accuracy, clarity, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in logic, performance, or design; fact-check technical information; write high-quality explanations and model solutions that demonstrate correct methods; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality. This fully remote, hourly paid contractor role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI data services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data to many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation model labs, where your Java expertise will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models.

Important

There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.

  • Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.
  • Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance the model's accuracy, fluency, and contextual relevance.
  • Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI models for potential inaccuracies or biases, validating their reliability across use cases.

Your Profile

  • Deep understanding of core Java, concurrency primitives, and the Java Collections Framework.
  • Extensive experience building and maintaining backend services using Spring or Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservice architectures.
  • Strong grasp of software design principles, system design, and performance optimization in distributed Java systems.

  • Comfort working with modern engineering tooling such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and containerization technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting thorough code reviews and providing structured, constructive feedback to other engineers.
  • Previous experience with AI data training, annotation, or evaluating AI-generated technical content is a strong plus.
  • Highly detail-oriented and systematic, with a methodical approach to evaluating reasoning quality and identifying subtle issues in Java solutions.

title: Contractor In Charge (CIC)
description:
National Railroad Safety Services, Inc. is seeking dedicated, safety-driven individuals for the Contractor in Charge position in Provo, UT. This essential role is responsible for ensuring all work within railroad rights-of-way is performed safely and in compliance with regulations.

Job Description: National Railroad Safety Services, Inc. (NRSS) is seeking a Contractor in Charge (CIC) responsible for overseeing construction, maintenance, and safety compliance for freight railroads, transit systems, state DOTs, and rail industry partners.

Job Requirements:

  • Strong computer, communication, and organizational skills
  • Communicates effectively in both verbal and written formats
  • Ability for long-term travel assignments, including multi-month deployments.
  • Valid Driver's License
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent

  • Responsible for documenting all activities, including job briefings, incident reports, daily work logs, and electronic forms for submission to management and regulatory agencies.

Work Environment:

  • Ability to work in all weather conditions

Do you enjoy working in the field, solving problems, and making a positive impact in your community? The City of Stirling is seeking a proactive and customer-focused Verge Control Officer to join our Development Services team.

  • Work collaboratively with internal teams to ensure the protection and restoration of public infrastructure.

You are a confident and professional compliance officer with strong investigative and problem-solving skills. You enjoy working autonomously in the field while balancing customer service, regulatory requirements and community expectations.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • Qualifications in Town Planning, Building Surveying, Civil Engineering or demonstrated equivalent experience.
  • Sound knowledge of compliance, enforcement, building control or regulatory practices.
  • The ability to interpret plans, specifications and technical documentation.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Excellent organisational, record-keeping and time management abilities.
  • Well-developed decision-making skills and the ability to apply legislation and policy consistently.
  • Experience dealing with challenging customer situations in a professional manner.
  • A current driver's licence and National Police Clearance.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

title: AI & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
AI & Infrastructure Engineer

Rochdale | £45,000 to £50,000 + 25% Bonus + Benefits | Hybrid - 3 Days Office-Based

An excellent opportunity for an IT Support or Infrastructure Engineer to join a large, established organisation with a £180m turnover and 7,500 employees, as it begins to invest in AI and automation.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a solid Microsoft 365 and Azure who wants to get more involved in AI, automation and emerging technologies alongside their infrastructure responsibilities. You don't need to be an AI specialist already but some exposure to it and AI Agents either commercially or in your own time will be needed.

The Role

Working closely with the AI Software Engineer, you will help maintain the infrastructure, platforms and applications that support the organisation's growing use of AI and automation.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Administering cloud, hosting and AI platforms, including user accounts, access rights, environments, API keys and usage monitoring.
  • Deploying, monitoring and maintaining internal applications and AI agents, troubleshooting issues and escalating where necessary.
  • Supporting Microsoft 365 and Azure services, including Entra ID, SharePoint, Teams, permissions and Power Platform integrations.
  • Onboarding colleagues onto approved AI tools, managing licences and providing guidance on their safe and effective use.
  • Supporting data connections, scheduled jobs and simple automations, with opportunities to contribute to development projects.
  • Maintaining system documentation, configuration records, support procedures and recovery plans.
  • Applying security best practices, including multi-factor authentication, access controls, patching and monitoring.
  • Setting up and supporting devices and technology used for automation, meeting capture and digital signage.
  • Monitoring platform usage, costs and incidents, identifying opportunities to improve reliability and efficiency.
  • Assisting with testing and the rollout of new tools and technologies across the business.

About You

You will have experience in systems administration or infrastructure support, with a good understanding of Microsoft technologies and an interest in developing your skills in AI and automation.

Ideally, you will have:

  • Experience supporting Microsoft 365, including Entra ID, Exchange, SharePoint and Teams.
  • Knowledge of Windows and macOS devices and general IT troubleshooting.
  • An understanding of cloud and web technologies, including DNS, hosting, APIs and basic command-line tools.
  • A methodical approach to problem-solving, with good organisational and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication skills and a helpful, patient approach to supporting users.
  • An interest in AI tools and automation, alongside an understanding of information security and the importance of handling confidential data appropriately.

Experience with Power Automate, PowerShell, Python, JavaScript, Azure App Service or AI platforms would be advantageous, as would relevant Microsoft or CompTIA certifications.

The Opportunity

Joining a substantial organisation that is fully embracing AI and automation, you'll have the opportunity to build on your existing infrastructure skills while gaining exposure to new technologies and projects.

Working alongside an AI Software Engineer, you'll play a key role in keeping the environment secure, reliable and running smoothly, while developing valuable experience in an increasingly important area of IT.

Package: £45,000 - £50,000, plus 25% bonus, private medical insurance and pension.

Location: Rochdale, with three days per week in the office.

If you're an IT support or infrastructure professional looking for a role that combines your existing technical skills with the opportunity to get involved in AI and automation, this could be an excellent next step.


Coburg Banks Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Microsoft PKI SME (Engineer)
description:
PKI SME Engineer - Microsoft AD CS

Rate: £520 per day Inside IR35
Contract: 6-12 Months (Subject to Extension)
Location: Remote with some occasional travel onsite to Bath.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced PKI SME Engineer to lead the hands-on implementation of a Microsoft Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) solution within a greenfield enterprise environment.

This is a delivery-focused role requiring a technical specialist with proven experience deploying Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) at enterprise scale. The successful candidate will be responsible for building, configuring, testing, and transitioning a production-ready PKI capability into service, followed by a period of focused post-go-live hypercare.

Working from established designs and architecture, you will take ownership of the implementation, integration, testing, and operational handover of the PKI platform, ensuring it is secure, scalable, and production-ready.

Role Purpose

The PKI SME Engineer is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of a Microsoft PKI solution within a new enterprise environment.

You will carry out the technical implementation of Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS), integrating the service into enterprise infrastructure and validating the platform through comprehensive testing before supporting production cutover and hypercare activities.

This role is focused on technical delivery, testing, transition, and post-go-live support rather than solution design.


Key Responsibilities

PKI Platform Implementation

  • Build and configure a greenfield Microsoft PKI environment based on approved architectural designs.
  • Prepare and validate all platform prerequisites, including Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, networking, service accounts, and security groups.
  • Install and configure:
    • Offline Root Certificate Authority (CA)
    • Enterprise Issuing Certificate Authorities
    • Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS) components
    • Supporting PKI infrastructure services

Certificate Services Configuration

  • Configure and manage certificate templates, policies, and permissions.
  • Implement auto-enrolment, certificate renewal, and certificate revocation processes.
  • Configure and validate Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), certificate chain publication, and supporting services.
  • Implement and support OCSP and NDES services where required.

Integration & Validation

  • Integrate PKI services with Active Directory and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Support integration with applications, devices, endpoints, and hybrid environments.
  • Execute build verification testing and functional validation activities.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve implementation defects and technical issues.

Go-Live & Hypercare

  • Support production deployment and service cutover activities.
  • Provide post-go-live hypercare support.
  • Investigate and resolve certificate, trust, authentication, and enrolment issues.
  • Work closely with operational support teams to ensure a smooth transition to business-as-usual support.

Documentation & Handover

  • Produce comprehensive as-built documentation.
  • Create operational runbooks and configuration records.
  • Document testing outcomes and implementation activities.
  • Deliver knowledge transfer sessions to support and operational teams.


Essential Technical Skills

Microsoft PKI Expertise

  • Strong hands-on experience implementing Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services (AD CS).
  • Enterprise Certificate Authority (CA) deployment and administration.
  • Certificate lifecycle management.

PKI Technologies

  • Certificate Templates
  • Auto-Enrolment
  • Certificate Revocation Lists (CRL)
  • Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP)
  • Network Device Enrolment Service (NDES)
  • Certificate Chain Management
  • Trust Validation

Microsoft Infrastructure

  • Windows Server
  • Active Directory
  • Group Policy
  • DNS
  • PowerShell Scripting

Enterprise Integration

  • Integration of PKI with enterprise infrastructure and applications.
  • Experience supporting hybrid and on-premises environments.
  • Knowledge of identity, authentication, and security services.

Troubleshooting

  • Certificate chain troubleshooting.
  • TLS and SSL certificate troubleshooting.
  • Service authentication and trust-related issue resolution.
  • Certificate enrolment and renewal diagnostics.


Required Experience

  • Proven hands-on experience delivering enterprise PKI implementations.
  • Extensive experience deploying Microsoft AD CS environments.
  • Experience building and configuring enterprise-scale PKI solutions.
  • Strong background working across both on-premises and hybrid infrastructures.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting production deployments and post-go-live hypercare activities.


Desirable Skills

  • Microsoft security technologies.
  • Enterprise identity and access management solutions.
  • Infrastructure automation using PowerShell.
  • Experience within highly regulated or security-sensitive environments.
  • Knowledge of certificate-based authentication and enterprise security frameworks.

title: Chief Quality Inspector
description:
MERITUS are recruiting for a Chief Quality Inspector to join our Precision Manufacturing client in their growing quality team in a permanent role.

CHIEF QUALITY INSPECTOR - £NEG - BASILDON, ESSEX - 1 STAGE INTERVIEW PROCESS - SECTOR: PRECISION MANUFACTURING - AEROSPACE COMPONENTS


An established and rapidly growing precision manufacturing company is continuing to strengthen its Quality team following sustained growth across aerospace, defence and commercial engineering programmes.

As new projects continue to be secured and production expands, they're looking to welcome an experienced Chief Quality Inspector / Senior Quality Inspector to join the business.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working closely with production teams, takes pride in maintaining exceptional quality standards, and wants to play a key leadership role in delivering precision-engineered components for highly regulated industries.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Quality Manager, you'll be responsible for leading the day-to-day inspection function across the business, acting as the technical bridge between Quality Management and the shop-floor inspection team.

This is a practical, hands-on inspection role where you'll spend time on the shop floor, working alongside production teams and inspectors to ensure components meet the highest quality standards before progressing through manufacture.

You'll provide technical leadership within the quality department, supporting and mentoring inspectors while using your experience to make informed inspection decisions, resolve technical challenges and drive continuous improvement.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Carrying out first-off, in-process and final inspections of precision-machined components.
  • Completing batch control and inspection sign-off activities.
  • Reading and interpreting third-angle engineering drawings, dimensions and tolerances.
  • Programming and operating CMM equipment to support inspection activities across the business.
  • Using a range of conventionalmetrology equipment, including:
    • Height gauges
    • Internal and external micrometers
    • Intrimics / ball micrometers
    • Slip gauges
    • Verniers and associated inspection equipment
  • Providing technical support and guidance to Quality Inspectors and production teams.
  • Acting as the key link between the inspection team and the Quality Manager.
  • Supporting quality investigations, non-conformance resolution and root-cause activities.
  • Working closely with production teams to resolve inspection-related queries.
  • Helping to maintain high quality standards within aerospace and defence manufacturing.
  • Identifying non-conformances and ensuring components meet specification before release.
  • Supporting the continued development of inspection processes, standards and best practice across the department.


What We're Looking ForEssential
  • Previous experience as a Senior Quality Inspector, Chief Inspector, Quality Inspector or Quality Technician.
  • Strong understanding of precision machining inspection processes.
  • Experience programming and operating CMM equipment.
  • Ability to confidently read and interpret third-angle engineering drawings.
  • Experience using conventional metrology equipment.
  • Experience supporting, mentoring or leading inspection teams.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with production, engineering and quality management teams.
  • Comfortable working independently while supporting a wider production and quality function.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high quality standards.
Desirable
  • Experience using PC-DMIS, Zeiss, MCOSMOS or similar CMM software.
  • Previous aerospace or defence manufacturing experience.
  • Experience inspecting complex precision-machined components.
  • Previous experience acting as a technical lead, senior inspector or team supervisor.
  • Understanding of root-cause investigation and continuous improvement activities.
Why Join?

This is a fantastic opportunity to become part of a growing engineering business where quality is genuinely valued.

You'll be joining an experienced team and stepping into a position where you'll have real influence over the inspection function, acting as the technical link between the Quality Manager and the wider inspection team.

You'll work on interesting aerospace, defence and commercial engineering programmes while helping shape the future growth and capability of the quality department.
