ensure contractors deliver services in full compliance with contractual requirements, approved procedures, method statements, staffing levels, competency requirements, licensing obligations, plant availability targets, response times, reporting obligations, and spare parts commitments; monitor contractor performance against contractual KPIs and service level agreements (SLAs); identify, document, and formally address all contractual deviations and non-conformances; direct corrective actions and verify close-out of contractor deficiencies; provide the facilities manager with supporting evidence and recommendations for contractual interventions when required; review and validate contractor procedures, risk assessments, technical reports, performance reports, laboratory reports, operational records, and invoice submissions before approval; participate in contractor performance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives; monitor contractor KPIs and service performance against contract requirements and report deviations; verify and control process performance at each sewage treatment plant, covering aeration and dissolved oxygen, MLSS and sludge age, food to microorganism ratio, sludge return and wasting, clarifier or membrane performance, disinfection, and sludge dewatering and disposal; ensure STP services comply with design and operational requirements, effluent quality and discharge standards, environmental permits, manufacturer’s specs covering BOD, COD, suspended solids, ammonia, nitrates, fecal coliforms, residual chlorine, pH, and oil and grease; review and analyze process and performance indicators including flows, loads, removal efficiency, alarms and incidents; review laboratory results, identify trends and deviations, and trigger corrective actions; manage hydraulic and organic loading against design capacity, including peak occupancy, shock loads and grease or chemical ingress from kitchens, workshops and washdown areas; oversee sludge routes and any treated effluent reuse for irrigation, dust suppression or flushing, in line with permit conditions; oversee wellfield management, covering borehole yield and drawdown monitoring, rest and rotation of boreholes, submersible pump condition and performance, rising mains, wellhead protection and sanitary seals, and groundwater quality trending; verify contractor control of the groundwater treatment train, covering aeration and oxidation, iron and manganese removal, coagulation and clarification where fitted, multimedia and sand filtration, activated carbon, softening or hardness control where required, pH correction, disinfection and contact time; monitor and act on the raw and treated water parameters relevant to groundwater, being iron, manganese, hardness, fluoride, nitrate, sulphate, chloride, total dissolved solids, turbidity, pH and microbiological quality; ensure WTP services comply with operational requirements, environmental permits, company rules, and WHO guidelines for drinking water quality; oversee residual disinfectant across the network, storage tank inspection, cleaning and disinfection cycles, the sampling program, and legionella risk control; manage water balance, demand forecasting against site personnel on board, storage autonomy and contingency supply arrangements; diagnose process and equipment faults independently of the contractor, covering sludge bulking and settleability, nitrification failure, filter breakthrough and short circuiting, dosing and disinfection failure, pump and blower performance loss, and instrument drift; technically assess the integrity of the contractor's plant and workmanship: open and inspect equipment where warranted, verify filter media condition and bed depth, confirm calibration and correct installation of instruments, inspect completed maintenance before plants return to service, and confirm that parts and chemicals used are of the correct specification; cross-check contractor process data and laboratory results against independent sampling and field measurement; challenge results inconsistent with observed plant condition or loading and reject records that cannot be substantiated; where contractor performance, competence or integrity is in doubt, intervene technically: direct process corrections, stop non-compliant operations and require rework, escalating the contractual consequence to the Facilities Manager; verify that the contractor executes the preventive maintenance program to plan and to standard across all plants, covering blowers, pumps, dosing systems, membranes and cartridges, filter media replacement and backwashing, valves and actuators, control systems and instrumentation for dissolved oxygen, pH, ORP, turbidity, chlorine, flow and level, electrical panels and standby generators; witness and sign off critical maintenance activities and audit maintenance records and job cards against work physically verified rather than accepting paperwork at face value; maintain and challenge the contractor's critical spares list, verify physical stock against the list, set and monitor minimum and maximum levels, and track re-order triggers against remote-site lead times; verify that chemicals, membranes, filter media, dosing pump spares, seals, lubricants and personal protective equipment are in place and within shelf life and escalate any shortfall before it becomes an availability or compliance risk; ensure calibration and verification of all process and laboratory instrumentation is in date and certificated; verify routine inspections and maintenance activities for sewer networks, grease traps, lift stations, irrigation infrastructure, and associated utility assets; produce daily and monthly utilities reports covering volumes abstracted, produced and treated, plant availability, capacity utilization against design, water quality and effluent results, chemical and energy consumption, exceptions and corrective actions; consolidate data and contribute to weekly and monthly site environmental, incident, deviation and non-compliance reporting; support abstraction and discharge permits, licenses and regulatory reporting, and provide evidence to internal inspections and audits and to external audits by lenders, authorities and certification bodies; enforce chemical safety for chlorine, acids, caustic, coagulants and polymers, together with confined space entry, lockout and tagout, permit to work and biohazard controls; lead toolbox talks and task risk assessments, participate in incident investigations, and maintain emergency response arrangements for spills, overflows, contamination events and loss of potable water supply.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher diploma in Civil, Environmental, Chemical or Mechanical Engineering, or in Water and Wastewater Technology;
  • Minimum of 10 to 15 years' experience in operations and maintenance of Sewage Treatment Plants and Water Treatment Plants and networks;
  • A hands-on maintenance and process background is mandatory. The candidate must have personally operated, maintained and repaired treatment plant and must be able to diagnose process and mechanical faults and assess plant integrity without Contractor support;
  • Demonstrated responsibility for several Sewage Treatment Plants and Water Treatment Plants operating concurrently, including packaged plants serving remote camps with fluctuating populations, at capacities up to 1,500 m3/day;
  • Practical experience treating borehole and groundwater to potable standard, including iron and manganese removal and hardness management. Seawater desalination experience is not a substitute for this requirement;
  • Demonstrated experience owning maintenance assurance and critical spare parts management on a remote site with long procurement lead times;
  • Experience of Operations and Maintenance from the Contractor’s is preferred side against contractual KPIs, including enforcement of contractual clauses;
  • Recognized water and wastewater treatment operator certification, Treatment or Wastewater Operations, or an equivalent national license;
  • NEBOSH International General Certificate or IOSH Managing Safely. ISO 14001 Internal Auditor is an asset;
  • Working knowledge of environmental permits, discharge consents, Environmental Management Systems and IFC standards. Ability to analyze process data and make inferences from it;
  • Good communication skills (English is required, while Portuguese is an asset);
  • Ability to work in a remote, multicultural and high-activity site environment.

Benefits

The possibility of working in a Company that offers salary conditions compatible with the level of experience and level of responsibility of the role, as well as opportunities for personal development.

title: CNC Setup Specialist
description:
About Company:

Our History

Since our humble beginning as a small blacksmith shop in 1882, Brunner & Lay has grown to include manufacturing plants and warehouses on three different continents. These include seven facilities in the United States, two in Canada, three in Great Britain, one in Germany, and two in Australia. We have played a role in the construction of some of the world’s most famous highways, dams, airfields, mines, quarries, and even national monuments.


American Made since 1882

About the Role:

The CNC Setup Specialist plays a critical role in the manufacturing process by preparing and configuring CNC machines to ensure precise and efficient production runs. This position requires a deep understanding of machine setup, tooling, and programming to optimize machine performance and maintain high-quality output. The specialist will collaborate closely with production teams to interpret engineering drawings and specifications, ensuring that all setups meet stringent quality and safety standards. By troubleshooting and resolving setup issues promptly, the CNC Setup Specialist helps minimize downtime and supports continuous improvement initiatives. Ultimately, this role is essential for maintaining the seamless operation of CNC machinery, contributing directly to the overall productivity and success of the manufacturing facility.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Proven experience in CNC machine setup within a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and blueprints.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and familiarity with CNC tooling and fixtures.
  • Basic knowledge of CNC programming and machine operation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Technical certification or associate degree in manufacturing technology or a related field.
  • Experience with specific CNC control systems such as Fanuc, Haas, or Siemens.
  • Familiarity with precision measurement tools and quality control processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with CAD/CAM software.
  • Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma training.

Responsibilities:

  • Set up CNC machines according to job specifications, including installing and aligning tooling, fixtures, and workholding devices.
  • Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and work orders to determine machine setup requirements and ensure compliance with quality standards.
  • Perform trial runs and make necessary adjustments to machine parameters to achieve optimal performance and product accuracy.
  • Collaborate with machinists, programmers, and quality control personnel to troubleshoot and resolve setup-related issues.
  • Maintain detailed records of machine setups, tooling usage, and production data to support process documentation and continuous improvement efforts.

Skills:

The CNC Setup Specialist utilizes their technical skills daily to accurately interpret engineering drawings and translate them into precise machine setups, ensuring product specifications are met. Mechanical aptitude is essential for installing and adjusting tooling and fixtures, which directly impacts the quality and efficiency of production runs. Troubleshooting skills are frequently applied to identify and resolve setup issues quickly, minimizing machine downtime. Knowledge of CNC programming and control systems enables the specialist to collaborate effectively with programmers and operators to optimize machine performance. Additionally, strong communication and documentation skills support coordination with team members and maintain accurate records for continuous process improvement.

title: SOLUTION ARCHITECT - SECURITY (M/F)
description:
Svaka nova funkcionalnost u Aircashu počinje tehničkom specifikacijom. U njoj se odlučuje koje se komponente koriste, gdje su granice povjerenja i što se događa ako isti zahtjev za plaćanje stigne dvaput u istoj milisekundi. Propust uočen u specifikaciji ispravlja se u nekoliko minuta, a onaj koji dođe do produkcije košta puno više. Tražimo osobu koja će se pobrinuti da se takvi propusti otkriju na vrijeme.

Aircash je hrvatska fintech kompanija koja je iz lokalne ideje izrasla u jednu od najbrže rastućih platformi za plaćanje u Europi. Sustav razvijamo sami, a koriste ga milijuni ljudi diljem Europe. Kod nas nema nepotrebne birokracije ni krutih korporativnih procedura.

O ulozi

Core odjel brine o znanju o Aircash sustavu i o tome da razvojni timovi imaju provjerene komponente, jasne standarde i dobru dokumentaciju. Platform tim unutar Core odjela pojačavamo seniornom osobom koja će biti odgovorna za sigurnost aplikacija u odjelu. Očekujemo da o sigurnosti razmišljaš već od prve verzije specifikacije, a ne tek nakon penetracijskog testa.

Čime ćeš se baviti

Arhitektura

  • pregledom i odobravanjem tehničkih specifikacija novih funkcionalnosti, u paru s kolegom iz Platform tima – bez odobrenja implementacija ne počinje
  • definiranjem arhitekture zajedničkih komponenti koje razvija tim za interne sustave
  • pisanjem dokumentacije za Knowledge Hub, središnje mjesto dokumentacije o našim sustavima i razvojnim standardima
  • predavanjima na internoj Akademiji

Sigurnost

  • sigurnosnom analizom specifikacija: dotiče li rješenje novčane tokove, osobne podatke, autentifikaciju ili regulatorne kontrole
  • analizom ranjivosti pronađenih sigurnosnim testiranjem te određivanjem prioriteta i načina sanacije
  • vođenjem registra ranjivosti i praćenjem sanacije do zatvaranja
  • definiranjem pravila sigurnog razvoja na temelju pronađenih ranjivosti i njihovim prenošenjem razvojnim timovima

Sigurnosno testiranje i automatizacija

  • vođenjem procesa kontinuiranog sigurnosnog testiranja s vanjskim konzultantom: dva sveobuhvatna testiranja godišnje, a između njih izvanredna testiranja i retestovi
  • definiranjem opsega testiranja, usklađivanjem testnih računa i okruženja s Operations timom, eskalacijom kritičnih ranjivosti i naručivanjem retestova
  • internom provjerom sanacije prije retesta
  • automatizacijom testova za sanirane ranjivosti visoke i kritične razine, koji se u CI/CD pipelineu izvode prije i nakon svakog produkcijskog releasea kako se ranjivost ne bi vratila s novim kodom

Funkcionalno testiranje nije dio ove uloge.

Što očekujemo

  • najmanje 5 godina iskustva u arhitekturi softverskih rješenja ili sigurnosti aplikacija
  • iskustvo u dizajnu backend sustava i integracija
  • poznavanje C#/.NET-a (ili spremnost na rad u .NET okruženju) i SQL-a
  • praktično iskustvo u sigurnosnom testiranju web i mobilnih API-ja (OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, ASVS, MASVS)
  • samostalnu reprodukciju ranjivosti (Burp Suite ili sličan alat) i procjenu prema CVSS v3.1
  • dobro poznavanje autentifikacije i autorizacije (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT, sesije)
  • razumijevanje propusta poslovne logike u novčanim tokovima: dvostruko izvršenje, race condition, zaobilaženje limita, pristup tuđim podacima (IDOR/BOLA)
  • iskustvo s automatizacijom sigurnosnih testova i njihovim izvođenjem u CI/CD pipelineu
  • iskustvo u pisanju i pregledu tehničke dokumentacije te sposobnost jasnog obrazlaganja odluka razvojnim timovima i upravi
  • samostalnost u vođenju procesa s rokovima i vanjskim suradnikom
  • spremnost na prijenos znanja kroz interne edukacije
  • izvrsno poznavanje hrvatskog i engleskog jezika

Prednost će imati kandidati s

  • iskustvom u fintechu, e-novcu ili platnom prometu (DORA, PSD2, AML)
  • iskustvom u sigurnosnom testiranju Android i iOS aplikacija
  • iskustvom u threat modelingu
  • iskustvom sa SAST, SCA i DAST alatima
  • iskustvom s Azure DevOpsom
  • certifikatima poput OSCP, OSWE ili BSCP

Ne tražimo nužno nekoga tko je dosad imao titulu arhitekta. Ako si senior backend developer koji se već dulje bavi sigurnošću ili AppSec stručnjak koji se želi više baviti dizajnom sustava, slobodno se prijavi.

Što nudimo

  • prilike za učenje i razvoj, unutar i izvan kompanije
  • kulturu otvorene povratne informacije
  • svježe pripremljen ručak svaki dan, uz više opcija
  • kavu, čaj, voće i grickalice u uredu

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description:

The Joblogic Story

Established in 1998,Joblogic is the UK’s #1 Field Service Management (FSM) software platform. We are a global business with offices in the UK, Pakistan, and Vietnam. Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from ~£500K ARR to ~£35M+ ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.

Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from Vista Equity Partners — a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over £100 million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our AI-first roadmap, expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.

With Vista’s backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to £100M ARR across international markets.

Joblogic provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over 100,000 users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.

About the role

Were scaling our data department and need a senior engineer who can do two things at once:keep the data that runs the business flowing reliably today, and architect the enterprise data warehouse that will run it tomorrow.

In the near term youll own and harden our current Azure-based ingestion and transformation pipelines. In the medium term — your biggest mandate — youll design and implement our enterprise data warehouse / lakehouse from the ground up and lead the platform migration toMicrosoft Fabric(our most likely direction) or Databricks.

This is a hands-onandleadership role. Youll set engineering standards, mentor two data engineers, and be the technical owner of the engineering branch as the team and data volumes grow. If youve built a warehouse from a blank page and want to do it again — properly, with governance and a clean semantic foundation — this is that role.

The two mandates

Now run the business

What youll own today

  • Own and maintain the ingestion pipelines feedingMarketing, Sales, CSM and Financeinto the data lake — consistent, auditable ingestion.
  • Design, build and optimiseETL/ELT pipelines in Azure Data Factory; write and tune complex SQL and stored procedures.
  • BuildPython automation and REST API integrationsfor external and third-party data.
  • Enforcedata quality, validation and lineageacross every pipeline.
  • Partner with the Analytics team so clean, modelled data feedsPower BIon time.
  • Set the engineering bar (Git, code review, CI/CD) and mentor the two engineers.
  • Monitor pipeline performance andcost; tune compute and storage.

Next build the platform

What youll build

  • Architect and implement the enterprise warehouse / lakehouse end-to-end— medallion (bronze / silver / gold), dimensional models, canonical definitions, governed semantic layer.
  • Lead the migration to Microsoft Fabric— OneLake, Lakehouse & Warehouse, Data Factory, Direct Lake for Power BI (or Databricks): strategy, phased cutover, legacy decommission.
  • Definemodelling, naming, partitioning and indexingstandards and performance SLAs.
  • Putgovernance, security, lineage and cost controlsin place so the platform scales without runaway spend.
  • Own the technical roadmap and architecture direction for the engineering function.

Must-have — core skills & experience

Non-negotiable

Proven, hands-on experiencedesigning and implementing a data warehouse / lakehouse from scratch— not just maintaining one. You should be able to point to a warehouse you architected: the modelling decisions, the trade-offs, and the outcome.

  • 6+ yearsin data engineering, including senior ownership of architecture and delivery on at least one end-to-end warehouse/lakehouse build.
  • Python— data engineering, automation and API work.
  • SQL— complex queries, performance optimisation and stored procedures.
  • Azure Data Services:
    • Azure Data Factory (ADF)
    • Azure SQL Database
    • Azure Storage (Blob / Data Lake)
    • Azure Functions
  • Data engineering fundamentals:
    • ETL/ELT pipeline development
    • Data modelling (incl. dimensional / star-schema)
    • Data transformation
    • Data validation & quality
  • Database design & management
  • REST API integration
  • Git / version control
  • Performance optimisation & scalability
  • Strongproblem-solving & debugging

Target platform — Microsoft Fabric

Strong advantage near-required

We are moving to Fabric, so this weighs heavily

  • Hands-on experience withMicrosoft Fabric— OneLake, Lakehouse & Warehouse, Data Factory (Fabric pipelines/dataflows) andDirect Lakesemantic models for Power BI.
  • Candidates who haveled a migration to Fabric or Databricksare ideal.
  • If you havent used Fabric yet but have deep lakehouse experience on Databricks / Synapse and can pick it up fast — still apply.

Good to have

  • Apache Spark / Databricks
  • Docker & containerisation
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Azure DevOps
  • Power BI — semantic models
  • FastAPI / Flask
  • Event-driven architectures
  • Service Bus Kafka
  • RabbitMQ Monitoring & logging
  • Data governance & security (Purview)
  • Cloud cost optimisation
  • Unit & integration testing Agile / Scrum

Leadership & ways of working

  • Technical leadership of the engineering function — mentoring, code review, and raising the standard of the two engineers on the team.
  • A clear communicator who can translate between business stakeholders, the analytics team, and engineering.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguity: you can set standards and architecture from a blank page and bring others along.

title: Service Delivery Coordinator
description:
BlueScope is an Australian-born global success story spanning 15 countries. Our team of over 16,500 people is our strength and we want our people to be safe, successful and well. We’re leaders and innovators in transforming steel into smart products and solutions that support society, today and in the future. We’re proud of brands, like COLORBOND ® steel that inspire and protect everything from hospitals to bridges and stadiums.

The Opportunity

BlueScope Distribution is looking for a Service Delivery Coordinator to join the BlueScope Distributions Gillman based in Wingfield. BlueScope Distribution is a single-source provider of product, processing and service solutions in steel and aluminium product. The business supports customers in a variety of industries and works with them to help deliver projects on time and to specification. BlueScope Distribution supports its customers by helping them find the freedom to do what they do best.

The Service Delivery Coordinator plays a key role in supporting service delivery outcomes, inventory coordination, and operational performance at the Wingfield site, which operates in close partnership with Gillman. The role works collaboratively with on-site teams to align activities with Distribution business priorities, ensuring a consistent and high standard of customer service.

Acting as a central point of coordination between Operations, Transport, Sales, and key stakeholders, the position focuses on facilitating clear communication, strengthening alignment, and supporting effective decision-making across multiple functions. The role contributes to the performance of despatch and inventory processes, while working alongside the on-site warehouse team to optimise outcomes and enhance overall operational efficiency.

What Will You Do?

With no two days the same, you will bring a hands-on approach and strong problem-solving skills to continuously support our Distributions operations. You will also:

  • build strong day-to-day working relationships by staying aware of stakeholder priorities and changes across Operations, Sales, and Transport partners
  • influence and communicate effectively with stakeholders, ensuring expectations are aligned and messages are tailored to support positive customer and operational outcomes
  • drive on-site operational performance at Wingfield by coordinating despatch, inventory activities, and service outcomes
  • coordinate daily inbound and outbound deliveries, including scheduling, receipting, load allocation, and manifesting
  • act as the key link between Sales, Operations, and Transport providers to ensure smooth and efficient service delivery
  • monitor daily performance (e.g. DIFOT, order fulfilment, inventory accuracy) and address any gaps or delays as they arise
  • work closely with the warehouse team to maintain accurate inventory, resolve stock issues, and support cycle counts
  • manage and resolve service issues and escalations, working proactively to ensure positive customer outcomes

More About You

You are a self-motivated individual with strong technical capability and a passion for learning. You will also have:

  • strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence, build relationships, and communicate effectively across multiple teams
  • demonstrated experience using SAP and/or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) for inventory control and operational processes
  • proven experience in a despatch, logistics, or distribution coordination role within a fast-paced operational environment
  • high level of resilience and ability to operate effectively in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment
  • strong customer focus, with a commitment to delivering service excellence and achieving positive customer outcomes
  • solid understanding of distribution operations, including planning, scheduling, and material movement

Why BlueScope​

As we’re creating strength for the future through our people, products and solutions, BlueScope supports you to build your expertise within a safe and positive team environment. At BlueScope, you’ll:​

  • Learn and develop as you grow. Work alongside specialists and keep your skills and knowledge at the forefront of industry with our lifelong learning culture.​
  • Experience connection and care. Experience a positive, inclusive work environment where we look out for each other’s safety and wellbeing.​
  • Build innovative products. Seek better, smarter ways to work, help develop sustainable solutions and make things happen.​
  • Deliver work that matters. Every action you take matters in delivering for our customers and strengthening communities for the future. We value what you do. ​

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels respected and valued to be their authentic selves, and we encourage Women and First Nations people to apply. We’re passionate about driving sustainability outcomes that matter to our communities, including action on climate and our 2050 net zero goal.​ At BlueScope, we offer work-life flexibility through our B-flex program.

It’s an exciting time in our history as, together, we work towards Our Purpose: “We create and inspire smart solutions in steel, to strengthen communities for the future.” ​

Come and discover us at www.bluescope.com/auscareers​

Join us, creating strength for the future.

description:
Jaffer Business Systems (JBS), founded in 1982 as a division of Jaffer Brothers, has been at the forefront of technology solutions for over four decades. Today, JBS is one of Pakistan’s leading IT companies, empowering organizations through innovation, digital transformation, and people-centric technology. Role Overview

Experience: 1–3 years

Employment Type: Contract

Focus: Data Engineering, Snowflake, Full-Stack / AI-ML

We are looking for a hands-on Data Engineer with mandatory professional experience in Snowflake and 1–3 years of overall engineering experience. The ideal candidate may come from either a Full-Stack Development or AI/ML Engineering background and should have strong foundational knowledge of databases, data workflows, and programming.

The Data Engineer will be responsible for designing, building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable data workflows, pipelines, models, and architecture centered around Snowflake. The role will involve collaborating with engineering and product teams to ingest, transform, and serve data effectively, while ensuring query performance, cost efficiency, data quality, and reliability.

This is a hands-on contract role requiring the ability to quickly understand existing systems, contribute independently, and deliver solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Location

Onsite

Business Unit / Department

Mode

Onsite 7PM-3AM

Type

Contract – 3 Months

Job Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data models, tables, views, and data pipelines using Snowflake.
  • Develop and optimize robust data workflows to support business, application, and machine learning requirements.
  • Leverage strong Snowflake expertise to manage and organize data for efficient storage, processing, and consumption.
  • Bridge application development or machine learning workflows with data infrastructure and engineering solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to effectively ingest, transform, process, and serve data.
  • Develop and maintain reliable data pipelines for structured and unstructured data workflows.
  • Monitor and optimize Snowflake query performance, compute utilization, and data storage costs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data architecture, pipeline efficiency, and overall system performance.
  • Support data workflows related to Full-Stack applications, AI/ML models, feature engineering, and model data requirements.
  • Troubleshoot data pipeline, query, integration, and performance-related issues.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ensure data pipelines and workflows are reliable, scalable, and maintainable.
  • Support the implementation of modern development and deployment practices, including CI/CD workflows.
  • Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP as required.
  • Contribute to technical documentation related to data pipelines, architecture, workflows, and processes.
  • Quickly understand existing systems and contribute effectively within a fast-paced contract environment.
  • Participate in testing, debugging, optimization, and deployment of data engineering solutions.

Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake is mandatory.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and relational database concepts.
  • Good understanding of data engineering concepts, including data pipelines, data transformation, data modeling, and data workflows.
  • Strong foundational experience in either:
    • Full-Stack Development, with strong backend and database integration skills; or
    • AI/ML Engineering, with experience in feature engineering, data pipelines, and supporting machine learning data workflows.
  • Experience designing and optimizing Snowflake tables, views, queries, and data pipelines.
  • Understanding of Snowflake performance optimization and compute/storage cost management.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices and software development workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and quickly adapt to existing technical environments.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, delivery-focused contract environment.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of professional hands-on engineering experience.
  • Proven professional experience working directly with Snowflake is mandatory.
  • Practical experience developing and maintaining data workflows, pipelines, or data infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with SQL and programming languages such as Python.
  • Professional background in either Full-Stack Development or AI/ML Engineering.
  • Experience with database integration, data pipelines, feature engineering, or model data workflows.
  • Familiarity with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Exposure to CI/CD and modern software development practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot technical issues and deliver solutions independently.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced engineering environment is preferred.

company: Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT
description:
THE ORGANIZATION
The Alliance of Bioversity International () and the International Center for Tropical Agriculture (CIAT) () delivers research-based solutions that harness agricultural biodiversity and sustainably transform food systems to improve people’s lives. Alliance solutions address the global crises of malnutrition, climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental degradation.
With novel partnerships, the Alliance generates evidence and mainstreams innovations to transform food systems and landscapes so that they sustain the planet, drive prosperity, and nourish people in a climate crisis.
The Alliance is part of CGIAR, a global research partnership for a food-secure future.

Background:
The Alliance of Bioversity International and CIAT leads cutting-edge initiatives leveraging computer vision for plant phenotyping. The objective is to design, validate, and deploy robust computer vision phenotyping systems capable of operating seamlessly across mobile phones, uncrewed aerial vehicles (drones), and rovers within breeding centers across the CGIAR network. By harnessing artificial intelligence and advanced digital phenotyping, we aim to modernize conventional breeding approaches and accelerate the development of high-yielding, climate-adapted seed varieties of staple food crops.

About the positions:
The consultants will support end-to-end MLOps workflows spanning data ingestion, validation, dataset versioning, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement across both cloud and edge environments. The roles will involve close collaboration with research machine learning, software engineering, product, and field teams to ensure systems are robust, maintainable, and aligned with project needs.
The consultants will also support the integration of ML systems within the ONA platform, a dedicated web- and smartphone-based platform for computer vision phenotyping, including deployment workflows connecting mobile applications, cloud infrastructure, visual data pipelines, disease detection and severity scoring workflows, backend services, and FAIRGrounds-integrated systems. In addition, the roles will contribute to strengthening best practices around experiment tracking, model governance, CI/CD workflows, deployment automation, and ML system monitoring across ONA infrastructure.
These are 11-month full-time consultancy positions (with potential for extension) based at the Alliance office in Arusha, Tanzania or Nairobi, Kenya.

Key Activities and Specific Terms of Reference
Computer Vision Systems Development and Optimization
• Support the development, fine-tuning, and optimization of robust, high-accuracy computer vision models for crop phenotyping across diverse field conditions.
• Develop and maintain automated workflows for image data preprocessing, quality assurance, feature engineering, and annotation curation.
• Conduct systematic hyperparameter tuning, model validation experiments, and benchmarking against baseline datasets.
• Support the containerization and optimization of inference workflows for low-connectivity, edge, and resource-constrained environments (e.g., mobile devices, edge compute).
• Monitor production model performance, latency, throughput, and data/concept drift under variable field lighting and environmental conditions.
Machine Learning Pipeline Development and Maintenance
• Develop, automate, and maintain scalable end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, training, validation, and deployment.
• Support the implementation of CI/CD pipelines to streamline automated model updates, testing, and deployment.
• Establish and maintain best practices for version control of datasets, code, and model artifacts to guarantee full reproducibility.
• Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, and product teams to integrate ML models into operational production applications.
Disease Detection and Severity Scoring
• Support development and deployment of AI workflows for disease detection and severity scoring using field images and visual data.
• Implement data and evaluation pipelines for disease annotation, validation, benchmarking, and continuous model improvement.
• Support integration of disease scoring workflows within the ONA platform for field-based data collection and analysis.
MLOps Infrastructure and ONA Integration
• Develop CI/CD pipelines for model training, evaluation, and deployment.
• Manage experiment tracking, model registries, and dataset versioning workflows.
• Implement monitoring and logging across ML services.
• Support deployment of ML services on GCP, AWS, and related cloud/edge infrastructure.
• Support integration of ML services within the ONA platform across mobile, backend, API, and cloud systems.
• Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and responsible AI requirements.

Deliverables and Payment Schedule:
• Deliverable 1: Inception Report and Technical Workplan (Month 1, ~Week 4)
Develop an inception report outlining the technical approach, deployment priorities, infrastructure requirements, integration roadmap, and detailed 11-month workplan for MLOps, computer vision, and disease-scoring workflows across the ONA platform.
Honoraria for Deliverable 1: 12,000,000 Tanzanian Shillings / 589,762 Kenyan Shillings

• Deliverable 2: Implementation of Ingestion, Annotation Selection, Model Development, and Evaluation Pipelines (Month 5, ~Week 20)
Implement operational workflows and data pipelines focusing on data ingestion, annotation selection, model training, benchmarking, and evaluation across cloud and edge environments, building on established core MLOps infrastructure.
Honoraria for Deliverable 2: 18,000,000 Tanzanian Shillings / 884,642 Kenyan Shillings

• Deliverable 3: ONA AI Pipeline Integration, Breeding Team Support, and Trait Model Deployment (Month 8, ~Week 32)
Deliver integrated deployment workflows connecting ML/CV services with ONA mobile applications, APIs, backend systems, and FAIRGrounds-integrated infrastructure. Assist breeding teams with advanced ML/CV tasks, operationalizing and deploying trait extraction models into production alongside monitoring and evaluation documentation.
Honoraria for Deliverable 3: 38,000,000 Tanzanian Shillings / 1,867,579 Kenyan Shillings

• Deliverable 4: Final Technical Report and Handover Package (Month 11, end of assignment)
Submit a final technical report summarizing completed workflows, deployed infrastructure, model performance across targets, key learnings, and recommendations for future scaling and maintenance. Deliver finalized documentation, deployment guides, pipeline configurations, and knowledge-transfer materials for internal teams.
Honoraria for Deliverable 4: 22,000,000 Tanzanian Shillings / 1,081,230 Kenyan Shillings

Requirements

Education:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Technical Competencies:
• Experience building and managing ML workflows, including model training, deployment, monitoring, and versioning.
• Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
• Experience working with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
• Experience with computer vision, image-based AI workflows, or multimodal AI applications.
• Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration tools.
• Ability to work collaboratively across technical, product, and field teams.
• Strong communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
• Background or experience in agriculture, digital agriculture, or international research environments will be an added advantage.

Benefits

Terms of employment
These are nationally recruited positions based in either Kenya or Tanzania. The initial contract will be for up to 11 Months, with the total estimated consultancy amount of 90,000,000 Tanzanian Shillings or 4,423,212 Kenyan Shillings.

Applications
Applicants are invited to visit to get full details of the position and to submit their applications. Applications MUST include reference number Ref: MACHINE LEARNING AND OPERATIONS CONSULTANCY (COMPUTER VISION) as the position applied for. Application including CV, technical proposal and financial proposal should be saved as one document using the candidate’s last name, first name for ease of sorting.

Note: The Alliance does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process (application, interview meeting, processing or training). The Alliance also does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

title: Environmental Program Manager II
description:
Job Title: Environmental Program Manager II
Location: Overland Park, KS with local hybrid or remote options available


Description/Job Summary

POSITION DESCRIPTION

The Environmental Program Manager II is responsible for leading and managing the company’s Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) contracts within EPA CLIN 2, Regions 4, 5, 6, and 7. The ideal candidate must ensure all projects are executed in alignment with client expectations, contractual requirements, and company objectives. This role oversees EPA-related projects and project teams within the regions, and provides strategic leadership, supports business development efforts within the EPA portfolio, and serves as a primary point of contact for client engagement. The Program Manager II also plays a key role in mentoring and developing staff, including program and project managers, to ensure consistent and successful project delivery.


The Program Manager II has the potential to work in-office, hybrid, or possibly remotely with occasional travel to project sites and HGL offices. If a candidate resides within commuting distance of an HGL office and would like to work in the office, that option is also available. Preference is for candidates who reside within the EPA CLIN2 areas.

Responsibilities/Duties

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Program and Staff Management:

  • Support the EPA program and direct all EPA-related contracts and CLIN (Contract Line-Item Number) project managers within the regions.
  • Manage and support a team of staff, including formal employee mentorship to provide guidance and professional development.
  • Communicate and connect with various departments (proposal development, contracts, chemistry, data management, etc.) to ensure that they are properly coordinating and functioning to support the regions.


Project Oversight and Delivery:

  • Ensure EPA projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with project scope of work and contract requirements and client expectations.
  • Conduct routine meetings with project managers to monitor project progress, review deliverables, and provide strategic direction.
  • Guide and enforce company best practices for consistent EPA project execution across teams.
  • Address and resolve project issues and challenges, including navigating complex client and team dynamics.
  • Serve as a Senior Project Manager.
  • Uphold contract and company required QA/QC and Health and Safety standards.


Client and Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Serve as the liaison with EPA clients, fostering strong relationships to ensure satisfaction and repeat business.
  • Coordinate with external stakeholders for scope and cost sensitive items including EPA clients and state and local agencies as needed for specific projects.
  • Respond to client inquiries and proactively address client needs to maintain high levels of satisfaction.


Proposal and Business Development:

  • Organize and lead proposal efforts for EPA-related opportunities, working closely with technical teams, HGL leadership, and teaming partners to submit high-quality and competitive proposals.
  • Assist in growing the company’s EPA portfolio, identifying new opportunities, and contributing to long-term client engagement strategies.
  • Evaluate potential project opportunities for profitability and alignment with company goals.
  • Support planning for and attendance of client sponsored Industry Day events and other conferences.


Process Improvement and Standardization:

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of internal guidelines and processes for program and project management to ensure consistency across teams.
  • Mentor project managers on best practices and standardized approaches to ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Utilize approved digital and AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to support technical documentation, data analysis, project communications, and workflow efficiency.

Minimum Requirements

WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

  • Bachelor’s degree in Science, Environmental Science, Engineering, or related field required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience managing large government contracts and multi-disciplinary teams, preferably in the environmental or engineering sectors.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Microsoft Project for project scheduling and management.
  • Must have either a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Professional Geologist (PG) certification, or Professional Engineer (PE) certification.
  • Strong leadership and people management abilities, including mentoring and coaching staff.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, to interact effectively with clients, team members, and executives.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills with the ability to manage complex situations and personalities.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture while focusing on project details.
  • Prior experience managing EPA clients and working with state and local agencies in EPA CLIN2.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and adopt new technologies and digital tools to improve project delivery and operational efficiency.


Desired Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO STAND OUT – Preferred, not required

  • Project Management Processional (PMP) certification a strong plus.
  • Experience using Ganttic or other resource management tools is a plus.
  • Microsoft suite of software, including but not limited to Microsoft Project.
  • Experience using generative AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to improve technical writing, data analysis, research, visualization, or project delivery efficiency.


Physical & Environmental Requirements

PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE REQUIRMENTS

  • Prolonged sitting up to 70% of the time, repetitive hand motions (typing, tool use, etc.), ability to see details at close range, viewing computer screen for extended periods, ability to interpret and analyze visual data (maps, graphs, warning indicators, etc.), and driving a company or personal vehicle.
  • Analyzing and synthesizing data, complex problem solving and decision making, reading and interpreting technical documents or regulations, writing reports, proposals, or technical documentation, leading a team or coordinating multiple priorities, communicating effectively with clients, team members, and stakeholders, and managing competing deadlines and shifting priorities.

WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be able to travel up to 10% per year, must wear appropriate PPE, and office work environment.

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

Details

Work Schedule: HGL office work is dictated by a 5-day work week; however, travel and fieldwork schedules will deviate based on job requirements and may require longer hours and weekends.

Office Type: In-office preferred, with options for hybrid schedules available. Fully remote work will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

Travel: 10%

A favorable pre-hire drug test is required.


All positions are subject to a pre-hire education and driving record verification.

MORE ABOUT HGL AND THE OPPORTUNITY


At HGL, we share a drive and vision to restore natural resources and provide ongoing stewardship of our environment to benefit present and future generations. We believe that we can make a difference in improving the world we live in through collaboration, teamwork, and a positive work environment. This unites and empowers us to strive for excellence in all our endeavors.


HGL - WHO WE ARE


The exceptional quality of our people is key to our strength. We value our employees as individuals and as important members of our team. We offer a work environment that is flexible, inclusive, and dedicated to creating a sustainable future. By cultivating a culture of innovation, we’re able to adapt and augment our services to solve complex environmental and natural resources challenges.


Projects at HGL primarily span the United States and its territories, tackling problems associated with emerging contaminants (like PFAS), radiological contamination, and military munitions, along with chemical contamination in groundwater, surface water, sediments, and soil.


With over 550 employees, HGL is large enough to execute high-profile projects, but small enough to develop personal working environments with our talented team members. By joining HGL, you will be working toward restoring the environment and protecting our future.

HGL - WE INVEST IN YOU


It’s not just a job, it’s your career. HGL provides career growth opportunities via mentoring, training, education, and support for your certifications and licenses. Achieve your career goals and help HGL achieve its mission of restoring the environment to beneficial use for our clients and communities.


We are an Equal Opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected category. Some positions may require U.S. citizenship. Applicants who wish to request a reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process should contact Human Resources directly at 703-478-5186.


EEO notices: US Equal Opportunity Employment Poster, US Equal Opportunity Supplemental Poster, Know Your Rights, and Pay Transparency Notice.


A full list of benefits is available at .


Digital & AI Proficiency: HGL encourages the responsible use of approved AI-enabled and digital technologies to improve productivity, technical quality, decision-making, and project delivery. Candidates who demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and experience leveraging emerging technologies are highly valued.


The annual salary for this position ranges from $121,620 - $194,592. This position's final salary can be impacted by various factors including, but not limited to, contractual requirements, geographic location, job-related education, training, experience, and skills. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

title: Journeyman - Plumbing
description:
About GEMCO

Founded in July 2014 and headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, GEMCO Constructors is a national mechanical, electrical, plumbing, building automation systems, and service contractor. We provide comprehensive design and build solutions for customers across the United States and hold engineering and construction registrations, licenses, and certifications in more than 30 states. With coast-to-coast operations, GEMCO delivers safe, efficient, and innovative solutions across diverse markets.

Position Summary

The Journeyman - Plumbing is responsible for the installation, maintenance, repair, and testing of commercial plumbing systems on new construction, renovation, and tenant improvement projects throughout the United States. This position requires extensive knowledge of piping systems, drainage systems, plumbing fixtures, and plumbing codes. Working under the direction of Trade Managers, Foremen, and Project Management teams, the Journeyman Plumber performs skilled trade work with a high degree of independence while supporting project schedules, quality standards, and safety requirements. This position also provides guidance and mentorship to apprentices and less experienced team members.

This position requires travel throughout the United States. Typical travel rotation is approximately 17 days in the field followed by 4 days at home.

Primary Responsibilities and Duties

  1. Install, assemble, maintain, and repair commercial plumbing systems, piping networks, fixtures, and equipment.
  2. Perform plumbing installations for new construction, renovation, and retrofit projects in accordance with project specifications and applicable codes.
  3. Install water distribution systems, sanitary waste systems, venting systems, storm drainage systems, and specialty piping systems.
  4. Diagnose plumbing issues and perform repairs efficiently to maintain project schedules and system functionality.
  5. Locate and repair water line leaks, drainage issues, and other piping system deficiencies.
  6. Install and connect plumbing fixtures, water heaters, pumps, interceptors, sinks, toilets, and related equipment.
  7. Perform testing, inspections, and system verification to ensure proper operation and code compliance.
  8. Read and interpret blueprints, plumbing drawings, specifications, shop drawings, and construction documents.
  9. Coordinate plumbing work with Foremen, Superintendents, Project Managers, subcontractors, and other trades.
  10. Ensure all work complies with federal, state, and local plumbing codes, regulations, and safety requirements.
  11. Assist with material planning, inventory management, and jobsite logistics to support project efficiency.
  12. Maintain accurate records of completed work, inspections, testing activities, and material usage.
  13. Mentor apprentices and helpers by providing training, technical guidance, and support in the field.
  14. Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in a safe, clean, and organized condition.
  15. Participate in safety meetings, toolbox talks, and company training programs.
  16. Promote and adhere to all company safety policies, procedures, and quality standards.
  17. Support project startup, commissioning, punch list completion, and project closeout activities.
  18. Perform other related duties as assigned to support plumbing and construction operations.

Traits and Competencies

  1. Extensive knowledge of commercial plumbing systems, piping methods, drainage systems, venting systems, and plumbing equipment.
  2. Strong understanding of all phases of commercial construction and coordination with multiple building trades.
  3. Familiarity with mechanical, electrical, and structural systems as they relate to plumbing installations.
  4. Skilled in the safe use of plumbing tools, equipment, machines, and materials.
  5. Ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical drawings, specifications, and project documents.
  6. Strong understanding of plumbing codes, regulations, industry standards, and safety requirements.
  7. Proven ability to troubleshoot plumbing systems and identify practical solutions to field challenges.
  8. Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet project deadlines.
  9. Ability to mentor, train, and lead apprentices and less experienced personnel.
  10. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, coworkers, and project teams.
  11. Knowledge of material management, labor productivity, and construction efficiency best practices.
  12. Dependable, self-motivated, and accountable for delivering quality workmanship.
  13. Resourceful and adaptable in fast-paced and changing construction environments.
  14. Strong commitment to safety, quality, and customer satisfaction.
  15. Willingness and ability to travel extensively throughout the United States.
  16. Demonstrates professionalism, integrity, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

title: Contractor In Charge (CIC)
description:
National Railroad Safety Services, Inc. is seeking dedicated, safety-driven individuals for the Contractor in Charge position in Abilene, TX. This essential role is responsible for ensuring all work within railroad rights-of-way is performed safely and in compliance with regulations.

Job Description: National Railroad Safety Services, Inc. (NRSS) is seeking a Contractor in Charge (CIC) responsible for overseeing construction, maintenance, and safety compliance for freight railroads, transit systems, state DOTs, and rail industry partners.

Job Requirements:

  • Strong computer, communication, and organizational skills
  • Communicates effectively in both verbal and written formats
  • Ability for long-term travel assignments, including multi-month deployments.
  • Valid Driver's License
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in a railroad company preferably in the maintenance of way or TY&E departments
  • Successfully completes all required federal, client, and company-specific training.

Job Duties:

  • A safety-focused railroad- approved contractor responsible for overseeing worksite safety and providing flagging services as needed in place of railroad personnel
  • The CIC is responsible for conducting job briefings and ensuring full compliance with Federal Railroad (FRA) regulations (49 CFR 214) during work performed within arm's length of the track.
  • Responsible for monitoring track conditions, approaching trains, and work activities to ensure personnel remain safely clear of active tracks and equipment.
  • Communicate with train dispatchers, engineers, and supervisors via radio, phone, or electronic systems to coordinate train movements and grant permissions within established working limits.
  • Responsible for documenting all activities, including job briefings, incident reports, daily work logs, and electronic forms for submission to management and regulatory agencies.

Work Environment:

  • This job operates in a field environment.

  • Ability to work in all weather conditions

Benefits:

  • Compensation is $28 to $37 per hour based on experience
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
  • Short-Term, Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Paid Vacation and Holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan

NRSS is the most trusted name in the railroad industry for providing qualified field safety staff and safety training. title: Scientist / Engineer - Process Chemistry (Life Cycle Assessment
description:
Scientist / Engineer 1 - Process Chemistry (Life Cycle Assessment)
Salary: £26,939 - £34,939 per annum (dependent on experience)
Employment Type: 12 Month Fixed Term Contract (Maternity Cover)
Location: Sedgefield

About CPI


At CPI, we bring together world-class science, technology and engineering to accelerate the development and commercialisation of innovative products and processes. As part of the High Value Manufacturing Catapult, we work with industry, academia and government to solve complex challenges and help create a more sustainable future.
Our Process Chemistry team supports the development of sustainable technologies through environmental assessment, process understanding and innovation. We are now looking for a Scientist / Engineer to join our Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) delivery team, supporting projects across a diverse range of products, materials, processes and emerging technologies.

About the Role


This is an exciting opportunity for someone with experience of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) to apply their knowledge in a fast-paced research and innovation environment.


You'll be responsible for delivering LCA studies that help our customers and project teams make informed sustainability decisions. Working closely with scientists, engineers and industry partners, you'll develop environmental models, analyse complex datasets and communicate findings that influence the direction of technology development.
The role is predominantly desk-based and would suit someone who enjoys analytical thinking, working with data and translating technical information into meaningful insights. We are open to candidates from a range of backgrounds, including those who have gained significant LCA experience through PhD research, academia or industry.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Conducting Life Cycle Assessments for products, materials, processes and technologies.
  • Defining project goals, scope, system boundaries, assumptions and assessment methodologies.
  • Developing and managing life cycle inventory datasets.
  • Building and maintaining LCA models using recognised software platforms.
  • Collecting and validating data from technical teams, clients, literature and databases.
  • Interpreting results and identifying key environmental hotspots and improvement opportunities.
  • Producing high-quality technical reports and presentations.

title: Digital Creative Strategist
description:
About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape how digital creative is developed during a period of significant growth and investment across ATL and digital channels.

The successful candidate will sit at the intersection of paid media, creative production, commercial performance, and brand strategy, using audience insight, platform knowledge, and performance data to create more effective digital campaigns across multiple international markets.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands performance marketing, can brief like a creative strategist, and knows how to turn data into stronger concepts, sharper messaging, and measurable commercial impact.

Key Responsibilities

Performance-led creative strategy

  • Own the creative testing and messaging roadmap across paid digital Brand, Acquisition and Retention channels, spanning up to 13 international markets.
  • Turn cross-channel performance data (across brand/acquisition and retention campaigns and working in-conjunction with channel managers/creative team) into clear creative direction, defining the audiences angles, hooks, formats and messaging to test each cycle across paid social, online video, paid search and display (mobile and desktop).
  • Understand how creative acts as an important delivery and audience-discovery signal on platforms such as Meta and TikTok, and how format, hook and pacing can directly influence commercial performance.
  • Develop structured test plans with clear hypotheses, success measures and learning agendas, ensuring creative decisions are led by evidence rather than opinion.
  • Build and evolve creative-performance reporting, analysing results by format, hook, audience, message and platform to establish clear priorities for future production.
  • Prioritise creative production based on commercial opportunity, ensuring the highest-impact concepts are developed first.

Creative development

  • Lead brainstorms that create genuinely new creative territory, rather than variations of existing work.
  • Translate the insights and ideas into clear, actionable briefs, setting out the audience, angle, format, hook, CTA, and strategic rationale.
  • Apply current platform best practice across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube, Display and Paid Search, including vertical video, sound-on creative, creator-led content, UGC and platform-native storytelling.
  • Ensure creative is adapted appropriately for mobile and desktop environments, platform behaviours and local market needs.
  • Use AI tools where appropriate to accelerate ideation, research, briefing and production workflows, while maintaining high creative standards

Working with Creative, Brand & Channel Teams

  • Partner directly with our designers, editors and producers to open up space for platform native content, understanding why a traditional creative process defaults to familiar, safer output
  • Build trusted, constructive relationships across Creative, Brand and Performance teams—challenging familiar approaches where needed and using evidence to build alignment.
  • Coach and upskill colleagues through regular sharing of platform developments, creative best practice, testing results and market trends.
  • Work closely with Channel Leads and the Digital Marketing Director to ensure testing is executed accurately, on time and translated into future media and creative decisions.
  • Partner with Brand and Marcomms teams to ensure messaging is relevant and consistent across the customer lifecycle, digital activity and ATL campaigns.
  • Lead regular creative review sessions, ensuring platform updates and performance learnings result in clear actions and improved creative output.

Brand and commercial context

  • Use digital creative to build genuine relevance, trust and preference for the brand in a highly competitive market rather than chasing short term performance metrics alone
  • Bring a clear point of view on how the brand can differentiate in a crowded and highly competitive market.
  • Develop creative that works within regulatory requirements and platform advertising policies, while remaining distinctive, effective and appropriate for each market.?
Requirements
  • 5+ years’ experience in creative strategy, performance creative, paid social, digital marketing, or a related discipline
  • Proven ability to make creative more digital-first and commercially effective
  • Strong experience across paid social, especially Meta, TikTok, and Snapchat
  • Experience with online video, YouTube, display, paid search, and cross-channel digital performance
  • Strong understanding of platform-native creative, vertical formats, opening hooks, UGC, creator-led content, and sound-on storytelling
  • Experience building and running structured creative testing frameworks
  • Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into strong creative briefs
  • Excellent briefing, facilitation, and brainstorming skills

title: Graduate Program | SR&T | Risk Data & Analytics
description:

What will your typical day look like?

Experience the dynamic environment of the R&R Data team, where you tackle unique challenges daily, guiding clients through complex business issues with data-driven solutions and crafting multi-layered data strategies. At Deloitte, you have all the support you need from your colleagues and broader team including access to a global network of risk and compliance management professionals.

Your days will involve:

As well as learning in the flow of work, you'll also be part of our firm-wide Graduate Program. title: Digital Platform Proposition Architect - M&G plc.
description:
At M&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

The Role: Platform Proposition Architect

Background

M&G Life is making important choices about how Sonata and other strategic platforms will support its future digital propositions for customers and advisers. We are looking for someone with the platform knowledge and commercial judgement to bring a clear, forward-looking view to those decisions, ensuring platform choices support our ambitions for digital experience and growth.

As part of a small Digital Architecture team, you will help develop how we approach platform decisions across M&G Life. The work reaches across propositions, with direct exposure to important choices before they become difficult or costly to change.

You will be joining a team that brings architecture, proposition, product, and design together around the digital experience. The role gives you scope to build a well-informed point of view, test it with experienced colleagues, and see it influence real proposition and platform decisions. For someone who enjoys making sense of difficult choices, learning across disciplines and helping others reach better decisions, it offers unusual breadth and the chance to establish a distinctive area of expertise.

Role Summary

As a Digital Platform Proposition Architect, you will bring platform expertise into the development of our digital propositions from the outset. Working across proposition, experience, operating model and technology, you will develop a clear view of where and how our core platforms should be used, what they can enable, and the choices needed to create propositions that can operate and scale effectively.

Sonata will be your immediate focus. You will advise on questions such as which needs should be met within the platform or elsewhere, what can be reused across propositions and when M&G should adopt standard platform capability rather than customise. Over time, the role will extend across other strategic platforms and the wider digital ecosystem.

You will work with colleagues across proposition, product, design and technology, as well as our platform partners, using your knowledge and judgement to provide informed recommendations, challenge constructively and influence direction.
You may have built this experience in platform or proposition consultancy, solution design, proposition or product strategy, a platform provider, systems integrator or a strategic business analysis role. Your current title matters less than your ability to understand how platforms enable a business, make sense of complex choices and communicate confidently across business and technology. This is a business-led role requiring strong platform and technology fluency, suited to someone who enjoys moving between strategic questions and the practical detail needed to make good decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and communicate a forward-looking view of how Sonata and other core platforms should be used and how they should evolve across digital propositions, aligned to the wider Digital Experience strategy.
  • Work as part of digital proposition development from its earliest stages, helping proposition, experience, operating model and platform capability come together before delivery commitments are made.
  • Turn proposition and operating-model needs into clear choices about standard capability, configuration, customisation, integration and reuse.
  • Apply learning across programmes and identify where platform capability, integrations and proven approaches can be reused.
  • Provide informed recommendations and constructive challenge at investment, design and governance decision points, influencing direction through evidence, expertise and judgement.
  • Develop a cross-platform view of how Sonata and other platforms work within the wider digital and data ecosystem, identifying the capabilities, dependencies and choices relevant to the future digital proposition strategy.
  • Use knowledge of the Sonata roadmap, market practice and M&G's future needs to influence platform choices and contribute to the strategic vendor relationship.

Core Competencies & Attributes
You will bring the following:
  • An understanding of how customer and adviser needs, proposition design, digital experience and platform capability combine to create a viable proposition.
  • The ability to structure ambiguous problems, weigh evidence and turn complexity into clear choices and recommendations.
  • Sound commercial judgement, balancing value, cost, reuse, risk and future flexibility.
  • Strong commercial, proposition and operating-model understanding, combined with the platform and technology fluency to challenge design, integration and vendor choices credibly.
  • The ability to influence across business, technology and vendors through judgement, evidence and constructive challenge rather than formal authority.
  • A view beyond an individual programme, identifying patterns, dependencies and opportunities across propositions.
  • An understanding of how regulatory and market change, including Consumer Duty, affects proposition and platform choices.

Experience & Knowledge
Essential:
  • Experience applying proposition and architecture thinking to connect business needs with platform capability, gained through platform or proposition consultancy, solution design, proposition or product strategy, or a related strategic role.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Sonata and how it is configured, integrated and used to support life and pensions propositions.
  • Experience shaping the use of a core or SaaS platform across products, propositions or services, rather than solving only for one delivery at a time.
  • A strong record of framing complex problems, assessing options and making pragmatic recommendations on standard capability, adaptation and reuse.Experience influencing decisions across

title: Head of Physical Lifecycle Engineering - Macquarie Group
description:
Be part of a new capability at Macquarie. Market Services is undertaking a greenfield rebuild of the post-trade lifecycle, re-architecting how trades are processed, validated, settled and reconciled across Commodities and Global Markets.

Lead a team that is redesigning the operating model and technology stack - replacing fragmented, manual processes with a digital-first, event-driven platform underpinned by deterministic controls and AI-native workflows.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you're empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play?

As the Post-trade Lifecycle Transformation Product Owner, you will own and define the Trade Lifecycle Operational Flow, setting the vision for a fully digital, event-driven post-trade environment. This includes the target-state architecture, product strategy, and roadmap to deliver scalable, deterministic outcomes from design through enterprise adoption.

You will lead a first-principles re-architecture of post-trade, replacing manual, fragmented, batch processes with structured lifecycle events, canonical data models, and automated controls. This is a true greenfield opportunity to design the future state.

Accountable for end-to-end lifecycle outcomes, you will partner with trading, operations, and technology to eliminate manual touchpoints and enable real-time, straight-through processing with full transparency and control.

You will embed AI as a core capability, enabling automated decision making, intelligent routing, and proactive exception management. Leading cross-functional teams in an ambiguous environment, you will drive rapid execution while maintaining strategic clarity, building scalable, reusable platforms with long-term commercial value.

What you offer

  • Exceptional product thinker in engineering-led environments, shaping what gets built and why, with a first-principles mindset focused on reimagining processes rather than incrementally improving them.
  • Proven experience creating workflow systems, operational platforms, or trade lifecycle technology from the ground up, with a focus on eliminating manual processes.
  • Hands-on experience building with AI agents, Large Language Model (LLM) powered workflows, and agentic systems-leveraging AI as a force multiplier and leading teams to do the same.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, greenfield environments with high stakes, demonstrating the ability to lead cross-functional teams (engineering, operations, data) and consistently deliver working products.
  • Commercially driven with an eye for cost, scale, and building products; ideally brings experience or familiarity with post-trade operations, capital markets, event-driven architectures, and trade lifecycle systems.
  • Someone who challenges conventions, prioritises transformation over incremental change, and relentlessly pursues better ways of working.
We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

Technology enables every aspect of Macquarie, for our people, our customers and our communities. We're a global team that is passionate about accelerating the digital enterprise, connecting people and data, building platforms and applications and designing tomorrow's technology solutions.
