title: Healthcare Intake Specialist /QA Specialist
description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and professional Healthcare Quality Assurance & Onboarding Coordinator to support quality assurance, documentation compliance, and onboarding within a healthcare services environment.

The ideal candidate is organised, communicates confidently, and enjoys working with detailed processes that require accuracy and consistency. You’ll play an important role in ensuring that Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) submit accurate and complete session notes, follow the required documentation standards, and understand how to use the relevant software and systems.

While the primary focus will be quality assurance and onboarding, the role may also involve occasional HR and administrative support as needed. We’re looking for someone who is adaptable, takes initiative, and is comfortable stepping in to assist outside their core responsibilities when required.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Documentation

  • Review session notes and clinical documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
  • Monitor documentation submissions and follow up with RBTs to ensure outstanding or incorrect session notes are addressed promptly.
  • Identify missing information, inconsistencies, and recurring documentation issues, escalating concerns where necessary.
  • Maintain accurate records and trackers to monitor documentation quality, outstanding items, and compliance deadlines.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of quality assurance processes and procedures.

Onboarding & Software Training

  • Assist with onboarding new RBTs, ensuring they understand documentation requirements, internal processes, and relevant procedures.
  • Train new team members on how to navigate and use the relevant software and systems.
  • Provide guidance and ongoing support to RBTs who need assistance with documentation or system-related queries.
  • Follow up with new starters to ensure they are comfortable with the systems and are meeting the required standards.

Communication & Team Support

  • Communicate professionally with RBTs and internal team members regarding documentation requirements, outstanding tasks, and areas for improvement.
  • Provide clear instructions and constructive feedback to help maintain high standards of documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with relevant teams to resolve documentation issues and support smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Assist with occasional HR-related tasks and general administrative duties when needed.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in quality assurance, compliance, documentation review, onboarding, training, or a similar coordination role.
  • Experience in a healthcare environment is preferred, with healthcare quality assurance experience considered a strong advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and missing information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A professional, patient, and organised approach to following up with team members.
  • Comfortable with repetitive, detail-heavy tasks that require accuracy and consistency.
  • Confident using computer systems and learning new software platforms.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple follow-ups and deadlines.
  • Flexible and willing to assist with responsibilities outside the primary scope of the role when needed.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in getting the details right. They are comfortable reviewing documentation, following up on outstanding tasks, and ensuring processes are completed correctly rather than simply ticking boxes.

They communicate professionally, can confidently hold team members accountable for completing required documentation, and enjoy helping others learn new systems and processes.

Someone with experience in healthcare administration, clinical documentation, quality assurance, compliance, or training and onboarding would be well suited to this role.

What Success Looks Like

  • Session notes are submitted accurately, completely, and on time.
  • Documentation errors and outstanding submissions are followed up on consistently.
  • New RBTs are onboarded effectively and can confidently use the required software.
  • Quality assurance processes are followed consistently, with issues identified and escalated appropriately.
  • The wider team receives reliable support with documentation, onboarding, and occasional administrative or HR tasks.

title: Board Certified Behavior Analyst Opening for National Nonprofit!
description:
Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) - Herrin, IL

Salary Range: up to $85,000 annually (based on experience)


Commitment Bonus: $5,000-$10,000


We offer relocation assistance!


“The clinic setting, collaboration of BCBAs all in the same office, and going to grad school with one of the BCBAs that worked at Hope all initially attracted me to Hope. The clients, the families, the continued collaboration, and the support across clinicians has motivated me to stay and continue to make a difference in the clients'/families' lives. I feel very comfortable bringing questions, concerns, and ideas to my manager! She is always willing to help answer a question; if she doesn't know, she will find the answer one way or another! I am constantly brainstorming ideas, and my manager is always happy to hear about them and utilize them if they will make a positive impact across staff and the clinic.”


ABOUT THE HOPE AUTISM CLINIC:

Where client outcomes are paramount, the Autism Clinic, which is a division of the nationally recognized non-profit, Hope, provides the highest quality therapeutic services to their local communities. We are dedicated to the idea that every child and their families deserve the opportunity to thrive and reach their fullest potential.

Serving children, ages 2 – 8, The Autism Clinic offers applied behavior analytic services (ABA), parent and family guidance, and in some settings, speech therapy. Each child’s treatment plan and treatment goals are individualized to meet their unique needs and all professionals collaborate together for optimal client outcomes.

As a part of our passionate care team you will have a purpose – not just a job. You’ll grow your professional skills, collaborate with talented professionals, and help create brighter futures for the children and families we serve. Be part of something meaningful – join us and help kids and their families soar!


WHAT YOU WILL DO

BCBAs are responsible for the ethical and evidence-based delivery of behavior analytic services to an assigned subset of clients with autism spectrum disorder (ASD), and/or intellectual/developmental disabilities in accordance with all guidelines stipulated by the Behavior Analysis Certification Board (BACB). This also includes but is not limited to, case management responsibilities, staff training, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Provides clinical case management for assigned caseload, which includes, but is not limited to completing assessments, conceptualizing goals and the course of therapy, recommending therapy hours, creating treatment plans, reviewing data and other pertinent information to make treatment recommendations, and communicating with all relevant stakeholders.
  • Involves the entire family or caregivers in treatment such that treatment plans include training goals, parents/caregivers are frequently updated on progress, growth, or areas of continued focus; BCBA will provide parent/staff training each month, which can be in whatever setting is deemed most appropriate.
  • Completes all required documentation, thoroughly and accurately, within the required timelines; Converts all sessions in time reporting platform within 24 hours of completion.

title: Governance Executive - Macquarie Group
description:
Join our Legal and Governance team in London and contribute to the corporate governance arrangements supporting our businesses across EMEA and Americas. You will become part of a collaborative regional function, working closely with colleagues across Legal, Finance, Tax, Treasury, Risk Management and the wider business groups. Supporting a diverse portfolio of legal entities whilst working with boards, committees, corporate transactions and regulatory developments.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you're empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play?

You will provide corporate governance and company secretarial support to a portfolio of entities, primarily across EMEA. Acting as a day-to-day governance support across Macquarie, you will help boards, committees, directors and internal stakeholders navigate governance requirements effectively. This will include preparing for board and committee meetings, drafting standard resolutions, reviewing and preparing papers, taking minutes and tracking actions. You will also coordinate meeting logistics and formalities, including compiling and distributing materials through Diligent Board Books.

Beyond the meeting cycle, you will support corporate transactions such as restructures, dividends, incorporations and dissolutions. Coordinating governance compliance activities, maintaining accurate corporate records and entity data, and preparing relevant documentation to company registrars. You will monitor corporate governance and regulatory developments, consider their implications and translate them into clear actions for the business. There will also be opportunities to enhance governance processes through data, technology and automation, while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

What you offer

  • 3 years' + company secretarial or corporate governance experience, supporting entities across EMEA. With a UK Chartered Governance Institute qualification or progress towards one.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain governance requirements clearly, that allow you to confidently work with stakeholders of varying seniority.
  • Sound judgement and a practical approach to complex governance matters.
  • Ability to take ownership, prioritise and deliver accurately in a fast-paced environment.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and interest in data, technology, automation and AI.
  • Experience with entity management software, such as Diligent Entities.
We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.

What we offer

At Macquarie, you're empowered to shape a career that's rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
  • 1 wellbeing leave day per year and a minimum of 25 days of annual leave.
  • 26 weeks' paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks' paid leave for secondary caregivers
  • Paid fertility leave for those undergoing or supporting fertility treatment
  • 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
  • Access to a wide range of salary sacrificing options
  • Benefits and initiatives to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including, comprehensive medical and life insurance cover
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
  • Access to company funded emergency and backup dependent care services
  • Recognition and service awards
  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
  • Reimbursement for work from home equipment
About the Legal Governance Group

Our Legal and Governance Group is a global, dynamic and independent group of lawyers, governance professionals and technical specialists that protect and represent the interests of Macquarie, our businesses and our people. Our teams are at the forefront of Macquarie, undertaking cutting edge legal and governance work to support business outcomes.

Inclusion at Macquarie

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of their identity, including age, disability, neurodiversity, gender (including gender identity or expression), sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy, parental status, race (including ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, or socio-economic background.
We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

title: Veterinar i Veterinarski tehničar – prodajni savjetnik (m/ž)
description:
Voliš životinje, veterinarske si struke, a svoje znanje želiš koristiti na malo drugačiji način?

U ZOOCITY-u vjerujemo da kvalitetna briga i njega mogu napraviti veliku razliku u životu svakog ljubimca. Zato tražimo osobu koja će svojim znanjem pomoći vlasnicima da donesu što bolje odluke za svoje ljubimce.

Ako si doktor veterinarske medicine ili veterinarski tehničar, voliš rad s ljudima i životinjama te želiš svoje znanje pretvoriti u kvalitetno savjetovanje – možda si baš ti osoba koju tražimo!

Veterinar (dr. med. vet.) – prodajni savjetnik (m/ž)

i

Veterinarski tehničar – prodajni savjetnik (m/ž)

Na području cijele Hrvatske tražimo 200 izvršitelja

Zašto raditi s nama?

🐾 Ostaješ blizu struke, ali u drugačijem radnom okruženju
Svoje veterinarsko znanje koristit ćeš svakodnevno kroz savjetovanje vlasnika i pomoć pri odabiru hrane, proizvoda i opreme za njihove ljubimce.

🕐 Predvidljiv ritam rada
Rad je organiziran u dvije smjene, a raspored je unaprijed planiran, što ti omogućuje da svoje radno i slobodno vrijeme lakše organiziraš i planiraš.

🌿 Više ravnoteže između posla i privatnog života
Određeni vikendi dio su rasporeda, no znaš ih unaprijed, što ti omogućuje da svoje slobodne dane i privatne planove bezbrižno organiziraš na vrijeme.

🎉 Blagdani i praznici su vrijeme za odmor
Blagdane i državne praznike provodiš sa svojim najmilijima jer su kod nas ti dani neradni.

💳 Konkurentna primanja i sigurnost zaposlenja
Kod nas te očekuju konkurentna plaća, dodatci na plaću i mogućnost ostvarivanja bonusa, uz dodatne financijske pogodnosti tijekom godine. Želimo ti pružiti sigurnost i stabilnost te graditi dugoročan odnos kroz ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme.

🎓 Ulaganje u tvoje znanje i razvoj
Uz početno uhodavanje i podršku mentora, očekuju te edukacije koje će ti pomoći da dodatno razvijaš svoje znanje i vještine. Prepoznajemo tvoj potencijal i pružamo ti mogućnosti za daljnji profesionalni razvoj i napredovanje unutar kompanije.

🏃 Brinemo o tvom zdravlju i dobrobiti
Vjerujemo da je u zdravom tijelu zdrav duh, zato ti omogućujemo korištenje Multisport kartice i potičemo te da pronađeš aktivnosti koje ti odgovaraju.

👨‍👩‍👧 Obitelj nam je važna
Želimo našim roditeljima omogućiti da bezbrižno uživaju u važnim trenucima odrastanja svoje djece, zato osiguravamo pogodnosti povodom rođenja djeteta, poklone za djecu povodom sv. Nikole te slobodan dan za roditelje prvašića.
Nakon povratka s rodiljnog dopusta omogućujemo ti rad na pola radnog vremena tijekom prva dva tjedna, a pritom ostvaruješ punu plaću.

🏆 Preporuči nam nove kolege
Imaš prijatelja ili poznanika koji bi se odlično uklopio u naš tim? Naši zaposlenici mogu preporučiti buduće kolege, a za svaku uspješno realiziranu preporuku slijedi nagrada.

🎁 Cijenimo tvoj trud i godine koje ulažeš u nas
Uz blagdanske bonuse i jubilarne nagrade, posebno podržavamo i tvoju odluku o udomljavanju ljubimca kroz dodatne dane godišnjeg odmora.

🤝 Postani dio dobre ekipe
Ne prepuštamo te samom/oj sebi – uz tebe je tim koji dijeli ljubav prema životinjama i želi zajedno napraviti razliku. Uz svakodnevnu suradnju, njegujemo i zajedništvo kroz druženja i evente tijekom godine.


Što ćeš raditi?

  • koristiti svoje veterinarsko znanje kako bi ljubiteljima ljubimaca pomogao/la pri odabiru odgovarajućih proizvoda
  • izdavati bezreceptne veterinarske lijekove u veterinarskoj ljekarni
  • prezentirati artikle, ponude i promotivne akcije
  • brinuti o urednosti i popunjenosti polica i asortimana
  • pratiti potrebe kupaca i pružati im kvalitetno korisničko iskustvo
  • sudjelovati u edukacijama i kontinuirano širiti svoje znanje

Što očekujemo od tebe?

  • doktori veterinarske medicine: završen sveučilišni studij veterinarske medicine
  • veterinarski tehničari: završenu srednju školu veterinarskog usmjerenja i položen stručni ispit
  • ljubav prema životinjama i interes za njihovu dobrobit
  • dobre komunikacijske vještine
  • otvorenost prema radu s kupcima i prodaji
  • odgovornost, angažiranost i proaktivnost
  • spremnost na timski rad
  • želju za učenjem i usvajanjem novih znanja

Ako želiš svoje veterinarsko znanje koristiti na nov način, svakodnevno biti okružen/a ljudima i životinjama te pritom nastaviti učiti i razvijati se, voljeli bismo te upoznati.

title: Project Lead, Business Systems
description:
About The Energy Authority

The Energy Authority is a public power-owned, nonprofit corporation with offices in Jacksonville, Florida, and Bellevue (Seattle), Washington. TEA provides public power utilities with access to advanced resources and technology systems so they can respond competitively in the changing energy markets. Through partnership with TEA, utilities benefit from an experienced organization that is singularly focused on deriving the maximum value of their assets from the market.


Join Our Team as a Project Lead, Business Systems!

At The Energy Authority (TEA), our business moves fast. We operate at the intersection of energy markets, technology, clients, and innovation—and keeping all of those pieces moving together takes more than project management. It takes someone who can see the big picture, connect the dots, anticipate what’s coming next, and turn complexity into coordinated action.

We’re looking for a Project Lead, Business Systems to serve as a program-level integrator across TEA’s business systems, vendor partnerships, operational initiatives, and market-driven changes. This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the center of Client Services, Operations, IT, vendors, and leadership, helping ensure projects and system changes are aligned, sequenced, communicated, and delivered successfully.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, enjoys working across teams, and can confidently move a project from “What are we doing?” to “Here’s how we’re getting it done,” this could be the role for you.

What You’ll Do

Own the Big Picture

  • Serve as TEA’s program-level connector, maintaining visibility across vendor initiatives, system enhancements, operational changes, and strategic projects.

  • Coordinate project sequencing, dependencies, cross-team impacts, and release timing to keep TEA’s systems and operations moving cohesively.

  • Build and maintain project roadmaps and release calendars that align business priorities, vendor capacity, market requirements, and organizational needs.

  • Bring structure to project intake, scoping, estimation, resource planning, testing readiness, and release governance.

  • Establish consistent release-readiness practices, including documentation, change control, testing, and acceptance.

  • Identify operational risks and dependencies early and bring the right people together to address them before they become problems.

Lead Projects from Idea to Execution

  • Prioritize, coordinate, and deliver cross-functional projects through structured project governance.

  • Facilitate project meetings, workshops, working sessions, and stakeholder discussions.

  • Set clear expectations with project teams, vendors, leadership, and business stakeholders.

  • Coordinate resources and keep teams focused on milestones, deliverables, and outcomes.

  • Coach and motivate project team members and contractors through influence and collaboration.

  • Develop leadership updates, dashboards, risk assessments, project communications, and release updates.

  • Represent projects and releases at portfolio councils and leadership forums.

  • Evaluate dependencies, coordinate readiness, and support proactive risk management.

Connect TEA with Our Vendors & Energy Markets

  • Lead structured monthly vendor meetings focused on roadmaps, capacity, priorities, releases, and upcoming needs.

  • Translate vendor release information into clear, actionable guidance for TEA teams.

  • Help ensure vendor priorities and capabilities align with TEA’s strategic direction and operational requirements.

  • Monitor regulatory and market-driven changes and coordinate the operational and system impacts across teams.

  • Lead coordination of market-mandated changes, ensuring appropriate testing, readiness, and acceptance.

  • Keep TEA prepared for what’s coming next—not just reacting to what’s happening today.

Be the Connector

  • Serve as a trusted point of connection across Client Services, Operations, IT, vendors, and business leadership.

  • Provide clear, consistent visibility into project status, risks, dependencies, metrics, and release timing.

  • Build strong relationships across the organization and create alignment among teams with competing priorities.

  • Communicate complex information clearly and confidently with leaders and employees at all levels.

  • Help strengthen TEA’s culture of accountability, collaboration, and execution.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You’re organized without being rigid. You’re strategic but know how to get into the details when needed. You can walk into a room with multiple teams, competing priorities, and a complicated problem—and leave with everyone aligned on what happens next.

You bring:

  • A Bachelor’s degree; MBA preferred.

  • Experience leading cross-functional projects and coordinating organizational change.

  • Experience working with vendors and managing vendor relationships.

  • Strong project governance, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • The ability to influence without direct authority and bring people together around a common goal.

  • Experience navigating complex systems, operational processes, and competing priorities.

  • Experience with Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) systems preferred.

  • Knowledge of Allegro, PowerOptix, OATI, Microsoft 365, and SharePoint preferred.

  • Additional experience across multiple products or systems may qualify for senior-level opportunities.

Why TEA?

At TEA, you won’t be managing projects in a silo. You’ll have a front-row seat to how technology, energy markets, operations, and people come together to power our business.

This is an opportunity to make a visible impact—creating the structure that helps teams move faster, improving how we manage change, strengthening our systems, and helping TEA prepare for what’s next.

If you’re energized by complexity, passionate about getting things done, and naturally the person who connects the dots, we want to hear from you.

Come help us energize what’s next at TEA.


TEA Values

TEA employees share a common sense of purpose. When TEA accomplishes its mission, the result is improved quality of life for the citizens and businesses of the communities our clients serve.

TEA employees exceed the expectations of those they serve, deliver services with the highest standards of fair, honest, and ethical behavior, set the standard for service and expertise in our industry, embody a spirit of collaboration, and embrace TEA’s founding entrepreneurial spirit by seizing opportunities to deliver value.

If you are self-motivated, driven to deliver excellence, and passionate about your career, TEA is the perfect place for you.

It’s YOUR Future. It’s OUR Future.

description:
About Man Group

Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm focused on pursuing outperformance for sophisticated clients via our Systematic, Discretionary and Solutions offerings. We have developed policies and processes which are designed to provide for the security and integrity of your Personal Data. We are committed to Processing your Personal Data fairly and lawfully, and being open and transparent about such Processing. For further information on how we process your data, please see the privacy notice for applicants

* As at 30 June 2026

The Team

Man Group’s business is powered by sophisticated technology with AI accelerating the next generation of transformation. Our technology stack is built on modern open-source components, both enabling day-to-day research and development, and supporting our 24hr trading.

With adoption of AI-agents we are investing in security as a first-class concern. Man has a sophisticated AI platform – MAIA – that offers the best foundation models on our modern technology stack. As agents become more powerful, the security platform which supports safe agentic workflows is critical.

The Senior Security Engineer will build and run the components that put these principles into practice: a policy engine and APIs that allows applications, AI agents and users to authenticate. This infrastructure will support authorisation with scoped short-lived credentials. This is a hands-on engineering role, securing Man's applications and services.


Role Responsibilities

Platform Engineering

  • Design, build and operate security platform services and APIs such as policy decision, just-in-time access and short-lived credential issuance.
  • Write and maintain policy-as-code that is tested, version-controlled and deployed through GitOps.
  • Integrate the platform with identity providers (Entra/AD), secrets management (Vault) and existing internal infrastructure (Keycloak, Sailpoint).
  • Run services to production standards for reliability, performance and observability, including 2nd line on-call support.

Enablement and Detection

  • Provide Python APIs and onboard application teams and AI-agent developers to the platform, with documentation that make the secure path the easy one.
  • Build logging, metrics and alerting for platform services, and contribute SIEM detection rules.


Key Competencies

Required

  • Hands-on experience building and operating production services with Python.
  • Using Kubernetes, Linux and containerised environments, including networking fundamentals and performance troubleshooting.
  • Solid understanding of authentication, authorisation and secrets management (OIDC/OAuth, Azure AD/Entra ID, vault technologies).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Helm) and GitOps-based deployment.
  • Working knowledge of observability stacks (e.g., ELK, Prometheus, Grafana), including building dashboards and alerting rules.
  • Clear communication and a structured approach to reasoning about risk.

Desirable

  • Kubernetes knowledge beyond basic usage: network policies, pod security standards, admission controllers and resource quota enforcement.
  • Policy engines and workload identity (e.g., OPA/Rego, Kyverno, Cedar, OpenFGA, SPIFFE/SPIRE, Envoy/service mesh).
  • API design (REST/gRPC) for internal platform consumers.
  • Network security controls: WAFs, segmentation, TLS termination and egress filtering.

Your unique perspective will contribute to our success, joining a workplace where inclusion is fundamental and deeply embedded in our culture and values. Through our external and internal initiatives, partnerships and programmes, you'll find opportunities to grow, develop your talents, and help foster an inclusive environment for all across our firm and industry. title: HEAT TREAT/TOCCO
description:
About Company:

Our History

Since our humble beginning as a small blacksmith shop in 1882, Brunner & Lay has grown to include manufacturing plants and warehouses on three different continents. These include seven facilities in the United States, two in Canada, three in Great Britain, one in Germany, and two in Australia. We have played a role in the construction of some of the world’s most famous highways, dams, airfields, mines, quarries, and even national monuments.


American Made since 1882

About the Role:

The Heat Treat/Tocco Technician plays a critical role in the manufacturing process by ensuring that metal components undergo precise heat treatment procedures to achieve desired mechanical properties and performance standards. This position involves operating and monitoring heat treatment furnaces, including Tocco testing equipment, to verify material hardness and quality. The technician will collaborate closely with production and quality assurance teams to maintain process consistency and troubleshoot any deviations. Attention to detail and adherence to safety protocols are paramount to prevent defects and ensure compliance with industry standards. Ultimately, this role contributes directly to the reliability and durability of manufactured products, supporting overall operational excellence.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Experience in heat treatment operations within a manufacturing environment.
  • Basic understanding of metallurgical principles and heat treatment processes.
  • Familiarity with hardness testing methods, including Tocco testing.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documents, work instructions, and process specifications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in heat treatment or metallurgical testing.
  • Experience with computerized furnace control systems.
  • Knowledge of quality management systems such as ISO standards.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills related to heat treatment equipment.
  • Previous experience working in a safety-conscious manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate and maintain heat treatment furnaces and related equipment according to established procedures.
  • Perform Tocco hardness testing on treated materials to verify compliance with specifications.
  • Monitor process parameters such as temperature, time, and atmosphere to ensure consistent treatment quality.
  • Document process data and inspection results accurately for quality control and traceability.
  • Identify and report any equipment malfunctions or process irregularities promptly to minimize downtime.
  • Collaborate with engineering and quality teams to implement process improvements and corrective actions.
  • Adhere strictly to safety guidelines and maintain a clean, organized work environment.

Skills:

The required skills enable the technician to operate complex heat treatment equipment effectively, ensuring that metal parts meet precise hardness and durability requirements. Proficiency in Tocco hardness testing allows for accurate verification of material properties, which is essential for quality assurance. Strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret technical documentation ensure that processes are followed correctly and consistently. Preferred skills such as familiarity with computerized control systems and quality standards enhance the technician's ability to optimize operations and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Effective communication and problem-solving skills support collaboration with cross-functional teams to address challenges and maintain production efficiency.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Join a team where your insight can help shape the future of business transformation across a growing renewable energy business. If you're passionate about turning complex challenges into clear, evidence-based recommendations, this is an opportunity to influence strategic decisions and drive meaningful change at scale.

At EDF power solutions, we're shaping an Electric UK and Ireland. Your work will help us turn that ambition into action, delivering renewable energy solutions that will power homes, businesses and communities for generations to come.

The Opportunity

As a Business Analyst, you'll play a central role within our Business Process Transformation team, providing the analysis, business understanding and structured thinking needed to turn strategic intent into successful, adopted change. You'll work across the organisation, helping leaders make informed decisions that improve performance, efficiency and long-term value.

This is a hybrid role based from either our #Durham or #London office. You'll have the flexibility to work remotely, with office attendance expected as and when required to support collaboration, stakeholder engagement and business priorities.

You'll contribute by helping to identify improvement opportunities, validate business concepts, shape target operating models and build the evidence needed for investment and transformation decisions. You'll also help establish best practice business analysis standards across the organisation.

Who You Are

We're looking for a Business Analyst with strong analytical capability, curiosity and the confidence to challenge assumptions through evidence-based analysis. You'll be experienced in working across complex organisations and building trusted relationships with stakeholders. Are you experienced in...?

  • Significant business analysis experience within complex organisations, where analysis has directly informed investment, transformation, improvement or adoption decisions
  • Testing business concepts, problem definitions, assumptions and target operating model thinking before progressing into detailed requirements or solution design
  • Facilitating requirements gathering and analysis activities with diverse stakeholders, translating needs into clear, prioritised and traceable requirements
  • Producing value, cost and benefits analysis to support portfolio, improvement and change adoption decisions
  • Requirements analysis and documentation including elicitation, workshop facilitation, prioritisation, traceability, validation and change control

What You'll Be Doing

  • Validating business problems, concepts, assumptions and target operating model thinking before requirements gathering begins
  • Contributing to workshops, stakeholder engagement and requirements analysis to define clear business outcomes and delivery-ready requirements
  • Producing business cases, options appraisals, process analysis and recommendations for complex transformation initiatives
  • Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, benefits tracking and analytical reporting to support decision-making
  • Establishing business analysis standards, methods and best practices across the wider organisation

Pay, Benefits and Culture

Alongside a competitive salary, potential for an annual bonus, and a market-leading pension scheme, your package will include customisable benefits such as electric vehicle leasing, discounted gym membership, life assurance, tech vouchers, experience days, and more.

At EDF, we believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That's why we offer you the freedom to develop a career that's unique to you. Here, Success is Personal – it's your journey, powered by us.

Everyone is welcome at EDF. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities. As a Disability Confident employer, we will support applicants requiring adjustments. Join us and find your success at EDF!

title: Contractor In Charge (CIC)
description:
National Railroad Safety Services, Inc. is seeking dedicated, safety-driven individuals for the Contractor in Charge position in Helena, MT. This essential role is responsible for ensuring all work within railroad rights-of-way is performed safely and in compliance with regulations.

Job Description: National Railroad Safety Services, Inc. (NRSS) is seeking a Contractor in Charge (CIC) responsible for overseeing construction, maintenance, and safety compliance for freight railroads, transit systems, state DOTs, and rail industry partners.

Job Requirements:

  • Strong computer, communication, and organizational skills
  • Communicates effectively in both verbal and written formats
  • Ability for long-term travel assignments, including multi-month deployments.
  • Valid Driver's License
  • High School Diploma or Equivalent
  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in a railroad company preferably in the maintenance of way or TY&E departments
  • Successfully completes all required federal, client, and company-specific training.

Job Duties:

  • A safety-focused railroad- approved contractor responsible for overseeing worksite safety and providing flagging services as needed in place of railroad personnel
  • The CIC is responsible for conducting job briefings and ensuring full compliance with Federal Railroad (FRA) regulations (49 CFR 214) during work performed within arm's length of the track.
  • Responsible for monitoring track conditions, approaching trains, and work activities to ensure personnel remain safely clear of active tracks and equipment.
  • Communicate with train dispatchers, engineers, and supervisors via radio, phone, or electronic systems to coordinate train movements and grant permissions within established working limits.
  • Responsible for documenting all activities, including job briefings, incident reports, daily work logs, and electronic forms for submission to management and regulatory agencies.
  • Enforce all Railroad, State, and Federal Policies.

Work Environment:

  • This job operates in a field environment.
  • Travel is expected from 50% to 85% of the time.
  • Ability to work in all weather conditions

Benefits:

  • Compensation is $28 to $37 per hour based on experience
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
  • Short-Term, Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Paid Vacation and Holidays

title: AI Assistant

title: Technical Engineer
description:
Technical Engineer

Position: Technical Manager / Electrical Project Engineer - Power Generation
Location: UK-based, ideally London / South East
Salary: Junior: £30,000-£35,000 | Experienced: £50,000-£60,000

Overview

A specialist power-generation business is looking for an electrically biased engineer to support the development and delivery of generator and power-generation projects, from individual generator packages to multi-megawatt installations.

The role is open to both junior candidates looking to develop their technical expertise and experienced engineers capable of taking ownership of technical solutions and project engineering.

Responsibilities
  • Review customer enquiries and technical specifications, identifying requirements and areas requiring clarification.
  • Develop technical solutions based on customer requirements, equipment specifications and project constraints.
  • Prepare technical scopes, specifications and requests for quotation.
  • Liaise with equipment manufacturers, suppliers and internal teams to progress technical requirements.
  • Evaluate supplier proposals and support tender submissions.
  • Coordinate the integration of generators, switchgear, transformers, controls and associated electrical systems.
  • Work with designers and draughting teams to review drawings, calculations and engineering documentation.
  • Identify technical issues, missing information and potential risks.
  • Support Project Managers and site teams with technical queries and engineering issues.
  • Ensure technical documentation is accurate and complete throughout project delivery.
Requirements
  • An electrical engineering background, supported by relevant qualifications, an apprenticeship or practical experience.
  • A genuine interest in electrical power systems and power-generation technology.
  • A practical, problem-solving approach and good communication skills.
  • The ability to work with customers, suppliers and internal teams.

Junior Candidate:

  • Ideally around two years' relevant experience, although consideration will be given to candidates with less experience or a suitable electrical engineering apprenticeship and practical background.
  • Ideally some exposure to generators, switchgear, controls or industrial electrical systems, although transferable electrical experience will be considered.
  • A willingness to learn and progress into a more senior technical role.

Experienced Candidate:

  • Ideally 5+ years' relevant experience in power generation, generator applications or electrical project engineering.
  • Strong knowledge of generator systems and electrical power distribution.
  • Experience coordinating suppliers, manufacturers, designers or engineering contractors.
  • The ability to assess technical proposals, resolve engineering issues and take ownership of technical solutions.

Experience with medium/high-voltage systems, transformers, protection and synchronisation would be advantageous.

A degree, HNC/HND or equivalent engineering qualification is preferred but not essential where supported by relevant industry experience.

Salary & Benefits
  • Junior: £30,000-£35,000, with scope to develop technical expertise and progress within the business.
  • Experienced: £50,000-£60,000, depending on experience and level of responsibility.
  • Opportunity to work on varied power-generation projects and contribute to the development of the engineering function.

Bennett and Game Recruitment are a multi-disciplined technical recruitment agency based in Chichester, West Sussex operating across the UK with specialist teams covering a range of industries.

We are acting as a Recruitment Agency in relation to this vacancy, and in accordance with GDPR by applying you are granting us consent to process your data, contact you about the services we offer, and submit your CV for the role you have applied for.

title: Maintenance Technicians
description:
Exciting and rewarding opportunities have arisen based on site at HPC near Bridgwater, Somerset for Mechanical, Electrical and C&I Maintenance Technicians to join our growing Maintenance Team.

The opportunity

The role of the Maintenance Technician sits within the Commissioning Programme as part of the Maintenance Team, reporting to the Maintenance Team Leader.

Prior to fuel delivery and commercial operations, the Maintenance Technicians will be supporting Care and Maintenance (preservation) activities on newly installed plant equipment undergoing commissioning and general plant maintenance supporting the preparation of equipment/systems during construction and fit outs.

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be a valued member of the team to ensure the daily operations run smoothly and will contribute to the best possible solutions using your skills.

From the start you will be focused to help underpin the HPC business case safely > 91% Unit availability target using your previous experience of working in Mechanical, Electrical or Instrumentation disciplines.

Nuclear Safety is our overriding priority and as a Nuclear Professional you will be responsible for the safe and reliable operations of a nuclear power plant in accordance with all licenses, regulating bodies, company business strategies and industry best practices.

Pay, Benefits & Culture

In addition to a very competitive salary we offer a competitive benefits package, including a company pension scheme, and a wide range of flexible benefits to suit your lifestyle.

At EDF UK, we embrace flexibility while recognising that everyone's working needs are different. Whether you're in our office spaces, on site, or working remotely, we promote an environment that supports collaboration, connection, and comfort. No matter where you are, our priority is to make sure you feel safe, valued, and celebrated.

Here, we do right by each other and everyone’s welcome. We’re on an action-oriented journey, championing equity, diversity, and inclusion. We’d like our future workforce to have an equal gender balance, represent a broad mix of people from minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+, those with a disability and supporting social mobility.

We’re a disability confident employer and we’ll do all we can to help with your application. Please let us know if you need to request reasonable adjustments.

We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive environment, where the diverse backgrounds and experiences of our employees drive fresh thinking and innovation. We understand that success means different things to different people. We believe there are multiple definitions of what it means to succeed. That’s why we support you to pursue a career that’s unique to you. Because success is personal.

What you’ll be doing

As a Maintenance Technician, you will be required to complete the following roles:

  • Carry out maintenance activities safely, in accordance with procedures. Doing so will require you to update procedures as required and feeding back on issues found with the plant.
  • Carry out reactive, planned, preventative, electro-mechanical maintenance and fault finding.
  • Support various teams on site prior to fuel delivery
  • Care and Maintenance preservation and rectification activities.
  • Plant Maintenance Instruction authoring/validation.
  • Workshop fit outs and set ups.
  • Maintenance during commissioning.
  • Corrective maintenance.
  • Routine preventative maintenance, based on a reliability centred approach.
  • Working flexibly as well as actively participate in personal performance appraisals and take ownership of delivering personal development plans.
  • Undertake training to upskill to a Light and/or Heavy Mechanical Technician level.
  • Support I&C and Electrical activities if required.
  • Observe and report safety, environmental and plant issues in a timely manner.
  • Ensure maintenance activities do not adversely affect the environment.

Who you are

  • As a minimum, entrants will have completed a recognised apprenticeship and received NVQ level 3 qualification (or equivalent) in Mechanical, Electrical or Instrumentation disciplines.
  • Possess a sound working knowledge and understanding of performing routine maintenance activities on light and heavy industrial plant, apparatus, or systems.
  • Demonstrate a good level of engineering judgement and the ability to work safely.

Experience should include

  • Overhauling various types of valves, pumps, compressors, diesel engines, boilers and drive equipment including V belts, chain drives, couplings and more.
  • Overhauling motors, switchgear and control equipment, HVAC, actuators, lighting and small power, and fault finding on AC/DC electrical systems.
  • Calibrating and overhauling instrumentation equipment (pressure, flow, level, temperature, etc). Setting up and calibrating control valves and associated control circuits, fault finding on control and instrumentation systems.

To be appointed to this role, you will need to meet the criteria for Counter Terrorist Check (CTC) which will, ordinarily, require you to have British residency for the last 3 years.

Interviews will be held in November

title: EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, ROYAL OAK CAMPUS
description:
Woodside Bible Church is seeking a spiritually mature, strategic, and relational Executive Director to help lead a healthy, unified, and effective campus ministry. Partnering closely with the Campus Pastor and Regional Hub Pastor, the Executive Director translates vision into action by developing leaders, strengthening ministries, and ensuring campus teams and operations remain aligned with Woodside's mission, values, and ministry strategy.

This is a key leadership role for someone who loves both people and organizational leadership—a leader who can shepherd staff, build strong teams, create clarity, and help ministries flourish.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with the Campus Pastor to establish and execute campus goals, priorities, and ministry initiatives.

  • Lead, coach, and develop ministry directors and other key campus staff.

  • Build a healthy, collaborative staff culture characterized by accountability, trust, and leadership development.

  • Oversee campus operations, budgets, staffing, systems, and ministry planning.

  • Strengthen ministries and discipleship pathways that help people take meaningful next steps with Christ.

  • Monitor ministry health and effectiveness through goals, metrics, regular reviews, and staff development.

  • Provide pastoral leadership through discipleship, mentoring, counseling, and congregational care.

  • Serve as a key connector between campus leadership, Central teams, and the broader Woodside organization.

What We're Looking For

  • A spiritually mature, pastoral leader with a deep knowledge of Scripture and a heart for developing people.

  • 10+ years of senior leadership experience in a church, nonprofit, or organizational setting, including staff leadership.

  • Proven ability to build unified teams, develop leaders, navigate organizational dynamics, and execute strategy.

  • Strong organizational, administrative, financial, and strategic-planning skills.

  • A relational, humble, and wise leadership style with the ability to shepherd both staff and congregation.

  • Bachelor's degree required; master's degree preferred.

  • Meets Woodside's qualifications for ministry leadership and demonstrates strong alignment with our mission, values, and ministry philosophy.

This is a full-time, salaried role, requiring membership and active participation at the Royal Oak Campus.

If you're passionate about developing leaders, building healthy teams, and turning ministry vision into effective action, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Electronics Assembler

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of soldering and blueprints.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Outstanding time management skillset with the ability to prioritize without direct supervision.
  • Teamwork and project management skills combined with ability to work as part of a team.
  • Flexibility to adapt quickly to changing circumstances. Able to proactively question and challenge to prioritize and identify solutions in timely manner.


Required Education and Experience

  • Results oriented and driven, with a track record for delivering to plan.
  • Must be 18 years of age or older


Essential Knowledge

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Project management skills combined with ability to work as part of a team


Personal Qualities

  • Passionate about working and winning in a team environment.
  • Results oriented and driven, with a track record for delivering to plan
  • Flexibility to adapt quickly to changing circumstances. Able to proactively question and challenge to prioritize and identify solutions in timely manner
  • Clear and logical thinker
  • Relish working in a company with a diverse, challenging, and fast paced environment


Travel Requirements

Must be able to sit most of the day and lift up to 10lbs occasionally

You'll sit at the intersection of content, editorial, digital, SEO and AI, setting the standards for how content is created once, intelligently reused, discovered and cited across AI-powered search and digital experiences.


What you'll own

  • Define the editorial standard for the AI era; creating a scalable, component-based approach to content, messaging, taxonomy and governance.

Please only apply, if…

  • You have 8-10+ years' experience in content/communications/marketing, strong SEO knowledge and a genuine understanding of AEO, GEO and AI-powered search.
  • B2B regulatory environment experience is must; ideally within Asset Management or other Financial environments
  • You'll know how to build editorial standards, create structured and reusable content, work with data and turn complex ideas into compelling messaging.

  • Most importantly, you're someone who can translate emerging technology into practical change; influencing senior stakeholders, bringing teams with you and turning strategy into measurable results.

title: Speech Pathologist - Early Start Australia Graduate Program
description:
On the Early Start Australia Graduate program, you’ll feel all in from day one. In a close-knit allied health team, learning from each other and building lasting friendships along the way. With dedicated clinical supervision, mentoring and training, we’ll support you to grow with confidence – while making a positive impact in the lives of children and their families.

About the Graduate program

Our 12-month graduate program is designed to help you progress from student to thriving therapist. You can expect:

  • Structured induction with clinical skills training and a dedicated buddy.
  • Clinician shadowing before leading sessions independently.
  • Weekly supervision with an experienced clinician.
  • Supported ramp-up to managing your own caseload.
  • Learning and development built into your week.
  • Ongoing support from your multidisciplinary team and team leader.

What you’ll do at our Vermont clinic:

  • Deliver early intervention speech pathology services to children and families, supporting communication, participation, and independence.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments (formal and informal) to identify speech, language, and developmental needs.
  • Develop and implement individualised, evidence-based therapy plans aligned with family goals and child needs.
  • Work collaboratively with families, caregivers, and multidisciplinary teams using a key worker/transdisciplinary approach.
  • Monitor, review, and adapt therapy programs based on client progress and feedback.
  • Provide education, resources, and ongoing support to empower families in decision-making and home-based practice.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, reports, and NDIS-related records within required timeframes.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders (e.g., schools, health professionals, support coordinators) to support client outcomes.

What you’ll get

Support

  • Dedicated buddy to help you settle in
  • 1:1 supervision with an experienced clinician
  • Discipline and peer-to-peer support sessions
  • Admin support so you can focus on learning and therapy

Grow with confidence

  • CPD allowance + paid professional development leave
  • Structured clinical and soft skills training
  • Clear path from graduate to independent clinician, and beyond
  • Local and global career opportunities through the APM Group

Flexibility and wellbeing

  • Up to 12 weeks annual leave
  • Flexible working options as you progress
  • Wellbeing support for you and your family

Reward and recognition

  • Competitive graduate salary + bonus program
  • Registration and professional membership contribution
  • Relocation reimbursement up to $5,000, where applicable

What you’ll bring

  • Relevant qualification in Speech Pathology
  • Membership / registration with relevant bodies (SPA)
  • Current Driver’s License and vehicle
  • Current Working with Children Check or Working with Vulnerable People Registration (state specific)
  • NDIS workers screening check & Police Check
  • Accredited first aid & CPR certificate
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • Exceptional observational and report writing skills

Who we are

We’re a passionate team of allied health professionals supporting children and young people to reach their full potential. Our multidisciplinary teams work closely with families to deliver fun, personalised, evidence-based support across communication, motor, cognitive and social development. We are a registered NDIS provider and our clinics offer therapy under different funding models. As part of the APM Group, we offer the stability and opportunities of a global organisation, with the connection and care of local multidisciplinary teams.

Early Start Australia places a high priority on the principles of respect, equity and diversity. As an employer of choice, we strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, people from culturally diverse backgrounds and people with disabilities.

title: Head of Organic Performance
description:

Salary: £50k - £55k per annum

WorkingHours: Monday to Friday 9am-5pm

Benefits:

  • Flexible working offered
  • Hybrid working offered
  • Pension
  • Onsite parking

The role is responsible for organic growth across search, AI discovery, technical SEO, content, authority and ecommerce.

We want someone who understands the landscape businesses are now struggling to navigate. Senior enough to steer the ship, credible enough to challenge thinking and technical enough to work directly with developers.

You will own the organic proposition across the business and help us improve how clients are discovered through Google, AI platforms and the wider web.

You will lead organic performance across a portfolio of clients.

That includes:

  • Technical SEO
  • Content strategy implementation
  • Ecommerce SEO
  • Information architecture assessment & implementation
  • Internal linking
  • Structured data
  • Entity optimisation
  • Digital PR and authority
  • AI search visibility
  • GEO / AEO
  • Competitor analysis
  • Organic conversion opportunities
  • Measurement and reporting

You will decide what matters, what does not, and what needs to happen next.

We are not looking for someone to produce long audits and lists of recommendations.

We are looking for someone who can identify the highest-value opportunities and turn them into action.

The Role:

Technical SEO

You will need strong technical SEO knowledge.

You should be comfortable working with:

  • Crawlability and indexation
  • Rendering
  • JavaScript
  • Canonicals
  • Redirects
  • Robots directives
  • XML sitemaps
  • Pagination
  • Faceted navigation
  • Structured data
  • Core Web Vitals
  • Internal linking
  • Site architecture
  • International SEO
  • Ecommerce platforms
  • Website migrations
  • Log analysis
  • Search engine and AI crawler behaviour

You do not need to be a developer, but you will be working directly with developers and your recommendations need to stand up technically.

AI search and discovery

AI search is part of the role.

You will be expected to understand and investigate visibility across platforms such as:

  • ChatGPT
  • Gemini
  • Perplexity
  • Copilot

You will help us understand why brands are being surfaced, cited or ignored.

Content and authority

You will help influence content strategy across core user journeys and commercial landing pages.

The objective is not to publish more content.

It is to create content that earns visibility and supports commercial outcomes.

You will also work across authority and trust signals including:

  • Links
  • Brand mentions
  • Reviews
  • Third-party citations
  • Industry coverage
  • Expert profiles
  • Partnerships and associations

Ecommerce

Experience with complex ecommerce websites will be important. You should understand the issues created by:

  • Large catalogues
  • Product variants
  • Categories
  • Filtering
  • Faceted navigation
  • Pagination
  • Out-of-stock products
  • Seasonal ranges
  • Duplicate content
  • Product feeds
  • Manufacturer pages
  • Large-scale metadata

Experience with Magento / Adobe Commerce & Shopify is essential, WooCommerce would be useful.

Data and commercial performance

We care about commercial performance so there will be an expectation to understand and report on areas such as:

  • Organic revenue
  • Qualified leads
  • Non-brand visibility
  • Conversion
  • Brand demand
  • Share of search
  • Landing-page performance
  • AI visibility
  • Citation frequency
  • Organic contribution

You should be comfortable with:

  • Google Search Console
  • GA4
  • Semrush
  • Screaming Frog
  • Google Trends
  • AI visibility tools
  • Crawling and diagnostic tools

The important part is not knowing how to use the tools. It is knowing what to look for.

You will have full ownership on how we report all of this information centrally, so any preference such as Looker Studios is worth bringing to our attention.

Client leadership

This is a senior client-facing role.

You will work directly with founders, Marketing Directors, Ecommerce Directors and their supporting teams.

You will lead:

  • Performance strategy sessions
  • Performance reviews
  • SEO workshops
  • AI search workshops
  • Competitor analysis
  • Technical reviews
  • Content planning
  • Executive presentations

Essential skills & Attributes:

We are looking for someone with strong senior-level experience across organic search.

You should have:

  • Strong technical SEO knowledge
  • Proven experience developing organic growth strategies
  • Experience with complex websites
  • Strong ecommerce SEO knowledge
  • Experience with content strategy
  • Experience with authority and link acquisition
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Commercial awareness
  • Confidence working with senior clients
  • A good understanding of AI search
  • The ability to prioritise effectively
  • The confidence to challenge weak thinking

description:

West Yorkshire
circa £70.000 + benefits
2-stage interview

Certain Advantage is partnering with a key client to recruit a Principal EC&I Engineer. You will lead EC&I delivery and provide technical authority throughout design, testing and commissioning. You will guide the team in developing high-quality solutions, applying engineering principles to resolve complex challenges. You will oversee design activities, coordinate stakeholders, ensure compliance and advise on electrical systems.

What will you be doing?

  • Ensure designs meet functional safety, cybersecurity, hazardous-area, EMC/EMI, environmental and survivability requirements, including applicable MIL-STD, DEF-STAN, UK, EU and client standards.
  • Coordinate cable routing and interfaces with gearbox, mechanical, transmission, process and marine engineering teams, including for demanding operating environments.
  • Use PLC and DCS software, investigate technical issues and identify root causes.
  • Define and manage design requirements, lead multidisciplinary project activities, and participate in design reviews through client acceptance.

A couple of things you should know:
  • Skilled in preparing electrical specifications, scopes of work, engineering calculations, drawings and schedules.
  • Demonstrated EC&I engineering experience, preferably in heavy industry or rotating equipment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics or a related discipline.
  • Proficient in 3D CAD layout tools, such as Solid Edge Electrical or NX Electrical Routing.
  • Familiar with defence platforms or industrial machinery.

title: Economic Inclusion and Agribusiness Advisor (m/f)
description:
Support to forcibly displaced persons and host communities in Northern Mozambique (Nexus Norte II) is recruiting an Advisor Peacebuilding & Security Risk Management (m/f) for Pemba, Cabo Delegado, Mozambique

The cover letter and CV should be in a single file including relevant annexes.

Deadline of applications submission: 19.10.2026

A. Context

The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) is a global service provider in the field of international cooperation and capacity building for sustainable development. In Northern Mozambique, GIZ is supporting bilateral cooperation in the area of“Peace and Social Cohesion” since 2022. The project “Nexus Norte – Support to forcibly displaced persons and host communities” is implemented jointly with the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR). It is commissioned by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (Bundesministerium für wirtschafliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung, BMZ) with the objective to improve the living conditions of forcibly displaced persons and members of host communities in the provinces of Nampula and Cabo Delgado. Nexus Norte works along three outputs, seeking to (1) strengthen capacities for coordinated service delivery across the Humanitarian Development Peace (HDP) Nexus, (2) providing opportunities for technical and vocational education and training (TVET) and income-generating activities and (3) strengthening the preconditions for a peaceful coexistence between different groups.

In order to support project activities in the sector, GIZ is recruiting an Economic Inclusion and Agribusiness Advisor in Pemba, Cabo Delgado.

The Agribusiness and Income Generation Advisor is responsible for developing, implementing and monitoring strategies that improve agricultural related income generation measures that build the resilience of small holder farmers particularly Internally Displaced Persons and host communities in selected districts of Nampula and Cabo Delgado. The role will focus on increasing the income of displaced people by supporting their access into agricultural value chain processes and creating alternative income sources to build household resilience. The actions must include adaptation and provision of gender and psychosocial approaches in direct collaboration with UNHCR and other project implementation partners to guarantee the support to women, especially GBV and other sextortion survivors in all project activities. This position reports to the Deputy Project Manager with regular travel within the country.

B. Main activities

1. Agricultural value chains and income generation:

  • Conduct localized value chain analyses in selected districts to identify profitable opportunities for IDPs and host communities.
  • Facilitate the coordination of relevant government and non-government partners that provide technical assistance to producer groups and other value chain actors on topics such as production, post-harvest handling and quality control.
  • Through implementing partners, promote client smart agricultural and alternative livelihoods to reduce dependence on single production.
  • Develop and implement alternative income generation measures such as small businesses that would respond to the basic needs of IDPs and host communities as appropriate.

2. Private sector engagement and partnerships

  • Serve as the project's Focal Point for private sector engagement, in collaboration with other GIZ projects.
  • Identify and facilitate engagement with private sector companies to maintain fair out grower agreements that would support the provision of production, marketing and financing inputs where possible.
  • Build partnerships with other stakeholders and projects to scale interventions.

3. Access to finance and financial literacy

  • Support access to community-based financing schemes (e.g. Village Savings and Loan Associations, revolving funds) and trainings on financial literacy, savings etc.

4. Inclusion, gender and protection

  • In coordination with UNHCR and its implementing partners, ensure the inclusive economic participation of women and youth, especially GBV survivors and other sextortion victims, through gender-transformative and psychosocial approaches.

5. Partner, grant and consultant management

  • Guide and monitor grantees, local subsidies and contracted consultants, including drafting terms of reference, financial agreements and contracting documents.
  • Train partner staff on institutional capacity strengthening and advise on policy, quality assurance and regulatory issues affecting the target group.

6. Internal Advisory, planning, monitoring and knowledge management

  • Operational planning and supporting the planning and monitoring of project expenditure related to Agribusiness and Income Generation Output.
  • Advise project staff and stakeholders on policy development, quality assurance and regulatory reforms particularly where these have a direct effect on the project’s target group.
  • Support the MEL team in collecting disaggregated outcome and output data with implementing partners.
  • Documentation of best practices and contribution to communication needs of the project within the project team and with partners. This will also include sharing sector specific updates and following up on relevant debates/advances to the sectors.
  • Provision of necessary documentation and support to the Finance and Administration team in relation to project led events, training, workshops, forums, team meetings and other project activities.

Other duties as assigned.

C. Qualifications and specialist knowledge

Educational qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Agribusiness, Agricultural Economics, Economics, Business Administration, Rural Development or a related field; Master's degree an asset

Requirements

Professional experience

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in economic inclusion, agribusiness, value chain development or livelihood programming
  • Proven experience working with smallholder farmers and rural SMEs in a displacement context
  • At least 2 years of experience implementing programmes in northern Mozambique (Cabo Delgado and/or Nampula)
  • Experience in private sector engagement, including out-grower or contract farming arrangements
  • Experience facilitating community-based savings and credit mechanisms (e.g. VSLAs) and financial literacy training
  • Experience managing implementing partners, grants and consultants, including drafting terms of reference and contracts
  • Experience in gender-responsive and protection-sensitive programming; familiarity with coordination with UN agencies an asset
  • Proven ability to plan, monitor and evaluate livelihood activities, including collection of disaggregated data

Other competencies

  • Strong management, organizational and facilitation skills
  • Good command of MS Office
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese; knowledge of Emakhuwa, Kimwani or Shimakonde an asset
  • Familiarity with GIZ/BMZ or other donor procedures an asset
  • Willingness to travel and work in a volatile security environment

Notes

  • This is a national position.
  • The application must contain the Curriculum Vitae (with at least three professional references), a cover letter describing your motivation and your qualifications for the position, relevant diplomas and certificates.
  • The Curriculum Vitae and cover letter must be in a single file, including relevant attachments.
  • We encourage women, people with disabilities and minority groups to apply for this position. GIZ is committed to equal opportunities and diversity of perspectives in the workplace.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Lead Document Controller
description:
Lead Document Controller
Wolverhampton or Warrington | Hybrid Working | Excellent Salary Package

Take Ownership of Document Control Across Complex Engineering Projects

Are you an experienced Document Controller with a background in engineering, manufacturing or turnkey project delivery? Do you have strong technical document management skills and the confidence to take a lead role in maintaining standards, supporting project teams and developing best practice?

We are working with a specialist engineering business operating in a technically demanding, project-led environment. They are looking to appoint a Lead Document Controller to act as the business's subject matter expert for document control, overseeing consistent processes across projects and programmes while remaining actively involved in the day-to-day delivery of project documentation.

Offering an excellent salary package, hybrid working and the choice of Wolverhampton or Warrington as your base, this is an opportunity to combine hands-on technical document control with team leadership and continuous improvement.

The Role

Reporting to the Projects Delivery Director, you will take responsibility for the effective management of document control activities across the business. Around 90% of your time will be spent supporting nominated projects, with the remainder focused on leading the Document Control function, developing colleagues and improving processes.

Your responsibilities will include:

Project Document Control: Managing the receipt, issue, distribution, review and approval of project documentation, ensuring accurate records and efficient information flow between internal teams, clients and suppliers.

Document Management Systems: Setting up and maintaining project systems using Autodesk Vault or similar DMS platforms, ensuring documentation is correctly recorded, controlled and accessible.

Engineering Documentation: Managing technical documents and engineering drawings, maintaining revision control, document registers, transmittals and fully auditable records.

Compliance and Quality: Ensuring project teams follow established document control procedures and contractual requirements, conducting spot audits and maintaining appropriate project archives.

Client Systems: Coordinating documentation through client-specific document management systems where required, alongside the company's primary system.

Team Leadership: Providing day-to-day leadership, guidance and mentoring to Document Controllers, reviewing workloads, supporting performance development and ensuring resources are effectively allocated.

Continuous Improvement: Reviewing procedures and work instructions, identifying opportunities to improve document control processes and supporting the implementation of approved business improvement initiatives.

Project Support: Working closely with Project and Programme Managers, assisting with documentation tracking, information packs, meetings and other project administration requirements.

About You

You will be an experienced Document Controller who understands the importance of accuracy, traceability, revision management and consistent document control procedures within a complex engineering environment.

Ideally, you will bring:

  • Proven experience in document control within engineering, manufacturing, industrial projects or turnkey engineering environments.
  • Practical experience using Autodesk Vault or a comparable Document Management System (DMS).
  • A strong understanding of technical documentation, engineering drawings, document transmittals, approval workflows and version control.
  • Experience maintaining auditable records and working to formal quality procedures and contractual requirements.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
  • Excellent organisation, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.
  • The confidence to work with engineers, project teams, clients and senior stakeholders while promoting consistent working practices.

Experience within highly regulated or safety-critical sectors, particularly nuclear or defence, would be a significant advantage. Previous experience supervising, mentoring or managing other Document Controllers would also be beneficial, although a strong technical Document Controller ready to step into a leadership position will be considered.

What's in It for You?

  • Excellent salary and benefits package, dependent on experience.
  • Hybrid working for improved flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Choice of base office in Wolverhampton or Warrington.
  • An influential position with responsibility for document control standards across multiple projects and programmes.
  • The opportunity to work alongside experienced engineering and project delivery professionals.
  • Scope to develop your leadership skills and drive meaningful improvements across the business.

Occasional travel between the Wolverhampton and Warrington offices will be required.

Interested?

If you have a strong engineering document control background, experience with Autodesk Vault or similar DMS software, and are ready for a role combining technical delivery, team leadership and process improvement, we would welcome a confidential conversation.

Apply today to explore this opportunity and take the next step in your document control career.

Important Information: We endeavour to process your personal data in a fair and transparent manner. In applying for this role, Russell Taylor will be acting within your interest and will contact you in relation to the role, either by email, phone or text message. For more information see our on our website. It is important you are aware of your individual rights and the provisions the company has put in place to protect your data. If you would like further information on the policy or GDPR please get in touch with us .

title: SDK Engineer Drive 9th Oct 2026

title: Senior Splunk and DLP Security Engineer
description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Splunk and DLP Security Engineer to enhance and optimise DLP monitoring, alerting and reporting capabilities across Splunk and the wider DLP toolset.

You will also support junior analysts, share technical knowledge and ensure the team has clear documentation and runbooks to maintain and develop the enhanced capabilities.

  • Develop and optimise advanced Splunk searches using SPL, including multi-index correlation, drilldowns and alert development.
