description:
About the Role
Bhumi's Schools of Excellence Program strengthens holistic student development in select government schools
through structured Sports, Arts, and Co-Curricular programming. This role sits at the intersection of program
design, government liaison, and data-driven program management, working closely with government officials,
school leadership, and coaching/facilitation partners to build a model that enables excellence in student
participation, skill-building, and achievement beyond the classroom.

We're looking for a generalist with genuine interest and some experience in the sports and/or arts space —
someone who understands how school-level sports, arts, and co-curricular programs work, can speak the
language of coaches and instructors, and can translate that understanding into a program that works at scale in
a government school system. You don't need to have competed or performed at a high level yourself; what
matters is a real interest in this space and the ability to design and manage a program around it.

Key Result Areas (KRAs)
  • Government & Institutional Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as Bhumi's primary point of coordination with
    HMs, DEOs, Physical Education/Arts faculty, and coaching or facilitation partners. Build and sustain
    relationships that keep the program credible.

  • Sports/Arts & Co-Curricular Program Design & Oversight: Design and refine the coaching/facilitation
    model — content structure, session pacing, and coach/mentor inputs — drawing on interest, exposure, or
    experience in sports and/or arts to keep the model realistic and effective for government-school students.

  • Data Analysis & Performance Monitoring: Track student participation, attendance, and skill/performance
    progression across schools and disciplines (sports, arts, other co-curricular activities). Build simple, usable
    dashboards/reports that help identify what's working and course-correct quickly.

  • Coaching Quality Assurance & Capacity Building: Monitor the quality of coaching/facilitation delivery
    across partner schools. Work with coaches, instructors, or teachers to close gaps and maintain consistency
    across sites and disciplines.

  • Reporting & Cross-Team Coordination: Prepare periodic updates for leadership.
Preferred
  • A genuine interest in sports and/or the arts, along with some exposure to this space — as a participant,
    volunteer, organiser, instructor, or through prior work/project experience, OR

  • Prior experience designing, managing, or coordinating a sports, arts, or co-curricular program or event,
    even in a generalist capacity.

  • A reasonable working understanding of how school-level sports/arts ecosystems function (e.g., school and
    district tournaments, annual days, exhibitions, co-curricular requirements) — you don't need to be a
    domain expert, but you should be comfortable learning and engaging with this world.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, ideally with exposure to government or institutional environments.

  • Comfort working with data, building trackers, reading performance trends, and translating numbers into
    decisions (Excel/Sheets fluency expected).

  • Based in Chennai; willing to work out of the DPI office as the primary base, with travel to partner schools.

title: ADF Rehabilitation Consultant
description:
Join Acumen Health and be part of a national team delivering meaningful outcomes in occupational rehabilitation. With strong local support, exposure to complex and psychological injury cases, and clear governance around your work, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your capability while making a real impact.

Support people where your rewards are truly meaningful and purposeful.

As an ADF Rehabilitation Consultant, you will apply your clinical reasoning skills to support ADF personnel who have sustained a physical and/or psychological injury. This is a unique role to be part of the team that gets our military fully fit and ready to defend and protect Australia.

  • Taking a holistic care approach, work within a multidisciplinary team to support the journey from rehab to healing
  • Perform a variety of assessments depending on your area of clinical expertise. This could include worksite, ergonomic or activities of daily living assessments
  • Collaborate with a variety of stakeholders including the employee who has suffered injury, illness, or trauma, medical specialists, other treatment providers and allied health professionals
  • Develop, implement and monitor rehabilitation plans.

KPI’s based on service delivery outcomes, NOT billable hours. Genuine person-centred focus and goal setting.

Set working hours means you can truly have WORK / LIFE balance – no overtime, no outside of work hours work. Enjoy early starts and early finishes: 7:30am - 3:30pm Monday to Friday. You will be located at HMAS Stirling in Garden Island.

Why you’ll love working at Acumen Health, part of the APM Group

At Acumen Health, you’ll work within a national network with strong local teams, giving you the opportunity to manage diverse and complex cases while being supported by experienced colleagues and leaders.
You’ll build capability in complex and psychological injury, working with structured approaches including trauma-informed practice and validated assessment tools.
Our teams are supported by clear clinical governance and practical systems, giving you the confidence to make decisions, manage risk and deliver strong outcomes for your clients.

As part of the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. title: AI Product Manager
description:
Are you ready to take the lead on how AI is used safely, securely and effectively across a growing renewable energy business? As AI technology develops at pace, we need someone who can help us make the most of its potential while making sure the platforms and products we use are right for our people and our business.

At EDF power solutions, we’re shaping an Electric UK and Ireland. Your work will help us turn that ambition into action – delivering renewable energy solutions that will power homes, businesses and communities for generations to come.

As our AI Product Manager, you’ll turn opportunities into AI products that make a real difference. You’ll shape our AI roadmap, bring business and technology teams together and take ideas from discovery through to live solutions that people trust and use.

The Opportunity

As our AI Product Manager, you’ll take a senior role in shaping how AI is used across EDF power solutions. With an AI platform already secured for use in the UK, you’ll help us move into the next phase, leading how it’s used, managing specialist suppliers and partners, and making sure AI solutions are secure, responsible and delivering genuine value.

Alongside a competitive salary and potential for an annual bonus, this role offers flexibility to be based UK-wide. You’ll come together with colleagues for an office meeting around once a month, which could be in #London, #Durham, or #Edinburgh.

You’ll also have the opportunity to shape our wider AI strategy, collaborating with IT teams across the UK and France and bringing together expertise from across EDF. You’ll lead suppliers and delivery partners, explore emerging AI capabilities and help us get the balance right between innovation, security and practical business value.

Why EDF power solutions?

We’re united by a shared ambition: to tackle climate change, shaping an Electric UK and Ireland. Our diverse team is growing fast, driven by innovation and a commitment to clean, green energy for all.

With technologies spanning onshore and offshore wind, solar, battery storage and green hydrogen, we’re the UK & Ireland’s most diverse renewable generator. By 2035, we aim to deliver 10GW of low-carbon energy – and we’d love you to help us get there.

Who You Are

We’re looking for a senior AI Product Manager who can bring together AI strategy, product management and strong commercial thinking. You’ll be confident working across a complex organisation, managing external partners and influencing how AI is used safely and effectively. To be shortlisted, you need to offer…

  • Experience in AI product management, product ownership or a similar AI or machine learning-focused role within a large or complex organisation.
  • Experience delivering AI or machine learning solutions from concept through to production.
  • Experience managing technology suppliers, delivery partners or third-party AI providers.
  • Experience shaping or contributing to an organisation-wide AI strategy and product roadmap.
  • Knowledge of modern AI technologies, including large language models, generative AI and emerging AI capabilities.
  • An understanding of responsible AI, data governance, privacy and the security considerations involved in introducing AI into a business.
  • Experience working with stakeholders across different business areas, functions or geographical locations.
  • Experience within energy, utilities or another large, complex organisation would be useful.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Shaping and managing our AI strategy and roadmap, helping us decide where AI can make the biggest difference.
  • Leading how our AI platform is used across the business, making sure it’s adopted safely, securely and appropriately.
  • Managing specialist AI suppliers and delivery partners, making sure solutions meet our needs and deliver value.
  • Working with IT colleagues across the UK and France to share expertise and make the most of capabilities from across EDF.
  • Setting clear standards around responsible AI use, including security, privacy, data quality and governance.
  • Taking AI opportunities from discovery through to delivery, adoption and ongoing improvement.
  • Exploring emerging AI technologies and assessing where they can solve genuine business problems.
  • Building relationships with senior stakeholders and helping teams understand what AI can, and can’t, do for them.
  • Measuring adoption and value to make sure AI investments are delivering the outcomes we expected.

Pay, Benefits and Culture

If you’re looking to join a company where you can work hard, have fun, and help to create a net zero future – then you’re in the right place! If you’re passionate about tackling climate change to support a cleaner, greener future, we’d love you to come and join us.

Alongside a competitive salary and potential for an annual bonus, and a market-leading pension scheme, our employee benefits include flexible benefits tailored to your lifestyle – from electric vehicle leasing and private healthcare to extra holiday and more.

Everyone is welcome at EDF power solutions; we’re committed to building a workforce that reflects gender balance, social mobility, and inclusion of minority ethnic backgrounds, LGBTQ+ communities, and those with disabilities. As a Disability Confident employer, we will support applicants requiring adjustments.

title: Analytics Internship - Trading & Shipping
description:
At Ampol, we believe in the Power of Us - the extraordinary power of people to connect, act, and make a difference.

As a leading energy company operating across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore and from the United States, our work spans fuel supply, energy solutions, convenience retail, infrastructure, trading and shipping. Every role at Ampol plays a part in something bigger - powering progress for our customers, communities, and people.

Your career here is yours to shape. We back our people with real opportunities, the tools to grow, and a culture that rewards ownership and initiative. Whether you’re deepening your expertise or taking on something new, we’ll support you to power a career that works for you.

We’re building a workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued - because when people are free to be themselves, powerful things happen.

About Ampol Trading & Shipping

Our purpose at Ampol is to power better journeys today and tomorrow. Our Trading and Shipping team is key to achieving this, not only supplying our customer’s needs today, but evolving as the energy transition takes place to supply our customers well into the future.

We take pride in our people and value innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. If you’re a professional committed to excellence, Ampol is looking for you.

About the role

The Commercial & Market Analysis Intern will support the analytical activities that underpin Ampol's trading and shipping business.

A core focus of the internship will be vessel tracking, trade flow analysis, refinery monitoring and maintaining key market datasets. Through tracking physical movements, analysing country-level statistics and monitoring refinery activity, interns will develop an understanding of the drivers behind crude oil and refined product markets.

These activities form the foundation of commercial awareness and market understanding. As familiarity and competence grow, interns will have opportunities to contribute to market analysis, balance updates, dashboard development, process improvement, modelling and automation initiatives.

Depending on business requirements and individual strengths, interns may support:

  • Crude Oil
  • Distillates (Diesel & Jet Fuel)
  • Gasoline
  • Pricing & Data Analytics

We're looking for individuals who are curious enough to ask why, disciplined enough to follow the process, analytical enough to identify problems, and confident enough to investigate them independently.

Internship Details

This is a full-time, paid 6-month internship commencing in January 2027. Applicants should be available for the full duration of the internship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct vessel tracking and trade flow analysis for crude oil and refined products.
  • Monitor and maintain country statistics, refinery operations, refinery outages and market datasets.
  • Support the development and maintenance of supply and demand balances.
  • Research global refining systems, energy markets and trade developments.
  • Produce regular reports, market updates, visualisations and pricing summaries.
  • Assist Commercial Analysts with market investigations and ad hoc analysis.
  • Develop dashboards and analytical tools to improve accessibility and understanding of market information.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analytical workflows through process improvement, modelling and automation.
  • Collaborate with analysts, traders and other stakeholders on commercial and analytical initiatives.

What We Look For

We're looking for curious, dependable people who enjoy solving problems and taking responsibility for outcomes. You'll be a great fit if you share these qualities:

  • Attention to Detail – You notice when something doesn't look right and take the initiative to investigate.
  • Investigative Thinking – When something doesn't make sense, you're driven to understand why and uncover the root cause.
  • Process Discipline & Patience – You value getting the fundamentals right before looking for ways to improve them.
  • Ownership & Follow-Through – You take responsibility for your work and see tasks through to completion.
  • Learning Agility & Teachability – You welcome feedback, learn quickly, and continuously look for ways to improve.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Undergraduate students from Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering or related disciplines.
  • Strong interest in commodity markets, energy markets and market analysis.
  • Good proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with Power Query and data transformation techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with Power BI, dashboard development or data visualisation.
  • Exposure to Snowflake, Azure or cloud-based data platforms.
  • Experience working with large datasets and data validation.
  • Good proficiency in Python and/or SQL.
  • Interest in shipping, commodity trading, energy markets or supply chain analysis.

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to learn how global energy markets function through real-world trade flow analysis, market fundamentals and commercial decision-making.

You will work alongside experienced analysts in a fast-paced trading environment, gaining exposure to the challenges and opportunities that shape global commodity markets. High-performing interns who demonstrate strong analytical ability, ownership and commercial curiosity may have opportunities to take on broader responsibilities and gain greater exposure to front-office activities.

Appliactions close 16th October 2027 at 5pm

    At Ampol, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We embrace and celebrate diversity in all its forms, recognizing that it makes our organization stronger. We encourage applications from people of all ages, backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We invite you to bring your whole self to Ampol.

title: Quality Control Inspector III
description:
Department: Quality

Reports To: Quality Supervisor

Location: Clinton, MA

Travel: Negligible


About Vitesse a Lyntris Company: How we communicate, capture, and share information has not changed significantly in our lifetime—it has changed significantly in the last decade, even in the last year. From a vacationer checking email as they fly across the world to a U.S. military service member sharing critical observations across the battlefield, the ability to capture and transfer data over different platforms is an important part both of our everyday lives and the security of our country. Whether on a geostationary satellite, a naval vessel, or a military jet, the mission-critical solutions that we design and manufacture at Vitesse make our country and our world safer.

Through extensive technical expertise, Vitesse Systems is optimizing the functionality of antenna and thermal management systems for the advancement of next-generation Radar, Electronic Warfare, and C4I (Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence) systems.

Vitesse Systems prides itself on the solutions we provide to our customers, as well as the incredible team of dedicated people we employ.


SUMMARY: The Quality Control Inspector III is an advanced level mechanical inspector role. The primary function of the role is to inspect components and assemblies for dimensional, aesthetic and workmanship characteristics. Simultaneously, the Quality Control Inspector III will verify documentation is complete and accurate from internal and external suppliers. This team member will perform all mechanical inspection using CMM, micrometers, calipers height gages and hardness testing equipment and will log data as required. The Quality Contril Inspector III will interpret measuring results passing confirming product and will generate non-conformance documentation. Advanced GD&T is required in this role in order to be proficient at CMM programming and interpretation of results/setups. Commitment to and support of the Company Core Values are key to success in this position.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform all work in manner that is safe for you and fellow team members and is compliant with Vitesse System safety policies.
  • Follow all quality procedures, work instructions, and documents pertaining to your job and department.
  • Complete all paperwork and documentation required with order.
  • Verify all traveler sign-offs, SPC sheets have been completed and signed off in accordance with good documentation practices.
  • Verify part number, revision, expiration dates and other data fields on supplier certification match work order or purchase order requirements.
  • Clock in/out to job operation promptly after assignment/completion recording quantity completed.
  • Inspect parts to blueprint specifications and workmanship standards.
  • Verify that all company and personal inspection equipment and tools being used are in calibration.
  • Report non-conformances to Quality Supervisor and Generate Non-Conformance reports for all discrepant material.
  • Identify potential issues/problems and collaborate with engineering and operations on corrective action investigations.
  • Independently operate equipment & tasks within allotted times.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area
  • Proficient with inspection tooling: height gages, calipers, micrometers, and hardness testing.
  • Proficient with programming, setup, and operation of CMM equipment including interpretation of inspection reports thereof.
  • Inspection reports as required.
  • Proficient use of Advanced Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (multiple datums, complex relationships, etc.).
  • Perform all functions of the job while adhering to established quality policies and procedures.
  • Uphold the company’s core values.
  • Other duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: This position has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation(s)may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Successful accomplishment of duties and responsibilities may require the following:

  • Must have the knowledge and experience necessary for the position.
  • Must be able to operate the various machines within the department with minimal instruction.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Must be capable of reading and understanding drawings, blueprints and specifications.
  • Must be able to inspect the parts they are machining.
  • Ability to measure with vernier caliper, micrometer sand height gauges.
  • Must be able to follow instructions and procedures and work with minimal supervision.
  • Strong communication, both written and oral and problem-solving skills.
  • Must be adaptable to a changing work environment and competing demands.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Actively supports and complies with Vitesse Systems objectives, guidelines and commitment to Quality and Safety, with an emphasis on continual improvement, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Must be able to interact effectively and cooperatively with Team Members at all levels.
  • Must have the ability to complete assignments within the time frame specified by the Manager.
  • Must be flexible regarding working hours and overtime. Must be able to work overtime in the evenings and weekends, with or without advanced notice.
  • Must be able to operate in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple projects simultaneously.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

  • High school diploma or general education degree (GED)
  • 4 -6 years related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience in an AS9100 environment.

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to speak and understand basic safety and manufacturing instructions.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to add and subtract two-digit numbers. Ability to multiply and divide with 10’s and 100’s.

REASONING ABILITY: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS: Authorization to work in the United States. To conform to U.S. export control regulations, you should be eligible for any required authorizations from the U.S. Government.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation(s) may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to stand, walk, and hear. The Team Member frequently is required to use hands and fingers; handle, feel, and reach with hands and arms. The Team Member is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and smell. The Team Member must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: The work environments characteristics described here are representative of those a Team Member encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation(s) may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this position, the Team Member is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The Team Member may be exposed to a hot and/or cold work environment, chemicals, fumes or airborne particles, loud noises, risk of electrical shock and vibration and/or other occupational hazards; personal protective equipment may be required.

NOTE: This job description identifies the general nature and scope of work to be performed. Vitesse Systems, LLC. reserves the right to revise all or any part of this job description and to add or eliminate essential job functions at any time. Designation of any job duty as an essential function is not intended as an assurance or guarantee that a team member has any right to perform the particular job duty, except as required by Vitesse Systems, LLC. This job description is subject to change based on the needs of the position and/or the Company.

title: Senior C++ Programmer
description:

Desirable Experience

What’s Offered
  • 12-month structured training programme
  • Smart City offices with a highly experienced engineering team
  • Long-term, stable product roadmap
  • Opportunity to work on software used by leading hedge funds and investment specialists
  • Deep technical challenges and genuine craftsmanship in C++

title: Junior Technical Engineer
description:
HM59: Junior Technical Engineer

Location: Flintshire

Salary: Competitive Hourly Rate | 6 month Contract

Overview:

First Military Recruitment are currently seeking a Junior Technical Engineer on behalf of one of our clients.

To measure and characterise the performance of customer mechanical test and measurement equipment by comparison to calibration standards or artefacts, in accordance with authorised procedure and metrological good practice.

Our client encourages applications from ex-military personnel however all candidates will be given due consideration.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Understanding and complying with statutory, quality and organisational requirements for aviation, including safety, documentation, occupational health and safety in an aviation environment.
  • To carry out calibration and/or measurements in accordance with authorised documentation.
  • Adjustment or partial reconditioning of customer assets that have drifted outside specification (where possible).
  • To complete all relevant paperwork to declare the customer asset as conforming to required specification and having a calibration that is traceable to the International System of Units.
  • To ensure that calibration standards or artefacts used during measurement activities are those specified in the authorised calibration procedure, are fit for use and hold a valid calibration status.
  • To report any suspected issues with calibration standards or artefacts that may compromise the integrity of measurement results.
  • To analyse and interpret measurement results, ensuring that customer asset performance is within the specification stated in the applicable calibration statement of requirement and/or standard.
  • To update calibration records on the business system prior to and after any calibration activity.
  • To ensure that data has been captured accurately regarding calibration assets/artefacts used (metrological traceability) and that any important information regarding customer asset as-found and as-left conditions has been logged.
  • To ensure the proper handling of customer assets both during measurement activity and in preparation of hand-over to warehousing team.
  • To coordinate with Team Leader and/or Support Engineers in the raising of Request For Change forms for issues that have been identified about documented calibration procedures.
  • To carry out pre-production proving of technical documents and to provide feedback to actioning engineer and agree corrective amendment action where necessary.
  • To assist in the round-up of calibration standards and artefacts in preparation for internal recalibration or dispatch to external calibration organisations.
  • To assist with development of calibration methodology and procedure, where agreed with the Team Leader.
  • To follow procedure regarding the bonding of customer assets where a standard or procedure has become unavailable or unsuitable for use.
  • To ensure the protection of mechanical calibration standards if the laboratory experiences an unacceptable drift in ambient humidity and temperature conditions outside specified parameters.
  • To ensure the cleanliness and integrity of working calibration area in preparation of measurement activity and to maintain on an on-going basis.
  • To assist with technical queries received through Helpdesk.
  • To coordinate with Engineering Support in the authorisation of alternative Test and Measurement equipment.
  • While most of the role will mandate the candidate operate in accordance with authorised procedure to specified tolerancing criteria, the need for opportunities to be involved in the development of improved metrological practice within will be commonplace.
  • The candidate may be asked to assist with investigations potentially leading to amendments in existing calibration documentation or procedures.
  • The candidate is required to maintain a consistent quality of work and generate technically valid results despite a high degree of repetition.
  • Dimensional calibration standards and artefacts can be excessively heavy yet delicate in nature, often mandating the utilisation of multiple operators or specialised lifting equipment.
  • Prolonged periods standing while efforts are maintained to avoid transferring vibration or movement to calibration setups.
  • Work involved in this calibration discipline is often highly detailed and requires the metrologist to discern fine graduation markings on calibration equipment.
  • Correct use of PPE is essential in all aspects of mechanical calibration.
  • The main body of the work is carried out in a calibration workshop environment.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Technical background in mechanical or electronic / electrical engineering.
  • BTEC ONC in a relevant engineering discipline / completion of a recognised relevant engineering apprenticeship or similar accredited training or qualified to an equivalent level by experience.
  • Ability to work well as part of a team.
  • Ability to follow/adhere to technical procedures.
  • Working knowledge of IT systems (Word, Excel etc.).
  • SC clearance or eligible/willing to be put through SC clearance successful candidate may start with BPSS as minimum with a view to completing SC clearance.

Desirable:

  • Calibration experience would highly desirable.
  • Able to interpret measurement results and compare against customer calibration statement of requirement.
  • Correct handling of calibration standards and artefacts and construction of suitable test-pieces for mechanical calibration.
  • Best metrological practice and principles behind uncertainty of measurement and traceability.
  • Use of BEAVER DMS and Microsoft Windows based software pack

title: Associate Director, Clinical Supply
description:
Position Summary

The Associate Director of Clinical Supply is responsible for the support and management of the clinical drug product supply for the Company’s clinical study programs to ensure continuity while maintaining compliance standards and following agreed supply planning processes. Working with a range of departments and internationally based third-party vendors, the Associate Director requires a structured approach to establishing a full support and oversight process with extensive collaboration among internal teams. The position will be required to attend occasional in person meetings in the Parsippany, NJ office with a strong preference to be located on the East Coast.

The Associate Director will report to the Senior Vice President, Chief Technical Officer.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Oversees management and communication of clinical drug product supply for the Company’s clinical study programs
  • Designs, develops, and manages strategies required to support new clinical studies
  • Oversees the process to translate inputs from Clinical into a supply strategy and effectively communicate such information
  • Develops and maintains clinical supply forecasting and planning tools
  • Liaises and manages relationships with external resources as required (e.g. IRT vendors, clinical distributor and packager)
  • Liaises with internal departments to understand the forecasted requirements, new clinical studies, and changes to existing studies
  • Supports regulatory interactions and submissions with various global regulatory agencies
  • Develops and maintains batch records, systems, procedures, and associated documentation in coordination with vendors as well as Quality, Clinical Operations, Manufacturing and Supply Chain, and other functional areas
  • Proactively identifies any key supply/demand imbalance, assesses the risk, runs root cause analysis, evaluates options, and proposes solutions
  • Ensures corrective/preventive actions are established where required

Competencies

  • Solid understanding of the requirements for the production of clinical materials with a CMO
  • Well-versed on the intricacies of a global study and the local nuances effecting clinical supply
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a multi-disciplinary team environment within a regulated environment
  • Extensive knowledge of clinical supply chain principles, including forecasting, planning, logistics, distribution, vendor management, and metrics/reporting
  • Comfortable proactively solving issues and working independently
  • Strong strategic skills and agility

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in life/physical sciences preferred
  • A minimum of 7 years direct experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related industry and significant GMP and GDP knowledge
  • Extensive experience in the management of multiple global pharmaceutical clinical studies with complex supply chains
  • Prior experience and proven knowledge in the use of IRT systems in support of clinical studies, including UAT testing of the initial set-up and subsequent modifications

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

Plan choices include medical, dental, vision, life insurance, flexible spending accounts, disability insurance, supplemental health insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan, and an employee stock purchase plan. Geron also provides regular-status, full-time employees with a generous time off program that includes the eligibility to accrue 160 hours of vacation during each full year of employment, 64 hours of sick leave, 9 standard paid holiday days off, and paid leave for certain life events. Geron recognizes that its employees work in many different states and therefore may be affected by different laws. It is Geron’s intention to comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws that apply to the Company’s employees.

title: Firefighter (2026-01)
description:
NATURE AND SCOPE OF WORK

This is skilled fire suppression and rescue work which involves combating, extinguishing and preventing fires and the saving of life and property. A firefighter is responsible for: rapidly and efficiently performing various duties under emergency conditions frequently involving considerable hazard; routine cleaning, servicing and maintenance of fire department equipment, apparatus, and property; participating in programs such as fire inspections, public education and public relations; participate in the delivery of training and sharing of knowledge with other fire / rescue personnel, including paid-call members; cleaning, maintenance and minor repairs for fire hall buildings and grounds. Although specific orders, instructions and assignments are received from a superior, a firefighter exercises independent judgment and action in emergency situations where superior’s directions are not available or possible.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES OF DUTIES

Performs fire suppression, rescue, hazmat, first aid and other related services.

As assigned, drivers operate all fire / rescue apparatus and equipment.

Participates in and maintains cleanliness, servicing and minor repairing of fire station, grounds, equipment, apparatus, turnout gear and uniforms as required.

Participates in training, drills, and practice sessions with career and paid-on-call personnel, as required.

Maintains up to date information and details with respect to location and accessibility of roads, industrial and commercial buildings, hydrants and all other physical and geographical aspects of the community in order to effectively participate in pre-planning, fire suppression methods and public safety.

Prepares and maintains records and reports, issues permits and enforces applicable codes and bylaws, issues municipal tickets, efficiently enters data into various computer software programs, and performs all required clerical tasks relating to the work as required.

Receives and records emergency calls and dispatches proper apparatus as required.

As required, performs fire and life safety fire inspections in all types of structures, pre-incident planning and participates in public education programs and public relations events as required.

Participates on department / municipal projects or committees as required.

May assist in fire cause and origin investigations and write associated reports.

Constructs, maintains, operates and trains others in the use of training props as required.

Performs other related duties as assigned.

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, ABILITIES, AND SKILLS

Considerable knowledge of:

Methods, techniques and theories used in suppressing and preventing fires, and related emergencies.

First aid and first responder medical practices.

Operations, policies, regulations and standard operating procedures of the Mission Fire Rescue Service.

Operation and maintenance of all fire fighting / rescue apparatus and equipment.

Applicable codes, standards and municipal bylaws relating to the fire and life safety inspections of buildings.

Building construction, wiring and hydraulics as applied to the work performed.

The geography and street locations of the municipality.

Ability to:

  • Understand and follow oral and written instructions.
  • Represent the City and fire department in a positive manner.
  • Perform maintenance, cleaning and minor repair of fire rescue equipment and apparatus, and department facilities.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Applications will be screened to ensure the following qualifications have been met. If you do not meet ALL of these, please do not submit an application as it will be screened out:

Successful completion of an approved Firefighter Training program resulting in a minimum of Firefighter Level 2 Certificate (NFPA1001) OR a current member of Mission Fire Departments paid-on-call program OR completion of at least one (1) full year in a career fire department. Certificates must have Pro-Board or IFSAC seal.

High school Grade 12 graduation with transcript.

Transcripts demonstrating successful completion of at least one (1) year of post-secondary education (i.e. 30 credits-academic/technical/trades) OR at least two years of accumulated work experience after high school (equivalent to full time hours), preferably in work related to the needs of the Fire Service (i.e. building construction, mechanical, driving trucks and/or large or emergency vehicles, first aid, nursing, paramedic, instructor/educator, full-time competitive athlete, etc.).

Physically fit for the position of Firefighter and medically fit according to the standards set in NFPA 1582.

Valid BC Class 3 Driver’s License or higher (Class 1 for example) with air brake endorsement for vehicles with more than two axles (Automatic transmission is accepted). * Applications without this qualification will be accepted only if you are able to obtain the qualification by the date of an official job offer.

Current driver’s abstract - personal driving record (dated no more than 30 days prior to the application closing date). This abstract should demonstrate responsible and safe driving behavior. A current record with:

  • A Driver’s License with no more than six (6) demerits/points in any one year, a total of no more than nine (9) points in the past five years, no suspensions under Section 215 of the Motor Vehicle Act, no convictions under Section 320.14 of the Criminal Code of Canada, and no present suspensions or charges pending.
  • Ensure your abstract displays a status of NORMAL. If your abstract displays a status of HOLD, you may be required to provide details on the “hold” before advancing to further stages of recruitment.

Successful completion of a recognized EMLAB BC First Responder (FR) or higher.

Computer literate (i.e. proficiency in Microsoft Office and/or common software applications).

Canadian Citizen or Permanent Resident of Canada.

No criminal convictions related to the job of Firefighter. Please see RCMP in British Columbia - Obtain a Criminal Records Check (Police Information Check) (rcmp-grc.gc.ca).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Progress towards or completion of a post-secondary education program (i.e. academic, technical or trades training).

Higher level first aid or first responder certification such as:

  • EMR
  • Primary Care Paramedic (PCP)

Additional fire service-related certificates listed below:

  • Auto Extrication/Vehicle Rescue
  • Hazardous Material Technical
  • Technical Rope Rescue
  • Lifesaving Certificates (Bronze Cross, Bronze Medallion, NLS)
  • WSOO-WFF-1
  • Mental Health certification

Demonstration of community service, other than duties assigned as a paid-on-call/volunteer firefighter (i.e. responding to calls, training etc.).

ADDITIONAL ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS

19 years of age or older

  • No conviction of a criminal offence related to the job duties of a firefighter (criminal records check will be completed prior to first interview). *At the time applications are submitted, applicants will be required to consent to a criminal records check.
  • Good physical condition and able to successfully complete the Mission Firefighter Physical Ability Test (medical clearance to participate in FPAT must be provided by medical professional).

Satisfactory medical examination to the standard of firefighter's pre-employment protocol that meets the NFPA 1582 standards.

SELECTION PROCESS

You will be contacted by e-mail if you are shortlisted to participate in the next stage. All testing throughout the recruitment process takes place at Mission Fire Station #1 (33330-7th Ave, Mission B.C. V2V-4R1) and all applicants must attend in person. You must be successful at each stage in order to be considered further in the process.

Only candidates with the minimum required qualifications and whose applications are regarded as complete will be considered for advancement to the following stages:

RECRUITMENT/SELECTION PROCESS TIMELINE*:

*timelines are subject to change

  • Sunday, October 25: Posting closes
  • Monday, October 26 to Tuesday, October 27: Candidate screening & confirmation of required documentation
  • Wednesday, October 28: Those selected will be contacted confirm attendance for Written Exam
  • Saturday, October 31: Written Exam
  • Weekend of November 7/8: Physical testing
  • Week of November 9 – Clearance checks
  • Weeks of November 16 & 23: Panel Interviews
  • Weeks of November, 30 & December 7: Ride-along
  • Week of December 14: Chief Interview
  • Medical Checks
  • Reference Checks
  • January 2027: Job Offer

INTERVIEW PROCESS INFORMATION

PHYSICAL TESTING

Endurance and Swim Assessments

The physical test is a series of exercises that are timed and scored as complete or incomplete.

The physical activities are:

  • Swim Test-5 mins of treading Water, 150 Meter Swim (6 laps of pool continuously), 50 Meter Tow (Swim Test Assessment Document)
  • 12 min Run-Candidate must complete 6 laps of the track in 12 mins flat
  • C-PAT– All timed stations will be performed consecutively while wearing a 50lb weighted vest and be scored for time.

C-PAT activities involved are:

  • Please see attachment (MFRS C-PAT Skills Assessment Document)
  • Liability Waiver to be signed

PANEL INTERVIEW & CANDIDATE SELECTION

Selected candidates will be notified to advance in the process to a panel interview.

This panel will consist of Fire Department recruiting and selection team members and representatives from Human Resources and IAFF Local 4768.

The interview will allow you the opportunity to expand on your resume, experience and educational background and allow you to answer behavioral questions.

Following the Panel Interview, successful candidates moving on in the process will be booked into a Ride-A-Long process for further assessments and to determine a good fit with the crew and the department.

RIDE-A-LONG

Selected candidates will receive communication of expectations and requirements before your ride-a-long date is scheduled. Liability forms must be signed by candidate before commencing ride-a-long.

During the ride-a-long, you will act as an observer and will not verbally or physically participate in emergency calls. You will have to attend one day shift (08:00-17:00). You can expect to undertake training with the crews which will involve a skills assessment, assist with all station duties and gain exposure to the workflow and environment of a career department. This part of the process may be evaluated by various members of the training division and hiring committee at any time.

Skills Assessments: Each assessment (various 1001 skills) will be demonstrated to candidate prior to commencing assessment-some of these assessments may be timed.

FIRE CHIEF'S INTERVIEW

Successful candidates will move on to the Fire Chief’s interview stage of the process.

Successful candidates will meet with the Fire Chief for an interview assessing motivation, character, and experience.

Following the Fire Chief’s interview and any further testing, some candidates may be given a conditional offer of employment or be placed in an eligibility pool. The conditional offer is conditional on at least (but not limited to) the elements below:

  1. Passing an assessment with a certified medical physician demonstrating medical fitness to perform the job of Firefighter. The assessment uses the National Fire Protection Association – Standard on Comprehensive Occupational Medical Program for Fire Departments (referred to as “NFPA 1582”).
  2. Providing an updated Police Information Check with vulnerable sector clearance.
  3. Submitting an updated driver's abstract – personal driving record demonstrating safe and responsible driving behavior as at the time of application.
  4. Successful completion of work-related reference checks.

Candidates who are not selected for immediate employment may be placed on an eligibility pool (1 year) for consideration for future employment opportunities.

Candidates hired as new employees shall become members of IAFF, Local 4768

Closing Date: Sunday, October 25, 2026

title: Body Technician
description:
Job Description: Auto Body Collision Repair Technician


The Body Technician is a skilled craftsman with a thorough understanding of how to restore automobiles with light to heavy damage through collision repair. Key responsibilities include assessing exterior damage, repairing manufacturer guidelines, ensuring necessary parts, reshaping panels with minor damage, welding and refinishing techniques as needed.

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Work Location: Full Time Hourly/Commission


Sign-On Bonus Available for Qualified Candidates. Bonus eligibility, amount, and payout schedule are determined based on experience, certifications, skill set, and business needs. Terms and conditions apply.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Ensure repairs adhere to OE standards, DRP part choices, and ADAS requirements for calibrations and scanning, verifying a quality and safe repair.
  • Complete disassembly of vehicles
  • Refit new parts such as bumpers, fenders, grills, moldings, and other bolt-on and welded items.
  • Complete all repairs in a manner in which the repaired areas are restored to the original manufacturer’s specifications, including door, hood and deck alignments, chassis, and frame measurements, and welded on unibody parts.
  • Check all parts for accuracy before starting the repair and notify the Estimator of any incorrect parts or other discrepancies.
  • Work efficiently to meet the target delivery date assigned to an RO.
  • Assume responsibility for all parts assigned to your job(s)
  • Protect the interior and exterior non-repair areas of all vehicles in repair from additional damage, including dust, dirt, scratches, primer, overspray.
  • Read and understand every line item of each vehicle’s RO as pertaining to your responsibilities and visually inspect every vehicle to ensure that all the repairs are complete.
  • Provide guidance, education, and assistance to the assigned apprentice in such a manner that furthers their developmental growth.

Key Performance Metrics

  • Customer Service Index Score 95+ for Quality, Done on Time, and Net Promoter Score
  • Cycle Time Efficiency

Skills/Technical Qualifications:

  • I-CAR Gold Class and ASE certifications a plus
  • Complete understanding of all facets of light to heavy automobile collision repair.
  • Knowledgeable in safety guidelines for repair.
  • Skilled welder with the ability to remove and refit welded panels as well as the bolt-on items required in a typical crash repair.
  • The ability to read, understand, and perform written instructions accurately and consistently and to work independently as well as with others in an organized manner.


Behavioral Excellence Required:

  • Perform all assigned responsibilities according to the Company Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area always, adhering to 5S organization.
  • Participate in training programs as required to maintain the technical and professional skills and techniques necessary for this position.
  • Extend normal working hours as necessary to accommodate workload and customer requirements.



Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to work in an automotive repair shop environment for extended periods.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, and reach frequently throughout the workday.
  • Ability to work in various positions, including above shoulder height, below waist level, and in confined spaces.
  • Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 pounds frequently and up to 75 pounds occasionally, with heavier lifting performed using assistance or mechanical equipment.
  • Ability to operate hand tools, power tools, welding equipment, measuring devices, and other repair-related equipment safely and effectively.
  • Ability to use hands and fingers for repetitive grasping, handling, manipulating, and operating tools and equipment.
  • Ability to visually inspect vehicle damage, measure tolerances, assess repair quality, and identify defects, including close, distance, color, and peripheral vision.

Overview
First Military Recruitment are currently seeking a Project Manager on behalf of one of our clients, an established civil engineering and infrastructure contractor.

The successful candidate will manage projects from design through to completion, ensuring works are delivered safely, on programme, within budget and to the required quality standards. The role involves coordinating site teams, managing subcontractors, overseeing commercial performance and maintaining strong client relationships.

  • Manage NEC3/NEC4 contractual requirements, including early warnings and compensation events.
  • Chair site meetings, monitor progress and maintain accurate project records.
  • Coordinate design development and resolve technical issues.
  • Maintain client and supply chain relationships, identifying opportunities to improve project performance.

Skills and Qualifications
Essential

  • Project management experience within civil engineering or infrastructure.

  • Experience with NEC3/NEC4 contracts and subcontractor management.

Desirable

  • Experience in rail, water, utilities or heavy civil engineering projects.

  • Leadership and management training.
  • Regular appraisals and career development support.
  • Internal and external training opportunities.

This is an opportunity to manage challenging infrastructure projects within an established contractor, with access to professional development and long-term career progression.

Ex-military candidates are encouraged to apply, particularly those with relevant engineering qualifications, project delivery experience or a background in infrastructure and construction. title: SENIOR .NET SOFTWARE ENGINEER (M/F)

Hiszünk abban, hogy a sport mindenkié, és küldetésünk, hogy ezt az örömöt minél több emberhez eljuttassuk. 🔵Köztünk a helyed, ha👇

  • fontos számodra a vásárló központú gondolkodásmód
  • sportszeretet jellemez

  • jó problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel, minden esetben megoldásorientált vagy és nem riadsz vissza a kihívásoktól
  • empatikus és türelmes vagy, még a nehezebb helyzetekben is
  • mindig van egy új ötleted, ami előre viszi a csapatot
  • nyitott vagy az újra, szeretsz tanulni és fejlődni.

title: Business Solutions Advisor
description:

Reports to: Director of Revenue Operations

Department: Acquiring

About Priority Commerce:

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.


We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.


At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to be known for results - bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.


About the Role:

As a Business Solutions Advisor, you will be a motivated, customer-focused professional with strong communication and persuasion skills, responsible for selling our products and services over the phone. In this role, you will drive revenue by identifying and pursuing new sales leads, engaging Priority’s existing client base to uncover additional opportunities, and responding to inbound inquiries from both prospects and current customers to guide them through the sales process and close deals.

  • Make outbound calls to potential and existing customers to promote products or services.

  • Identify and generate new sales leads while promptly engaging with inbound inquiries to qualify prospects and move them through the sales pipeline toward conversion.

  • Represent Priority at trade shows and similar events as needed.

  • Maintain CRM to accurately report pipeline and deal progression by logging customer interactions and sales activities.

  • Meet or exceed daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets and performance metrics.

  • Actively manages and nurtures a healthy pipeline, ensuring timely follow-ups and minimal loss of viable opportunities.

  • Demonstrates strong product knowledge, compliance with regulations, and resilience in a high-volume environment, contributing to steady revenue growth.



Candidate Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience selling Payroll, Merchant Services or related financial services and technology.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred; additional education in sales, marketing, or related field is a plus.

  • Proven track record of success in Sales.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and handle objections professionally.

  • Goal-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving sales targets.

  • Good organizational and time management skills.

  • Basic computer skills and familiarity with Salesforce or Outreach.

  • Patience, persistence, and resilience in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to travel locally to meet prospective clients with occasional travel to tradeshows or conventions to engage with potential clients.




Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand - an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Time Off

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.


Traditional Physical Requirements:

title: Facade Designer
description:
Location: Remote (UK-based)

Salary: £42,000 - £47,000

Working Hours: Monday – Friday (8am-5pm)

Job Code: MJ2353


Façade Designer


My client is an established leader in external building envelope solutions, and they are seeking a talented Façade Designer to join their expanding technical team.


Operating predominantly remotely, with occasional travel to their London head office, factory, or UK sites as needed, this role offers fantastic flexibility alongside high project involvement.


To be considered, candidates must have a minimum of 5 years of proven, checkable experience in UK façade design or related disciplines like cladding, glazing, and curtain walling.


It is an ideal opportunity for an experienced professional to take full ownership of projects from concept through to site delivery.



Key Responsibilities:


  • Produce accurate 2D AutoCAD drawings and 3D models for curtain walling, cladding, SFS, and metalwork.
  • Create complete technical packages including GA drawings, interface details, and fixings.
  • Generate fabrication drawings and material procurement schedules for manufacturing.
  • Prepare compliance documentation meeting UK Building Regulations, BSR, and warranty guidelines.

  • Work with clients, architects, and engineers to clear technical details and secure approvals.
  • Attend design meetings, respond to RFIs, and keep document control logs up to date.
  • Provide technical support through installation, handling site queries and issuing as-builts.


The successful candidate will have:


  • Minimum 5 years' checkable UK experience in façade design (curtain walling, cladding, glazing, rainscreen).
  • Degree or recognised UK qualification in Architecture, Engineering, or Façade Engineering.
  • Strong AutoCAD skills and sound knowledge of UK Building Regulations and performance standards.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities, high attention to detail, and great time management.
  • Desirable: Proficiency in 3D modelling software (Revit, SolidWorks, Inventor) or BIM experience.

Benefits:


  • Remote working setup with full IT equipment and software provided
  • 29 days paid annual leave (including bank holidays)
  • Discretionary annual performance bonus
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
  • Full reimbursement of travel expenses for site and office visits

title: Oracle Database Administrator
description:
Η PLANET S.A. αναζητά Oracle Database Administrator για την ενίσχυση της ομάδας βάσεων δεδομένων μεγάλου οργανισμού του ενεργειακού τομέα. Στον ρόλο αυτό, θα έχετε την ευθύνη της εγκατάστασης, διαχείρισης, ασφάλειας και απόδοσης των βάσεων δεδομένων Oracle, τόσο σε on-premise υποδομές όσο και σε cloud, και θα συμμετέχετε ενεργά στον σχεδιασμό, τις αναβαθμίσεις και τις μεταφορές τους.

Responsibilities:

  • Εγκατάσταση, παραμετροποίηση, συντήρηση και επίλυση προβλημάτων σε βάσεις δεδομένων Oracle, on-premise και σε cloud.
  • Διαχείριση ασφάλειας και ακεραιότητας βάσεων, δικαιωμάτων χρηστών και αντιγράφων ασφαλείας (RMAN).
  • Έλεγχος scripts των προγραμματιστών και εφαρμογή πολιτικών και διαδικασιών ασφαλείας.
  • Παρακολούθηση των συστημάτων για την πρόληψη αστοχιών και βελτιστοποίηση απόδοσης (Performance Tuning) με Statspack και AWR.
  • Αναβαθμίσεις, μεταφορές σε νεότερες εκδόσεις και εγκατάσταση patches.
  • Archiving και replication δεδομένων με Multi-Master replication, Active Data Guard και GoldenGate, καθώς και διαχείριση db-links.
  • Ενεργή συμμετοχή στον σχεδιασμό και την ανάπτυξη βάσεων δεδομένων και στις διαδικασίες συντήρησης.
  • Επικοινωνία με προγραμματιστές, project managers, ανάδοχες εταιρείες και τις ομάδες ασφάλειας, δικτύων και συστημάτων.
  • Δημιουργία και παρακολούθηση Service Requests στο Oracle Support και διαχείριση αιτημάτων μέσω ticketing συστημάτων (JIRA, ServiceNow).
  • Ανάπτυξη και συντήρηση τεχνικής τεκμηρίωσης και εκπαίδευση junior DBAs.
  • Διασφάλιση της τήρησης SLAs και στόχων.

Requirements

  • Τουλάχιστον 5 έτη αποδεδειγμένης επαγγελματικής εμπειρίας σε Oracle RDBMS, Oracle Exadata και Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  • Εμπειρία σε λειτουργικά συστήματα Oracle Linux και AIX
  • Linux shell scripting και χρήση SQL / PL-SQL
  • Κατανόηση προτύπων δικτύωσης και βέλτιστων πρακτικών
  • Αναλυτική σκέψη και ικανότητα επίλυσης σύνθετων προβλημάτων υποδομής
  • Άριστη γνώση της Αγγλικής γλώσσας

Επιθυμητά προσόντα

  • Oracle Certified Professional Database Administrator
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Certified Architect Associate
  • Oracle Cloud Database Migration and Integration Certified Specialist
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Certified Associate
